13ce9738.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
13ce9738.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Lead Technical Program Manager
   

  

**Overview**
 Are you a technical program manager who wants to shape the cloud platform for Mastercard’s products? Do you want to work for a company that offers above and beyond benefits including paid parental leave, flexible work hours, gift matching, and even volunteer incentives? Do you want to work in an inclusive and nurturing culture that encourages your own professional learning and development?
   

  

 ROLE
   

  

 We are breaking up our monoliths and re\-platforming features into re\-usable micro\-services and APIs while we continue to innovate and deliver results for our customers. All net new capabilities will be built on the cloud platform supporting multi\-tenancy and multi\-geography capabilities for the company. We are looking for experienced technical program management professionals to join our team and help us build towards the future. Our Technical Program Managers (TPM) conceptualize, rationalize, and drive multiple simultaneous projects to deliver engineering work across the portfolio in our scrum execution model. In this role, you get to dive as deep as you want into the tech stack, the integration patterns, the organizational capabilities, and the company wide assets that can be leveraged to provide technical solutions to customer problems. You will contribute to the strategies, design choices, and even the cloud infrastructure necessary to build comprehensive believable and achievable execution plans to deliver high\-profile new features and capabilities for our customers. You may drive the execution of a feature through the full stack or may drive a project which spans multiple teams and integrations, reporting meaningful status along the way.
   

  

**All About You**
 Demonstrated ability to operate with independence and autonomy
   

  

 Experience defining and building cloud\-native software products as a platform at scale with a deep understanding of those platforms capabilities and underlying technologies.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning sprints, and delivering technical programs in agile delivery models (scrum, Kanban, etc.)
   

  

 Experience working on programs to define and build cloud\-native software products as a platform at scale
   

  

 Enjoys diving deep to understand of the platforms capabilities and underlying technologies.
   

  

 Proven track record of data driven decision\-making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams
   

  

 Can debate the delivery strategy with business teams, architects, engineers, and designers
   

  

 Can communicate to executives, peers, and staff with impact, eloquence, and authenticity
   

  

 Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization
   

  

 Huge plus if you have expertise in Payments, IaaS, PaaS, serverless technology, CI/CD, NoSQL databases, microservices APIs, and distributed systems operations in a DevOps model
   

  

 BS in engineering, computer science or related discipline.
   

  

 Technical program delivery experience including time developing and testing software
   

  

 AI related adoption in program management is a must
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

2bd72d76.title: Technical Program Manager
2bd72d76.description:
**This role is for one of our clients**
 Company Name: Tekion
   

  

 Industry: Software Development
   

  

 Seniority level: Mid\-Senior level
   

  

 Min Experience: 7\+ years
   

  

 Location: Chennai
   

  

 JobType: full\-time
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
   

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE** 
 :
   

  

 Tekion is redefining automotive retail with a cloud\-native, AI\-native platform serving 1,700\+ dealerships. We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to join our CIO/PMO organization at a pivotal moment, as we accelerate an enterprise\-wide AI transformation. This is not a conventional program management role. You will sit at the intersection of strategy, governance, and execution, shaping how critical transformative programs are run. Reporting into the Director, Technical Program Manager, you will be a key voice in building the PMO function and driving transformation across CIO Organization.
   

  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 
 :
   

  

  

* Partner directly with the CIO and his leadership team on critical transformation program strategy and delivery
* Build and run program governance structures that scale with Tekion's hyper growth
* Establish and continuously improve sprint cadence, story point estimation, Definition of Done, milestone tracking etc.
* Identify and proactively manage risks, blockers, and escalation paths across complex, multi\-team programs
* Drive structured program rollouts with defined scope, success metrics, and dependency management
* Produce C\-suite facing deliverables: program status decks, OKR scorecards, quarterly business narratives, and business proposals
* Define and track PMO KPIs: delivery velocity, capacity utilization, and quality indicators
* Build and maintain dashboards in Jira, Confluence, and other AI tools for real\-time program visibility
* Champion PMO maturity across teams\- standardizing processes, governance frameworks, and reporting cadences


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 
 :
   

  

  

* 7\+ years of technical program management experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex, cross\-functional technical programs
* 2\-4 years of management consulting experience preferred at a recognized firm, with strong executive\-facing communication and structured problem\-solving skills
* Prior experience embedded in a PMO within a multinational company, you have operated across geographies, time zones, and cross functional teams
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to present to senior leadership team
* Proven track record delivering programs in enterprise technology environments (GTM, Finance, Data/AI, or similar)
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Agile/PDLC delivery frameworks
* Well versed with AI LLM models and building skills/agents


**About The Company**
 Tekion is redefining automotive retail with an end\-to\-end, AI\-native platform purpose\-built for the industry. With AI built into every workflow, Tekion delivers intelligent automation, real\-time insights, and advanced decision support—driving measurable efficiency, revenue, and modern consumer.
   

  

 Must\-have skills
   

  

 Program Management, program development
   

  

 Good\-to\-have skills
   

  

 Jira, Confluence, Artificial Intelligence

2cb095d7.title: Presales Engineer
2cb095d7.description:
**Designation: Presales Engineer** 




**Preferred Experience: 3\+ Years** 




**Location: Pune** 




  





**Job Summary** 





 We are looking for a
 
**Presales Engineer** 

 with a strong technical background who can understand complex technical products and translate them into compelling solutions for clients. The role involves working closely with sales, product, and engineering teams to conduct product demos, handle technical discussions, and support deal closures.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Technical Presales \& Solutioning** 



* Understand customer requirements and map them to appropriate technical solutions.
* Analyze client use cases and recommend product configurations or custom solutions.
* Act as the technical point of contact during the sales cycle.



**Product Demonstrations** 



* Conduct technical product demos, proofs\-of\-concept (POCs), and walkthroughs for clients.
* Tailor demos based on customer industry, business challenges, and technical maturity.
* Clearly explain product architecture, features, and integrations to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.



**Cross\-Functional \& Go\-To\-Market Support** 



* Partner with sales teams to respond to RFPs, RFIs, and technical questionnaires.
* Assist in preparing proposals, presentations, and solution documentation.
* Support negotiations by addressing technical objections and concerns.
* Support cross\-functional initiatives beyond presales, including marketing, events, and solution positioning, as required.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to contribute to solution collateral, including flyers, brochures, case studies, and pitch decks.
* Assist in webinars, conferences, industry events, and product launches by supporting demos, presentations, and technical storytelling.
* Translate technical capabilities into clear, customer\-friendly messaging for digital and field marketing use cases.



**Stakeholder Collaboration** 



* Work closely with product and engineering teams to stay updated on new features and roadmap.
* Provide customer feedback to internal teams to improve product offerings.
* Ensure smooth handover from presales to delivery/implementation teams.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




**Technical Skills** 



* Strong understanding of software products, SaaS platforms, or enterprise solutions.
* Strong ownership mindset with attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Comfort working with presentations, documentation, and visual storytelling for both technical and business audiences.
* Ability to understand system architecture, APIs, integrations, and workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with demos, POCs, or solution presentations.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, databases, or modern tech stacks is a plus.



**Soft Skills** 



* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts in a simple, business\-friendly manner.
* Ability to work in cross\-functional roles spanning presales, marketing, and customer engagement when required.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Confident in client\-facing interactions.



**Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 3–6 years of experience in presales, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or similar roles.



  





**Company Overview:** 





 Aventior is a leading provider of innovative technology solutions for businesses across a wide range of industries. At Aventior, we leverage cutting\-edge technologies like AI, ML Ops, DevOps, and many more to help our clients solve complex business problems and drive growth.
 





 We also provide a full range of data development and management services, including Cloud Data Architecture, Universal Data Models, Data Transformation \& and ETL, Data Lakes, User Management, Analytics and visualization, and automated data capture (for scanned documents and unstructured/semi\-structured data sources). Our team of experienced professionals combines deep industry knowledge with expertise in the latest technologies to deliver customized solutions that meet the unique needs of each of our clients. Whether you are looking to streamline your operations, enhance your customer experience, or improve your decision\-making process, Aventior has the skills and resources to help you achieve your goals. 
 





 We bring a well\-rounded, cross\-industry, and multi\-client perspective to our client engagements. Our strategy is grounded in design, implementation, innovation, migration, and support. We have a global delivery model, a multi\-country presence, and a team well\-equipped with professionals and experts in the field.
 




  





**Website:** 

 https://aventior.com/

 TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next\-generation customer experience to fast\-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud\-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest\-growing sectors, including social media, e\-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride\-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.

We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. f0e4217e.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
f0e4217e.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Lead Technical Program Manager
OVERVIEW  

Are you a technical program manager who wants to shape the cloud platform for Mastercard’s products? Do you want to work for a company that offers above and beyond benefits including paid parental leave, flexible work hours, gift matching, and even volunteer incentives? Do you want to work in an inclusive and nurturing culture that encourages your own professional learning and development?  

  

ROLE  

We are breaking up our monoliths and re\-platforming features into re\-usable micro\-services and APIs while we continue to innovate and deliver results for our customers. All net new capabilities will be built on the cloud platform supporting multi\-tenancy and multi\-geography capabilities for the company. We are looking for experienced technical program management professionals to join our team and help us build towards the future. Our Technical Program Managers (TPM) conceptualize, rationalize, and drive multiple simultaneous projects to deliver engineering work across the portfolio in our scrum execution model. In this role, you get to dive as deep as you want into the tech stack, the integration patterns, the organizational capabilities, and the company wide assets that can be leveraged to provide technical solutions to customer problems. You will contribute to the strategies, design choices, and even the cloud infrastructure necessary to build comprehensive believable and achievable execution plans to deliver high\-profile new features and capabilities for our customers. You may drive the execution of a feature through the full stack or may drive a project which spans multiple teams and integrations, reporting meaningful status along the way.
  

  

ALL ABOUT YOU  

Demonstrated ability to operate with independence and autonomy
  

Experience defining and building cloud\-native software products as a platform at scale with a deep understanding of those platforms capabilities and underlying technologies.  

Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning sprints, and delivering technical programs in agile delivery models (scrum, Kanban, etc.)  

Experience working on programs to define and build cloud\-native software products as a platform at scale  

Enjoys diving deep to understand of the platforms capabilities and underlying technologies.
  

Proven track record of data driven decision\-making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams
  

Can debate the delivery strategy with business teams, architects, engineers, and designers
  

Can communicate to executives, peers, and staff with impact, eloquence, and authenticity  

Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization  

Huge plus if you have expertise in Payments, IaaS, PaaS, serverless technology, CI/CD, NoSQL databases, microservices APIs, and distributed systems operations in a DevOps model  

BS in engineering, computer science or related discipline.
  

Technical program delivery experience including time developing and testing software  

AI related adoption in program management is a must **Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

53bf8952.title: Solution Engineer
53bf8952.description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75\+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.
   

  

 As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full\-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.
   

  

 We operate with an AI\-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.
   

  

 If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.
   

  

 Let’s build what’s next, together.
   

  

 As a Solution Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, demonstrating, and implementing enterprise\-level SaaS, chatbot, conversational AI, and CPaaS solutions for clients. This is a highly client\-facing role that combines strong communication and consultative skills with hands\-on technical execution.
   

  

 You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams to understand business requirements, define the scope of work, conduct solution reviews, and deliver customized solutions using APIs, conversational AI, automation platforms, and emerging AI development tools.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is confident in customer interactions, able to convince and influence stakeholders, and comfortable using AI tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, and similar platforms to build solutions, prototypes, code, and reusable technical artifacts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement chatbot, conversational agent, and AI\-powered solutions tailored to client requirements.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their business challenges, explain technical concepts, present solutions, and build confidence in the proposed approach.
* Conduct technical discovery sessions, solution reviews, feasibility analyses, product demonstrations, and proof\-of\-concept discussions.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions, implementation plans, and scopes of work.
* Use AI development tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, and similar AI platforms to accelerate solution design, implementation, coding, prototyping, and documentation.
* Create and maintain AI\-generated or AI\-assisted technical artifacts, including prototypes, workflows, reusable skills, integrations, code components, documentation, and solution accelerators.
* Integrate and configure CPaaS products, including: Email, Voice, WhatsApp, RCS, Marketing automation solutions, Conversational agent and chatbot platforms
* Utilize REST APIs, Call APIs, webhooks, and other integration capabilities to extend solution functionality.
* Work with JavaScript, C\+\+, .NET, and related technologies to customize and integrate client solutions.
* Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success teams to define client needs, solution scope, effort estimates, dependencies, and delivery expectations.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to assess feasibility, resolve technical issues, and provide client feedback.
* Support solution implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-implementation troubleshooting.
* Provide ongoing technical consulting and post\-implementation support to ensure client satisfaction and optimal solution performance.
* Stay up to date with SaaS, conversational AI, generative AI, automation, and CPaaS trends, and apply relevant best practices.
* Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, best\-practice documentation, technical mentorship, and the development of reusable solution assets.


**Required Qualifications And Skills**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in solution engineering, technical consulting, systems development, enterprise software implementation, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience in a customer\-facing role, including the ability to communicate confidently, present solutions, influence stakeholders, and handle client discussions independently.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to build solutions, prototypes, code, workflows, or other technical artifacts.
* Practical experience with chatbot technologies, conversational AI, generative AI, or conversational agent solutions.
* Proficiency in one or more of JavaScript, C\+\+, and .NET, along with the ability to understand and work across multiple technologies.
* Strong knowledge of API integrations, particularly REST APIs, Call APIs, webhooks, and third\-party service integrations.
* Experience with SaaS products and enterprise\-level implementations.
* Familiarity with CPaaS products such as Email, Voice, WhatsApp, RCS, and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to convert business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ability to work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Experience with Agile methodologies is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Why you'll love it here**
* Financial rewards \& recognition \- A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance\-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
* Flexible work arrangements \- We combine in\-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere \- and not always between 9 and 5\.
* ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) \- As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
* Work\-life balance and Well\-being  \- We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility \- Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development \- Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow \- no matter where you start.
* International mobility \- Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long\-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well\-being, and success \- wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection


**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.** 
 We’re proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
   

  

 No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.
   

  

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.**
 Read more about our hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience with one or more general purpose programming languages like Java, Python, Go.
* 2 years of experience building AI solutions and experiences.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in generative AI agent and machine learning.
* Experience in full\-stack development, enterprise software architecture and AI platforms.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



Within Google Cloud, Looker is the core of our Business Intelligence (BI) and analytics platform. Our mission is to reinvent BI by moving it from a descriptive (what happened) tool to a prescriptive and collaborative partner (what should we do next?). We are doing this by deeply infusing Generative AI into the Looker platform. We believe this is a 100x opportunity to change how the world interacts with data. This role is central to that mission, defining how we leverage Looker's unique semantic layer to provide trusted, governed, and conversational data experiences to everyone.

  

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Dive deep into the core Artificial Intelligence (AI) and BI use cases and build easy\-to\-use and scalable features. Build a robust and scalable systems.
* Collaborate with a team of engineers to develop techniques that improve system performance, efficiency, and scalability.
* Drive end\-to\-end ownership of critical components, from design and implementation to testing and optimization.
* Be an expert in BI domain. Foster an environment of continuous learning and knowledge sharing.
* Define key tech improvements, driving progress through innovation. Collaborate with cross\-functional, cross\-geo teams and stakeholders.

In this role, you’ll take ownership of the solution architecture for new and existing capabilities, working closely with product and engineering partners to turn business needs into secure, scalable, resilient, and high‑quality solutions.
   

  

 You’ll bring strong experience designing cloud‑based applications and data‑rich integrated systems, with a thoughtful approach to non‑functional requirements such as performance, security, reliability, and data integrity. As part of your day‑to‑day work, you’ll use AI‑assisted tools to support architectural analysis, accelerate design exploration, assess impacts, and improve documentation, while applying sound judgment and clear accountability to architectural decisions.
   

  

 Collaboration is central to this role. You’ll work alongside teams across Product, Engineering, CloudOps, Infrastructure, and Security to guide solutions from early design through delivery and evolution. You’ll also help teams adopt AI in practical, responsible ways, ensuring solutions are transparent, well‑governed, and aligned with customer trust and compliance expectations.
   

  

 At Vena, innovation is driven by a relentless focus on customer outcomes and continuous improvement. You’ll thrive here if you enjoy solving complex problems, working in a fast‑moving SaaS environment, and having a visible impact on both the product and the people building it.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
**Solution Architecture, Strategy \& Delivery:**
* Partner with Product Management and domain experts to define, own, and evolve the solution architecture and roadmap for a set of Acterys features and capabilities within a cloud‑based SaaS environment.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering teams to define pragmatic, well‑reasoned solution designs that balance functional needs with performance, security, scalability, and maintainability.
* Review and validate engineering designs and implementations to ensure alignment with approved solution architecture, architectural standards, and compliance requirements.
* Support delivery teams throughout the delivery lifecycle by helping resolve complex technical challenges, guiding refactoring efforts, and improving solution quality as requirements and constraints evolve.


**Research \& Continuous Improvement:**
* Stay informed of relevant industry trends, technologies, and architectural practices, evaluating opportunities to evolve solution patterns, blueprints, and delivery approaches.
* Leverage modern tooling, including AI‑assisted research and analysis, to support informed architectural decisions and continuous improvement. Architecture Communication \& Enablement:
* Maintain clear, accurate architecture artifacts and decision records, ensuring solutions are well understood and traceable across stakeholders.
* Proactively communicate architectural decisions and changes, while mentoring and supporting engineers through design reviews, working sessions, and ongoing knowledge sharing. Architecture Governance:
* Actively participate in architecture governance, contributing to the definition and application of standards, principles, policies, and best practices.
* Help ensure architectural decisions are consistent, well‑reasoned, and aligned with platform strategy, compliance expectations, and long‑term sustainability. Innovation \& Proof of Concept:
* Collaborate with cross‑functional stakeholders on proof‑of‑concept initiatives to explore new capabilities and support business cases for future features and enhancements.
* Contribute to a culture of innovation by helping teams experiment responsibly while maintaining architectural quality and customer trust.

Job Details
**1\. Role Summary** – BHIVE Group is looking for a Program Manager to plan, coordinate and deliver IT programs spanning infrastructure and network, cybersecurity, and ERP implementation. This is a program\-management role, not a technical specialist role — the focus is on driving delivery, not building solutions hands\-on. The successful candidate leads through people and process: orchestrating internal teams, vendors and stakeholders to deliver programs on time, within budget, and in line with BHIVE’s IT policies, SOPs and governance standards.


A working understanding of the IT domains involved is sufficient — enough to converse credibly with technical teams and vendors, ask the right questions, and make informed prioritisation and risk decisions. Deep, hands\-on expertise in networking, security or ERP configuration is not required; strong program\-management discipline is.


**2\. Key Responsibilities**


**Program Planning \& Delivery**


* Own end\-to\-end delivery of IT programs across infrastructure, network, cybersecurity and ERP — defining scope, schedule, budget, resourcing and success criteria.
* Build and maintain integrated program plans, milestones and roadmaps across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Drive execution to agreed timelines and budgets; proactively remove blockers and manage change requests through to sign\-off.
* Coordinate cutovers, go\-lives and rollouts across BHIVE sites, ensuring readiness and clean hand\-over to operations / support.

**Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**


* Act as the single point of coordination between business owners (Finance, HR, Operations), internal IT teams, and external vendors / system integrators.
* Manage vendor engagement — RFPs, SOWs, deliverables, SLAs and performance — and hold partners accountable to commitments.
* Run steering committees and status reviews; communicate progress, risks and decisions clearly to leadership and stakeholders.

**Risk, Budget \& Reporting**


* Maintain RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) and drive timely mitigation and escalation.
* Track program budgets and spend against approved plans; flag variances early and support forecasting.
* Produce dashboards and reports on program health, KPIs and milestones for the SVP – IT and leadership.

**Governance, Policies \& Documentation**


* Develop, maintain and enforce IT policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and process documentation across programs.
* Establish and run governance routines — change management, access reviews, asset and license/subscription governance, and vendor governance.
* Maintain an audit\-ready documentation repository (SharePoint) and support internal and external audits and compliance requirements.
* Ensure every program adheres to security and governance controls from initiation through closure.

**3\. Program Management Skills \& Competencies**


* **Planning:** Planning \& scheduling — building realistic plans, critical\-path and dependency management across parallel workstreams.
* **Stakeholders:** Stakeholder management — aligning cross\-functional teams, managing expectations and communicating with clarity at all levels.
* **Vendors:** Vendor \& contract management — RFPs, SOWs, negotiations, SLAs and holding partners to account.
* **Risk:** Risk \& issue management — identifying, quantifying, escalating and mitigating risks before they impact delivery.
* **Budget:** Budget \& financial tracking — cost control, forecasting and variance management.
* **Governance:** Governance \& documentation — policies, SOPs, audit readiness and disciplined record\-keeping.
* **Methods:** Methodologies \& tools — Waterfall / Agile / hybrid delivery; fluency with project\-tracking, reporting and collaboration tools.
* **Leadership:** Communication \& leadership — steering committees, status reporting, and influencing without authority.

**4\. Required Qualifications**


* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (IT / Engineering / Management preferred).
* **Experience:** 5\+ years in program / project management, ideally delivering IT or technology\-enabled programs.
* **Delivery:** Proven track record delivering multiple concurrent projects on time and within budget.
* **IT knowledge:** Working (not expert) understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity and ERP concepts — enough to lead technical teams and vendors effectively.
* **Governance:** Experience authoring policies, SOPs and governance documentation; comfortable in audit and compliance environments.
* **Soft skills:** Excellent communication, coordination, stakeholder\-management and documentation skills.

**5\. Preferred / Good to Have**


* Program / project management certification — PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM, or Agile / Scrum (CSM, PSM).
* Exposure to ITIL, or governance frameworks such as ISO 27001, in a coordination capacity.
* Familiarity with ZOHO, Microsoft 365, SharePoint and project\-tracking tools.

* Experience with job portals: Dice, Monster, CareerBuilder, LinkedIn Recruiter, TechFetch, Indeed
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills (voice\-heavy role)
* Ability to work independently under target pressure in a fast\-paced environment
* Knowledge of MS Office/Excel and applicant tracking systems (ATS)
* Prior experience in Bench Sales / US IT Staffing preferred

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline
* 1\+ years of proven bench sales experience with a track record of successful placements
* Existing vendor network is a strong plus

Compensation

Pay: ₹200,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


CFIN Functional Lead Architect **Your role and responsibilities:**


We are looking for an experienced and technically proficient Record to Report(R2R) Architect to lead the design, integration, and optimization of the R2R solutions within the Central Finance (CFIN) landscape. The R2R Architect will be responsible for ensuring that R2R processes are fully aligned with business needs, effectively integrated with other enterprise applications, and supported by automated solutions to enhance operational efficiency. This role involves close collaboration with various internal teams, including Finance, IS Architecture, and external vendors, to maintain and evolve the R2R architecture, ensuring it meets business requirements and is fully compliant with ABB's standards.


The work model for the role is: \#LI\-Onsite


This role is contributing to the Finance Services business Finance Process Data Systems division in Bangalore, India.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Solution Design \& Validation: Review and validate the design of all R2R solutions within the CFIN framework, ensuring they are aligned with business goals and technical requirements. Ownership of R2R Architecture: Define, document, and own the overall R2R architecture within the CFIN ecosystem, including technical components, modules, and integration with other applications.
* Maintain Solution Roadmap: Keep the target R2R solution architecture up\-to\-date, documenting changes to the roadmap and their impact on the broader enterprise architecture. Collaboration with Stakeholders: Work closely with the CFIN solution team, IS architects, vendors, and business stakeholders (including Finance, Process, Data, and Systems Finance teams) to configure, maintain, and enhance the CFIN landscape, ensuring business continuity.
* Business Process Alignment: Collaborate with R2R Global Process Owners (GPOs) and business teams to define and implement robust R2R solutions that align with business requirements and global best practices. Automation \& Innovation: Drive the regular implementation of automation solutions within the CFIN system to streamline R2R processes, reduce manual effort, and improve efficiency.
* Requirements Validation: Support the validation of business and functional requirements alongside Process Owners, FPDS team, and Technical Leads, ensuring processes are allocated to the appropriate applications and technologies.
* Compliance \& Standards: Ensure that all R2R solutions and work processes are compliant with ABB’s internal standards, policies, and regulatory requirements. Continuous Improvement: Maintain and enhance domain expertise in R2R and related technologies, keeping abreast of industry trends and ABB standards to drive continuous improvement within the organization.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Relevant certifications in FICO – SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN, or IT architecture. At least 7\-10 years of experience in s an R2R Architect, SAP Architect, or a similar role, with deep knowledge of R2R processes and system integration.
* Strong expertise in SAP CFIN (Central Finance), SAP S/4HANA, or other ERP systems, and experience with related modules. Familiarity with R2R process automation tools and strategies. In depth knowledge in Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation \& should have extensive knowledge in making Rules/Exposures \& locking down the complex scenario to make better ICMR capabilities with more futuristic visibility In depth knowledge in Balance sheet account reconciliation \& how this concept can help us to achieve wider view.
* Operational visibility based on Hyperion \& Financial Management \& reconciliations done on various levels In depth knowledge in global \& structural expertise level on FSVs: Financial statements. Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide cross\-functional teams. Excellent collaboration skills with the ability to coordinate between different stakeholders, including business leaders, technical teams, and external partners.
* A strong focus on continuous improvement and automation, with a passion for driving innovation within enterprise systems. Experience in managing relationships with external vendors and third\-party service providers to ensure the delivery of high\-quality solutions. Ability to adapt to a fast\-paced, dynamic work environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

**More about us:**


Finance Services is ABB’s shared services organization which delivers operational and expert services in Finance, with employees based in five main hubs and front offices, finance service provides mainly Business services to ABB teams across the globe as well as supports with external customer inquiries.


We value people from different backgrounds. Apply today for your next career step within ABB and visit www.abb.com to learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. \#MyABBStory

  

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.


Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.


View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home


For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how\-to\-apply/fraud\-warning

94bb3f68.title: Cybersecurity Architect
94bb3f68.description:
**Company Description**  

Every minute of every day, Smiths Detection’s threat detection and security screening technology helps to protect people and infrastructure, making the world a safer place.


Smiths Detection is a global leader in the development, manufacture and management of security and detection solutions designed to make the world a safer place. Our technology provides threat detection and screening solutions for customers in our key markets: aviation, ports and borders, defence, and urban security.


Our expertise spans 21 global offices, seven manufacturing sites and five R\&D centres, with a global network of 3,500 dedicated colleagues contributing towards over 40 years at the frontline of advances in safety and security.


This results in careers built on variety and the opportunity to work on a range of state\-of\-the\-art solutions, where you can develop your knowledge and experience every day.

 **Job Description**  

Job Purpose


We are seeking an experienced **Cybersecurity Architect** to drive the design, governance, and continuous improvement of enterprise security architecture across cloud, infrastructure, SaaS, and corporate technology environments.


Partnering closely with Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Engineering, and Digital teams, you will play a critical role in ensuring security is embedded into technology solutions, business initiatives, and digital transformation programs. You will provide strategic security guidance while balancing business objectives, regulatory requirements, and cyber risk.


Key Responsibilities

* Define and maintain enterprise cybersecurity architecture principles, standards, patterns, and reference architectures.
* Design and review secure solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.
* Conduct security architecture reviews, risk assessments, and threat modelling for new applications, cloud platforms, SaaS solutions, and technology initiatives.
* Collaborate with Architecture, Infrastructure, Engineering, and Product teams to ensure security is embedded throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Evaluate and recommend security controls aligned with business, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
* Assess third\-party vendors and SaaS platforms for security, compliance, and risk considerations.
* Design and advise on Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Microsoft Entra ID, and Zero Trust solutions.
* Establish cloud security guardrails covering identity, network security, data protection, monitoring, logging, and incident response.
* Provide security architecture guidance across endpoint security, data protection, and security operations capabilities.
* Stay ahead of emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry trends to strengthen the organization's security posture.

 **Qualifications**  

What You'll Bring

* Proven experience in Cybersecurity Architecture, Security Engineering, or Security Consulting roles.
* Strong expertise in cloud security architecture across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
* Experience conducting security reviews, architecture assessments, threat modelling, and risk analysis.
* Deep understanding of:
	+ Identity \& Access Management (IAM)
	+ Privileged Access Management (PAM)
	+ Microsoft Entra ID
	+ Zero Trust Architecture
	+ Network Security \& Segmentation
	+ Endpoint Security \& Data Protection
	+ Security Controls \& Risk Management
	+ Secure Development and DevSecOps practices
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate technical security risks into business\-focused recommendations.


Preferred Certifications

* CISSP
* CCSP
* TOGAF

  

**Additional Information**  

Join us and we’ll help build your career, with excellent training and opportunities for career growth across the business, both locally and globally. You’ll experience an inclusive environment, with strong leadership and a focus on safety and wellbeing. You’ll also have the flexibility to choose from a wide range of benefits to suit your lifestyle, offering you and your family support from a health and wellbeing, financial and lifestyle perspective.

**Join us and work for a world\-leader, with the benefits and training to reward your dedication and skills. Be part of a team where we are making the world a safer place.**


We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a company flourish. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, economic status, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are proud to be an inclusive company with values grounded in equality and ethics, where we celebrate, support, and embrace diversity.


At no time during the hiring process will Smiths Detection, nor any of our recruitment partners ever request payment to enable participation – including, but not limited to, interviews or testing. Avoid fraudulent requests by applying jobs directly through our career’s website.

Position Description  

Company Profile:  

Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.  

  

Job Title: ServiceNow Architect  

Position: Associate Consultant  

Experience: 12\+ Years  

Category: IT Infra  

Shift: US Shift  

Main location: Bangalore/Hyderabad  

Position ID: J0726\-1359  

Employment Type: Full Time  

Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 03 years of relevant experience.  

  

Job Description  

A skilled and experienced ServiceNow Developer/Architect to design, implement, and optimize solutions across multiple ServiceNow modules, including IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD), Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), Configuration Management Database (CMDB), Software Asset Management (SAM), Hardware Asset Management (HAM), Generative AI (Gen AI), and system integrations. This role requires a deep understanding of ServiceNow capabilities, best practices, and customization to align with business requirements and drive digital transformation.  

  

Key Responsibilities:  

  

1\. ITSM (IT Service Management): Configure and enhance core ITSM modules, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management. Develop custom workflows, automation, and integrations to improve IT service delivery. Collaborate with service owners to optimize user experience and process efficiency.  

2\. ITOM (IT Operations Management): Implement and optimize ITOM capabilities, including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and Orchestration. Enhance monitoring, alerting, and automated responses to improve service uptime and operational resilience. Integrate ITOM with existing infrastructure to support automated workflows and event\-driven responses.  

3\. HRSD (Human Resources Service Delivery): Configure and manage HR case management, employee self\-service portals, and knowledge management. Enable workflows to automate onboarding, offboarding, and other HR processes to streamline employee services. Collaborate with HR teams to ensure adherence to compliance, data privacy, and security standards.  

4\. GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance): Design and implement GRC workflows to support policy and compliance management, risk assessment, and audit tracking. Automate risk reporting, assessments, and governance processes to enhance regulatory compliance and risk mitigation. Integrate GRC with other systems for real\-time monitoring and reporting.  

5\. CMDB (Configuration Management Database): Develop, optimize, and maintain a robust CMDB to ensure accurate asset and service data. Implement CI relationships, manage CMDB health, and utilize the CSDM (Common Service Data Model). Support alignment of CMDB with ITSM and ITOM processes to ensure effective data consistency and utilization.  

6\. SAM (Software Asset Management) \& HAM (Hardware Asset Management): Manage SAM/HAM processes, including license compliance, software/hardware tracking, and audit readiness. Automate asset lifecycle management, optimize licensing, and reduce asset\-related risks. Integrate SAM/HAM with other modules to create an end\-to\-end asset management solution.  

7\. Generative AI (Gen AI): Utilize Gen AI capabilities to enhance ServiceNow modules, including virtual agent responses and predictive analysis. Integrate AI\-based automation to enhance self\-service, incident categorization, and resolution. Identify and apply AI\-driven insights to optimize workflows and reduce operational workloads.  

8\. Integrations: Design and implement integrations with third\-party systems and applications, including REST, SOAP, APIs, and custom integrations. Ensure secure, scalable, and reliable integrations that facilitate seamless data exchange across platforms. Troubleshoot integration issues and monitor performance to ensure minimal downtime.  

  

Qualifications:  

  

. Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field.  

. Experience: 12 \- 15 years of experience in ServiceNow Solution design, implementation, development and administration, with a deep understanding of multiple modules.  

. Certifications: Preferred certifications include ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (for ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, GRC), and experience with Integration Hub.  

. Technical Skills: Proficiency in JavaScript, ServiceNow Scripting, Flow Designer, REST/SOAP, and API integrations. Worked on solution designs  

. Soft Skills: Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills; ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders. Worked with client senior management.  

  

Additional Requirements:  

  

. Proven experience in ServiceNow customizations, workflow automation, and performance optimization.  

. Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.  

. Strong understanding of ITIL practices and frameworks, particularly for ITSM and ITOM modules.

1c2d5394.title: Senior Manager, Tech Delivery Lead
1c2d5394.description:
**Our Digital Transformation**


The Coca Cola Company is evolving into a more digital first, data driven enterprise to fuel sustainable growth, increase speed to market, and unlock new sources of value. Rapid advances in technology, data, and AI create a unique opportunity to accelerate The Coca\-Cola Company (TCCC) system’s next chapter of growth by reimagining our core competitive advantages. Building on a strong foundation of modernized infrastructure, global digital experiences, early data capabilities, and proven use cases, we are now shifting from early wins to scaled, end to end impact on growth, productivity, and efficiency. This next phase moves us from an analog world to a fully digitized one, powered by a digital growth engine that embeds data, technology, and AI into our most critical business domains. Success will require more than technology implementation, it demands a strategic transformation of core capabilities, a domain based, product centric operating model, and a cultural shift toward experimentation, data and technology fluency, and seamless partnership between business and digital teams.

**Role Overview**


The Senior Manager, Technology Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the successful delivery, deployment, and operationalization of enterprise digital products across the Operating Unit. This role serves as the technical delivery leader, partnering with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, and business stakeholders to ensure digital solutions are implemented, adopted, and optimized to deliver measurable business value. The role provides technical leadership throughout the product delivery lifecycle, overseeing solution implementation, market deployment, quality assurance, release management, and production readiness. Working closely with Global Digital Services, Operating Units, and bottling partners, the Technology Delivery Lead ensures global products are successfully localized where needed while maintaining alignment with enterprise architecture, engineering standards, and product roadmaps. Success in this role requires strong technical leadership, delivery management, stakeholder engagement, and the ability to bridge business priorities with engineering execution across a complex, global environment.

**What You will do for us**

* Lead the end\-to\-end technical delivery and deployment of enterprise digital products across the Operating Unit.
* Provide technical leadership for regional product implementations, ensuring solutions align with enterprise architecture, engineering standards, and business objectives.
* Partner with Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical delivery plans and implementation roadmaps.
* Analyze local business needs and identify regional configuration, localization, and feature enhancement requirements to maximize product adoption.
* Coordinate engineering, quality assurance, infrastructure, and operations teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable digital solutions.
* Oversee product validation, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and quality assurance activities to ensure successful product releases.
* Lead release planning, deployment management, production readiness, and post\-launch stabilization activities.
* Identify and proactively manage delivery risks, technical dependencies, and implementation issues across multiple initiatives.
* Partner with Global Digital Services, Operating Units, bottlers, and business stakeholders to ensure successful delivery, adoption, and business value realization.
* Monitor delivery performance, operational health, service quality, and user feedback to drive continuous improvement.
* Support Agile delivery practices, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release coordination across cross\-functional teams.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, automation opportunities, and engineering best practices to improve delivery efficiency and operational excellence.

**ORGANIZATIONAL IMPACT**

* Leads regional technology delivery for enterprise digital products that support strategic business priorities and transformation initiatives.
* Ensures consistent execution of delivery standards, quality practices, and release management processes across the Operating Unit.
* Improves product adoption, operational stability, and business value through effective implementation and stakeholder engagement.
* Partners with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, and business teams to accelerate successful product deployments.
* Influences delivery planning, implementation strategy, and operational readiness across multiple products and markets.
* Provides technical leadership to delivery teams while fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**INNOVATION \& COMPLEXITY**

* Solves complex implementation and delivery challenges involving enterprise platforms, multiple stakeholders, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Balances global product standards with regional business needs to ensure scalable and effective deployments.
* Drives continuous improvement in delivery processes, quality assurance, release management, and operational support.
* Leverages automation, DevSecOps, AI\-assisted delivery tools, and modern engineering practices to improve delivery speed and reliability.
* Resolves technical and operational issues while maintaining focus on business outcomes and customer experience.

**COMMUNICATION \& INFLUENCE**

* Partners with Product Managers, Engineering leaders, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders to align delivery priorities and execution plans.
* Communicates delivery status, implementation risks, dependencies, and business impacts to senior leadership.
* Facilitates cross\-functional planning sessions, release governance, and implementation reviews.
* Builds trusted relationships across Global Digital Services, Operating Units, bottlers, and external partners to drive successful implementations.
* Influences delivery decisions through technical expertise, structured problem\-solving, and a strong customer and business focus.

**Requirements and Qualifications Skills**

* 10–15\+ years of experience in technology delivery, software engineering, digital transformation, program management, or enterprise technology leadership.
* Proven experience delivering enterprise digital products across multiple markets, business functions, or geographies.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile delivery, DevSecOps, quality assurance, and release management.
* Experience working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated success managing complex implementations, technical dependencies, and cross\-functional delivery teams.
* Experience leading testing, deployment, production readiness, and post\-implementation support activities.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, enterprise applications, APIs, integration patterns, and modern software delivery practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management, executive communication, and structured problem\-solving skills.
* Experience within consumer products, manufacturing, supply chain, commercial, or global enterprise environments preferred.
* Expertise with Azure DevOps, Jira, Microsoft 365, project and portfolio management tools, and enterprise collaboration platforms.

**Candidate Profile**

A collaborative technology delivery leader with deep experience implementing enterprise digital products, managing complex technical programs, and partnering across business and engineering organizations. Combines strong technical knowledge with operational discipline to deliver scalable solutions that improve business performance and accelerate digital transformation. Recognized for leading cross\-functional teams, navigating complex stakeholder environments, and consistently delivering high\-quality technology solutions that achieve measurable business outcomes.

23e95328.title: Sr. Program Manager AI
23e95328.description:
**Job Description**
**Purpose of the Job**
 The purpose of the Senior Project Manager (AI Transformation) role is to work together with SBG leaders and AI evangelists in HTCS to implement and adopt AI tools across HTCS, and to lead a structured upskilling initiative that builds a strong AI culture, defines and enables key AI roles, and delivers role\-based AI trainings across all job levels. The role partners closely with SBG Engineering leaders, HR leaders, and cross\-functional stakeholders to translate the AI transformation roadmap into measurable business outcomes, sustainable operating rhythms, and scaled change adoption.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Principal Responsibilities**
 The principal responsibility is to plan, execute, and govern HTCS AI transformation initiatives by contributing in the following areas:
   

  

* Own and manage the HTCS AI Transformation program plan (scope, milestones, budget/benefits, dependencies, risks, and change impacts) and establish the governance cadence (steering committee, workstream reviews, and KPI reporting).
* Drive implementation and scaled adoption of priority AI tools within HTCS (e.g., copilots, knowledge assistants, automation, analytics/ML solutions), ensuring alignment to business problems, data/security requirements, and user needs.
* Build and maintain a prioritized AI use\-case portfolio with SBG Engineering and HTCS function leaders; define value hypotheses, success metrics, and realization tracking (productivity, quality, cycle time, cost, and user satisfaction).
* Lead the HTCS AI upskilling program end\-to\-end: training needs assessment, role\-based curricula, learning pathways, communications, learning logistics, completion tracking, and effectiveness measurement.
* Partner with HR/L\&D to define AI capability frameworks and key AI roles across HTCS (e.g., AI Product Owner, Citizen Developer, Prompt Engineer, Data Steward, AI Champion) and embed them into talent processes (hiring, onboarding, performance and career paths).
* Establish and run change management and communications to build AI culture (campaigns, showcases, communities of practice, office hours, playbooks, adoption toolkits) and drive engagement across all job levels.
* Coordinate cross\-functional readiness for AI deployments (IT, Cybersecurity, Legal, Data Privacy, Procurement, Finance) including access models, data governance, responsible AI controls, and operational support models.
* Develop standard processes and templates for AI use\-case intake, evaluation, delivery, and scaling (business case, data assessment, model/tool selection, validation, rollout, and sustainment).
* Facilitate alignment between HTCS and SBG Engineering leaders on priorities, resourcing, and decision\-making; prepare executive\-level materials (status, risks, decisions required, benefits realized).
* Track and report program health and adoption outcomes using dashboards (training completion, active users, usage patterns, NPS, productivity indicators) and drive corrective actions to ensure delivery.
* Ensure knowledge transfer and long\-term sustainment by establishing an AI community network, documenting standards, and enabling function owners to run AI tools and trainings as part of normal operations.


**Principal Networks \& Contact Links**
* HTCS leadership team and function leaders; SBG Engineering leaders; AI/Digital leaders and product owners.
* HR / L\&D leaders and training partners; change management and communications teams.
* IT, Cybersecurity, Legal, Data Privacy, Procurement, Finance, and other enabling functions supporting AI deployments.


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
* No direct reports; leads through influence in a matrix organization and coordinates cross\-functional workstreams (AI tools, training, change management, governance) to deliver outcomes.
* Ability to mobilize stakeholders, facilitate decision\-making, remove blockers, and ensure delivery across multiple sites and time zones.


**Geographic Scope \& Travel Requirements**
 The position is based out of Bangalore, India, and may require occasional travel to other HTCS and SBG Engineering locations globally as required.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Education Required**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline. Master’s degree (MBA/MS) is a plus.
* Project/Program Management certification (PMP/PRINCE2/Agile) preferred. AI/ML, data analytics, or cloud certifications are a strong advantage


**Work Experience Required**
 10\+ years of experience managing complex transformation programs and cross\-functional initiatives in a matrix environment, including strong exposure to digital/AI enablement, technology adoption, and organizational change.
   

  

**Experience Essential In**
* Program/project management for enterprise\-scale deployments (multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and workstreams).
* Driving adoption of technology products/tools (user journeys, change management, training enablement, and communications).
* Working knowledge of AI concepts and tooling (GenAI, copilots, prompt practices, automation, data/analytics), with the ability to translate between business and technical teams.
* Stakeholder management and executive communication, including steering committee facilitation and decision documentation.
* Operating in environments with strong governance expectations (data privacy, cybersecurity, compliance) and experience coordinating approvals and controls.
* Benefits realization and KPI tracking for transformation outcomes (productivity, quality, cycle time, cost, and user adoption).


**Experience Not Essential But Desirable**
* Experience with learning design/academy programs, communities of practice, or enterprise capability building initiatives.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Demonstrated delivery of digital/AI initiatives from concept through rollout, including adoption and sustainment.
* Strong facilitation and storytelling skills to simplify AI concepts for non\-technical audiences and influence leaders.
* Hands\-on proficiency with common productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., MS 365\) and familiarity with AI enablement tools/workflows.


**Behavioural Competencies Required**
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills – able to operate across functions, countries, and cultural boundaries.
* Should be able to demonstrate all Honeywell behaviours, specifically Act with Urgency, Think big and make it happen, Be courageous and inspire greatness


**Language Requirements**
* Must be able to effectively communicate in English


**About Us**
 Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

60939101.title: Java Solution Architect with Azure
60939101.description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Job Description**


We are seeking an experienced **Java Solution Architect** to lead the **re\-platforming and modernization** of mission\-critical **IBM DB2/Mainframe applications** onto **Microsoft Azure**. The role will drive target\-state architecture, application modernization, cloud\-native design, integration strategies, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code standards while ensuring scalable, secure, resilient, and business\-aligned solutions.


The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in **Java enterprise application architecture, Azure cloud platforms, legacy modernization, microservices transformation, and large\-scale re\-platforming initiatives**, with a proven track record of migrating monolithic and mainframe\-based systems to modern cloud\-native architectures.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Application Modernization \& Re\-platforming**

* Define the target architecture and modernization roadmap for migrating Mainframe/DB2 applications to Azure.
* Lead re\-platforming initiatives transforming legacy applications into cloud\-native, microservices\-based architectures.
* Define modernization patterns including decomposition, service extraction, API enablement, and event\-driven architectures.
* Balance business continuity, risk, scalability, cost, and operational efficiency during transformation programs.

**Java \& Microservices Architecture**

* Design enterprise\-grade solutions using **Java 21, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Spring Cloud, and RESTful APIs**.
* Define microservices architecture standards, domain boundaries, integration contracts, and service governance.
* Architect batch, real\-time, and event\-driven processing solutions.
* Design reusable frameworks, shared services, and engineering standards to accelerate modernization efforts.
* Establish best practices for application scalability, resiliency, fault tolerance, and performance optimization.

**Azure Cloud Architecture**

* Architect cloud\-native solutions leveraging Azure services including:
	+ AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service) and Docker
	+ Azure Functions
	+ API Management
	+ Azure Data Factory
	+ Event Hub / Service Bus
	+ Azure Storage Services
* Design **hybrid integration patterns between mainframe and Azure environments**.
* Establish cloud architecture standards covering security, scalability, observability, and operational excellence.

**DevOps, Automation \& Infrastructure**

* Define and implement **Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform (Mandatory)**.
* Working knowledge of integrating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.
* Establish DevSecOps practices including automated testing, security scanning, deployment automation, and monitoring.
* Drive cloud cost optimization and operational efficiency initiatives.

**Technology Leadership \& AI Adoption**

* Provide architecture leadership, governance, and technical direction across modernization programs.
* Conduct architecture reviews, design assessments, and technology evaluations.
* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted software engineering and architecture practices.
* Evaluate and integrate AI/GenAI capabilities to improve developer productivity, operational automation, and business outcomes.
* Ensure responsible, secure, and compliant adoption of AI technologies.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* **14\+ years of experience** in Solution Architecture, Application Architecture, or Enterprise Architecture.
* **Strong experience leading large\-scale application re\-platforming and modernization programs.**
* Expert\-level experience in:
	+ Java 21
	+ Spring Boot
	+ Spring Batch
	+ Spring Cloud
	+ Microservices Architecture
	+ API Design \& Integration
* Extensive experience migrating applications from:
	+ Monolithic to Microservices
	+ On\-Premises to Azure
* Deep expertise in Azure cloud architecture and platform services.
* Hands\-on expertise with **Terraform (Mandatory)** and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Strong experience with:
	+ Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions
	+ Kubernetes (AKS preferred) and Docker
	+ CI/CD Architecture
	+ DevSecOps
* Experience with:
	+ Event\-driven architectures
	+ Kafka / Event Hub
	+ Service Bus
	+ CDC and Data Synchronization
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, resiliency, and cloud\-native design patterns.
* Experience working with DB2, PostgreSQL, and enterprise data integration patterns.
* Demonstrated experience leveraging AI/GenAI technologies in software engineering, architecture, or modernization initiatives.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  



  

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

  

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

* Design and deliver end\-to\-end technical solutions on the Shakudo platform that address real\-world data and AI challenges for enterprise customers

* Build elegant, production\-ready solutions — not just proof\-of\-concepts — that customers rely on in production
* Contribute to architectural decisions and establish design patterns for platform development with high autonomy
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor for assigned accounts — understand their infrastructure, roadmap, and pain points deeply
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues customers face in their data and AI stack, from Kubernetes orchestration to pipeline performance
* Identify opportunities to expand Shakudo's footprint within existing accounts by connecting customer needs to platform capabilities
* Navigate customer organizations effectively — from individual contributors to engineering leaders and C\-suite decision\-makers
* Champion customer needs internally, influencing product direction and Stack team priorities
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to translate customer requirements into scalable, robust systems
* Collaborate with Customer Engineering to ensure smooth hand\-offs and consistent solution quality
* Contribute to internal knowledge bases, solution patterns, and best practices that accelerate delivery across the team



  





**Qualifications** 



* 4–8 years of experience in solution engineering, solution architecture, or a senior engineering role with significant client\-facing responsibility
* Strong Kubernetes and Helm Chart development and deployment experience
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code
* Backend and frontend experience (e.g., Python, React, TypeScript) — enough to be hands\-on when needed
* Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships, solve complex technical problems under pressure, and drive account growth
* Excellent communication skills — you can explain deep technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and translate business requirements into architecture
* A hands\-on, solutions\-first mindset and a passion for fast, high\-quality delivery
* A Plus
* Experience in data engineering, MLOps, or AI infrastructure
* Prior experience in a Solutions Architect or Solutions Engineer role at a B2B infrastructure or platform company
* Familiarity with the open\-source data and AI ecosystem (dbt, Airflow, MLflow, etc.)



  





**Why Shakudo Stands Out** 




  




* Work with cutting\-edge technologies in machine learning and high\-performance computing
* Contribute to a platform that transforms how organizations leverage data and AI
* Join a dynamic team that values innovation, efficiency, and diversity



  





  





 This is a work from office role based out of Bangalore (HSR Layout).
