**Req ID:** 383210
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Sr. AI Architect to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
  
  

Business Domain Architect – Manufacturing
  
  

Senior domain architect with 13\+ years experience combining deep business domain expertise with cloud (AWS, Azure), data, AI and agentic AI architecture. Strong AWS Azure Architecture experience with working knowledge in GCP.
  
  

**Locations:** Bangalore (but any location is Fine) Mode: Hybrid / client\-facing Primary cloud: Azure \+ AWS; GCP working knowledge Domain focus: Smart manufacturing, OT/IT, supply chain
  
  

**ROLE PURPOSE:** Own business and technology architecture for manufacturing transformation across shop floor, supply chain, quality, maintenance, engineering and aftermarket. Translate manufacturing strategy into scalable, secure and value\-driven cloud, data, AI and agentic AI architectures.
  
Define reusable patterns for smart factories, predictive maintenance, quality analytics, production optimization, supply chain control towers, digital thread, digital twins and agentic AI copilots
  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES MUST\-HAVE EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS
  
  

* Demonstrate strong knowledge of manufacturing capabilities across plan, source, make, deliver, maintain and service value streams, and use this knowledge to shape current\-state and target\-state capability maps.
* Advise on manufacturing transformation initiatives, including smart factories, plant modernization, asset performance, predictive maintenance, quality analytics and supply chain control towers.
* Provide manufacturing\-domain architectural guidance for Azure and AWS solutions supporting data platforms, IoT and edge, APIs and events, microservices, security, reliability, observability and FinOps, without necessarily being responsible for hands\-on engineering or platform configuration.
* Define and guide secure OT/IT integration patterns across ERP, MES, PLM, QMS, EAM, SCM, historian and time\-series platforms, SCADA/PLC environments and industrial connectivity layers.
* Identify and shape AI and agentic AI use cases relevant to manufacturing, such as maintenance copilots, production\-planning agents, root\-cause analysis agents, supplier\-risk assistants and enterprise knowledge search.
* Understand and guide the application of RAG, vector search, tool use, human\-in\-the\-loop review, prompt and policy controls, evaluation, monitoring, responsible AI and data governance within manufacturing environments.
* Lead domain\-focused workshops with plant operations, engineering, quality, supply chain, CIO, CTO and COO stakeholders, enterprise architects, delivery teams and vendors across India and Portugal.
* Provide architectural oversight through reference architectures, architecture decision records, non\-functional requirements, risk reviews, vendor assessments and governance forums.
* Work closely with cloud, data, application, security, OT and AI engineering teams that are responsible for detailed design, development, configuration and implementation.
* 13\+ years in technology/consulting, including 5\+ years in architecture and 5\+ years in manufacturing domain programs.
* Deep manufacturing knowledge: discrete/process/hybrid manufacturing, Industry 4\.0, ISA\-95 concepts, OEE, quality, maintenance and supply chain operations.
* Hands\-on architecture depth in Azure and AWS; practical familiarity with GCP, hybrid cloud, identity, network, security, data and integration services.
* Strong command of cloud\-native patterns: container/serverless, APIs, events, lakehouse/warehouse, streaming, edge/IoT and integration platforms.
* Good AI and agentic AI architecture know\-how: LLMs, RAG, multi\-agent orchestration, vector databases, LLMOps/GenAIOps, guardrails and model risk.
* Ability to convert business outcomes into target architecture, transition states, investment roadmap and delivery backlog.
* Excellent English communication; able to work with India and Europe teams with CET/IST overlap

* Azure Data Factory / Event Hubs / Stream Analytics patterns
* Azure Digital Twins / Fabric Digital Twin Builder concepts

* Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI / Foundry Local concepts
* Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel, Azure Functions and Logic Apps integration
* RAG, agent orchestration, prompt/version control and evaluation
* Computer vision for quality and safety use cases
* Human approval, action policy and business workflow integration Strong / Working / Awareness / Gap


Security, governance and operations
  
* Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC and managed identities
* Key Vault, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Azure Policy
* Purview for data governance, lineage and classification
* Azure Monitor / App Insights for observability Strong / Working / Awareness / Gap


AWS
  
Capability Area Candidate should know Check
  
Manufacturing platform data • AWS IoT SiteWise / SiteWise Edge for industrial data
  
* S3 data lake, Glue Data Catalog, Lake Formation governance
* Amazon Timestream / Kinesis / Managed Flink for time\-series and streaming Strong / Working / Awarenes / Gap


IoT, edge and hybrid • AWS IoT Core, Greengrass, Shop Floor Connectivity Framework
  
* Industrial protocol ingestion with partner connectors Strong / Working / Awareness / Gap

* Amazon Bedrock for foundation models and agents
* Amazon SageMaker AI for model build/train/deploy and MLOps
* Computer vision / anomaly detection use cases at edge
* Semantic search and governed data access for RAG
* Agentic workflows for maintenance, supply chain, quality and engineering Strong / Working / Awareness / Gap


Security, governance and operations

* VPC, PrivateLink, hybrid networking and landing zones
* CloudWatch, CloudTrail and Config monitoring
* Policy\-based access, data lineage and cross\-domain governance Strong / Working / Awareness / Gap


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
* Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* AWS Solutions Architect Professional
* Google Professional Cloud Architect
* TOGAF/Business Architecture and exposure to ISA/IEC 62443 or industrial cybersecurity
* MBA, Industrial Engineering or Operations background is useful.


About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. 674016a4.title: Senior Program Manager – Enterprise Portfolio Delivery
674016a4.description:
**Date Posted:**
 2026\-08\-05
   

  

**Country:**
 India
   

  

**Location:**
 IN\-KA\-BENGALURU\-NORTHGATE \~ Sy No 2/2 Venkatala Village \~ SY NO 2/2 VENKATALA VILLAGE, Yelahanka Hobli
   

  

**Position Role Type:**
 Hybrid
   

  

 At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.
   

  

 Pratt \& Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.
   

  

 Location: Bangalore, India
   

  

 Function: Digital Technology (Global PMO)
   

  

 Reports To: Director / Head of Global PMO
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Technology Program Manager to lead complex, enterprise\-wide technology programs supporting strategic business initiatives across a global organization. This role is responsible for driving end\-to\-end program delivery while ensuring alignment with portfolio priorities, governance standards, and business objectives.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of technical program management, portfolio leadership, Agile delivery, and enterprise governance, with significant hands\-on experience using Planview as an enterprise portfolio management (PPM) platform. This individual will work closely with executives, business leaders, product organizations, architects, engineering teams, and PMO leadership to deliver predictable, high\-quality outcomes across globally distributed teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Enterprise Program Leadership
* Lead multiple, large\-scale cross\-functional technology programs from initiation through successful delivery.
* Develop integrated program plans, manage schedules, budgets, risks, dependencies, and key milestones.
* Ensure programs align with enterprise strategy, governance frameworks, and organizational priorities.
* Drive delivery excellence across multiple concurrent initiatives while balancing competing business demands.
* Portfolio \& Planview Leadership
* Leverage Planview to manage portfolio planning, demand intake, resource planning, financial tracking, roadmaps, and executive reporting.
* Ensure high\-quality portfolio data by promoting governance, data integrity, and standardized planning practices.
* Support portfolio prioritization, investment decisions, and capacity planning through Planview insights and analytics.
* Partner with Portfolio Managers and PMO leadership to improve portfolio visibility and delivery predictability.
* Champion adoption and continuous improvement of enterprise portfolio management processes and tools.
* Technical Program Management
* Coordinate complex technology initiatives involving multiple delivery teams, business functions, vendors, and technical stakeholders.
* Facilitate technical planning, dependency management, release coordination, and implementation readiness.
* Work closely with Solution Architects, Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and Delivery Leads to remove delivery impediments and mitigate risks.
* Drive issue resolution through proactive decision\-making and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Agile Delivery Leadership
* Lead programs using Agile, Hybrid, and traditional delivery methodologies based on program needs.
* Partner with Product Managers, Scrum Masters, and Release Train Engineers to improve delivery cadence and execution.
* Drive PI Planning, roadmap alignment, dependency management, backlog governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Promote Agile best practices while maintaining enterprise governance and delivery discipline.
* Executive \& Stakeholder Management
* Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology leaders across global organizations.
* Prepare and present executive\-level dashboards, program updates, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations.
* Lead governance forums, steering committees, and executive reviews with confidence and professionalism.
* Influence decision\-making across multiple organizations without direct authority.
* Global Delivery \& Vendor Management
* Lead globally distributed teams across North America, Europe, India, and other regions.
* Coordinate internal teams and external delivery partners to ensure successful program execution.
* Monitor vendor performance, delivery quality, and adherence to contractual commitments and organizational standards.
* Governance, Risk \& Financial Management
* Manage program financials, forecasting, resource utilization, and budget performance.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate program risks while proactively managing cross\-program dependencies.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise governance, audit, security, and PMO standards.
* Drive lessons learned and continuous improvement across the program portfolio.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline (Master's degree or MBA preferred).
* 10\+ years of progressive experience leading complex technology programs and enterprise initiatives.
* Proven experience managing enterprise portfolios and strategic technology programs within large global organizations.
* Hands\-on experience with Planview (Portfolios, Enterprise One, or equivalent) supporting demand management, portfolio planning, resource management, financial tracking, reporting, and governance.
* Experience working directly with North American (onshore) business stakeholders and executive leadership teams.
* Strong experience leading globally distributed delivery teams across multiple regions and time zones.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent programs with significant organizational impact.
* Strong understanding of enterprise technology landscapes, digital transformation, and software delivery lifecycle.
* Extensive experience delivering initiatives using Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Hybrid, and traditional project management methodologies.
* Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, negotiation, and executive stakeholder management skills.


**What We Offer:**
 Daycare for young children
   

  

 Advancement programs to enhance education skills
   

  

 Flexible work schedules
   

  

 Leadership and training programs
   

  

 Comprehensive benefits, savings, and pension plans
   

  

 Financial support for parental leave
   

  

 Reward programs for outstanding work
   

  

**Role type** 
 :
   

  

 Please ensure the role type (defined below) is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role.
   

  

**Hybrid:** 
 Employees who are working in Hybrid roles will work regularly both onsite and offsite. Ratio of time working onsite will be determined in partnership with your leader.
   

  

**Employment Type:**
* Full\-time
* This role requires flexibility to work outside regular business hours, including supporting U.S. time zones, based on business needs

61bb9093.title: Program Manager – AI Transformation & Change
61bb9093.description:
⚡We are your
 **Energy Technology Partner** 
 . We electrify, automate, and digitalize every industry, business, and home, driving efficiency and sustainability for all.
   

  

 At Schneider Electric, our values – IMPACT (Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork) – are the foundation of everything we do. Becoming an Impact Maker means turning sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization.
   

  

 Are you ready to lead the digital transformation to create a more sustainable world?🌳
   

  

 If you are up to challenge your creativity and make an impact, we are excited to welcome you!
   

  

**Schneider Digital** 
 is the digital department of Schneider Electric, leading the digital transformation in the company by giving support globally to our internal teams and our clients. Schneider Digital consists of 6 Digital Hubs worldwide which are strategically located to ensure a 24/7 support across the company (France, China, India, USA, Mexico and Spain). Our Digital Hub in Barcelona is formed by \+450 employees working in strategic projects and different roles such as Data, Cybersecurity, ERP, Cloud, Infrastructures, IT Project Management or Digital Marketing.
   

  

 DCR is the digital backbone of Schneider Electric, representing \~1,200 FTEs and FTCs across eight capability domains. As AI is projected to reshape every DCR role, The DCR AI Operations team has been established to stand up a governed programme that turns the AI vision into measurable delivery across all DCR capabilities.
   

  

 Phase 2 of the programme (H2 2026\) focuses on building the foundation: establishing governance structures, validating priority use cases through live pilots, and preparing the organisation for full\-scale deployment in Phase 3\. The Transformation \& Change stream is the backbone of this phase — responsible for programme governance, use case portfolio management, process reinvention, and capability upskilling across all domains.
   

  

 In this context, the
 **Program Manager** 
 is the operational lead of the Transformation stream and the central orchestrator of the overall programme, translating strategic intent into a governed and deliverable roadmap.
   

  

**What will you do?**
**Key Responsibilities**
 The Program Manager leads the Transformation stream and orchestrates the end\-to\-end programme.
   

  

 Scope: Transformation \& Change \| Value Realization \| Solution Design \| AI Delivery
   

  

* Set up the programme operating model \& governance – Programme leadership role
* Define the end\-to\-end programme operating model: roles, decision rights, RACI matrix, and organisational design.
* Establish and chair the governance cadence, from operational syncs to executive steering committees, ensuring appropriate escalation paths and decision clarity.
* Define programme\-level KPIs aligned to the value framework; drive delivery against H2 2026 milestones (operating model set\-up, pilot selection, reinvention vision, upskilling strategy).
* Coordinate the AI use case portfolio \& stakeholder alignment – Orchestration role
* Lead the review and prioritisation of the AI use case portfolio with the AI Hub, scoring and shortlisting the highest\-value cases from the 120\-case inventory.
* Manage cross\-functional interdependencies across all workstreams, proactively resolving conflicts, blockers, and resource constraints before they impact delivery.
* Build trusted relationships with DCR domain SPOCs, BU VPs, and capability leaders; act as the communication bridge between programme execution and executive leadership.
* Drive programme delivery \& enable pilot execution – Execution management role
* Oversee the delivery plan across Foundation Setup (Q3 2026\), Pilot Validation (Q4 2026–Q1 2027\), and Deployment Readiness at scale (2027\+).
* Coordinate end\-to\-end pilot execution across all workstreams, from scoping through results capture and lessons\-learned consolidation into Phase 3 playbooks.
* Activate staffing for priority open roles; lead the development of operating model documentation, decision frameworks, and reusable playbooks for Phase 3 scaling.


**What qualifications will make you successful?**
**Qualifications:**
* Business or Engineering Degree
* 10\+ years in Programme/Project Management, Digital Transformation, or Technology Consulting
* Demonstrated track record of setting up and running complex, multi\-workstream programmes in a large, matrixed organisation
* Experience in AI, automation, or digital platform adoption programmes is strongly preferred
* Strong familiarity with governance frameworks, organisational design, and change management principles
* Ability to operate across multiple levels — from programme strategy to hands\-on delivery coordination — in a fast\-moving environment
* Multicultural, international environment experience strongly preferred


**Skills:**
* Strategic vision and executive\-level storytelling
* Governance and operating model design
* Structured problem\-solving with analytical rigour
* Risk management, conflict resolution, and decision facilitation
* Fluent in English; additional languages a plus


**What will you get?**
 We adapt to you:
   

  

 🕓 With our flexible schedule, you'll have the freedom to adjust your work hours to accommodate your personal needs and responsibilities.
   

  

 💻 We know how great it is to work from home. With our hybrid work plan, you can enjoy working from the comfort of your home.
   

  

 🏝 Need more time to relax and disconnect? With our Holy Pack, you can purchase additional vacation days to recharge when you need it most.
   

  

 📅 Celebrate holidays your way! With Floating Holidays, you can exchange holidays for other days that better suit your plans and personal preferences.
   

  

 🧘‍Need additional time to explore new experiences or focus on personal projects? With the Sabbatical Pack, you can request up to 2 months of extra leave (unpaid).
   

  

 💞 We value the importance of family and want to support you in all aspects of your life. Our Global Family Leave Policy provides flexible paid conditions for when you need it most, whether you're about to be a parent, need time to overcome a loss, or to care for a loved one.
   

  

 We take care of you:
   

  

 📱 With access to the health and wellness platform Wellwo, you and up to 5 people of your choice can enjoy access to wellness content, nutrition counseling, fitness classes, and more!
   

  

 🏄‍From dance classes to booking a hotel spa, we offer an agreement with Wellhub so you can access a network of thousands of gyms and sports centers to keep your body active in the way you like best.
   

  

 🩺 Your well\-being is our priority. You will have medical service at your workplace for close attention to any medical needs.
   

  

 We empower you:
   

  

 🎯 With Career Hub, our AI\-driven professional development platform, you can connect with job opportunities, projects, and mentors at Schneider Electric globally.
   

  

 🤑 We offer you the opportunity to be a shareholder of Schneider Electric and share in our achievements with our stock ownership program.
   

  

 🙌 We celebrate everyone's talent and success with our recognition program, through which you can give and receive points for your achievements and redeem them for gift cards at your favorite stores.
   

  

 💗 You will have life insurance for your protection.
   

  

 💰 We offer you a Flexible Remuneration Plan in which you can choose from a variety of options, such as health insurance, meal vouchers, childcare vouchers, transportation vouchers, training, and more.
   

  

 🎁 With Club Schneider, you will enjoy special discounts at your favorite stores, restaurants, travel agencies, and other external services.
   

  

 💚 Participate in company\-subsidized volunteer programs to contribute to our community and have a positive impact on your environment.
   

  

 Bring your expertise to a team that's ready to achieve great things together — apply today!
   

  

 Grade 9
   

  

**Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?**
 When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.
   

  

 IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.
   

  

 We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.
   

  

 Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!
   

  

 €40 billion global revenue
   

  

 \+9% organic growth
   

  

 150 000\+ employees in 100\+ countries
   

  

 You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled.
   

  

*Schneider Electric aspires to be the most inclusive and caring company in the world, by providing equitable opportunities to everyone, everywhere, and ensuring all employees feel uniquely valued and safe to contribute their best. We mirror the diversity of the communities in which we operate, and ‘inclusion’ is one of our core values. We believe our differences make us stronger as a company and as individuals and we are committed to championing inclusivity in everything we do.*
*At Schneider Electric, we uphold the highest standards of ethics and compliance, and we believe that trust is a foundational value. Our Trust Charter is our Code of Conduct and demonstrates our commitment to ethics, safety, sustainability, quality and cybersecurity, underpinning every aspect of our business and our willingness to behave and respond respectfully and in good faith to all our stakeholders. You can find out more about our Trust Charter here*

**Job Description:**
**The Future Begins Here:**
 At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future\-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.
   

  

 Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. Your role will be pivotal in driving innovation and operational excellence including day to day delivery and requires a strong technical background, leadership abilities, and a strategic mindset to drive the project to success. You will establish and enforce best practices, lead the delivery of scalable and secure solutions, and ensure that the execution aligns with critical project/business objectives. You will also be instrumental in fostering a culture of technical and engineering proficiency, mentoring a team of software developers and data engineers. Collaborating closely with business stakeholders and global leadership, you will ensure that the team’s efforts enhance business capabilities and drive forward the strategic goals of PDT as well as Takeda. 221f953f.title: Senior SAFe Program Manager / Release Train Engineer
221f953f.description:
**About Amgen**
 Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients
   

  

 At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas—Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease—we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines that help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science\-based. If you have a passion for solving complex problems, enabling high\-performing teams, and driving meaningful business outcomes, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team.
   

  

 Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 Role Description
   

  

 The Senior SAFe Program Manager / Release Train Engineer is a strategic Lean\-Agile leader responsible for enabling successful execution across one or more Agile Release Trains (ARTs). This role partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Business stakeholders, and leadership teams to deliver high\-value digital solutions while fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and execution excellence.
   

  

 As a servant leader, coach, and facilitator, the Senior RTE helps teams achieve higher levels of Agile maturity by facilitating Program Increment (PI) execution, managing cross\-team dependencies, mitigating risks, and ensuring alignment between strategic priorities and delivery outcomes. The role also plays a key part in driving Lean\-Agile transformation, coaching leaders and teams, and continuously improving delivery practices across the organization.
   

  

 This position benefits from expertise in biopharma R\&D domains and enterprise informatics solution delivery. Success in this role requires extensive collaboration with global teams, strong experience across the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle, and the ability to influence without authority within a highly matrixed organization.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and facilitate Agile Release Train (ART) execution using SAFe principles and Lean\-Agile practices.
* Drive successful planning and execution of Program Increment (PI) Planning, Scrum of Scrums, Inspect \& Adapt workshops, Solution Demos, and other ART ceremonies.
* Partner with Product Management, Product Owners, Engineering, Architecture, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment between strategic priorities and execution.
* Enable predictable, high\-quality delivery by improving flow, removing impediments, managing risks, and resolving cross\-team dependencies.
* Coach Scrum Masters, Agile teams, Product Managers, and leaders to continuously improve Agile maturity and delivery effectiveness.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement through retrospectives, data\-driven decision making, innovation, and Lean thinking.
* Monitor ART health using delivery metrics and Agile performance indicators, providing transparent reporting and actionable insights to leadership.
* Drive execution of strategic portfolio initiatives across multiple cross\-functional teams while balancing business priorities and organizational objectives.
* Facilitate collaboration across globally distributed teams to ensure seamless delivery and operational excellence.
* Manage and optimize the flow of value through the Agile Release Train using tools such as Program Kanban, Jira, Jira Align, Confluence, and other Agile information radiators.
* Coordinate with support, operations, and service teams to ensure successful product releases and issue resolution.
* Lead organizational readiness activities for PI Planning, including stakeholder alignment, dependency management, communication, and planning logistics.
* Champion Lean\-Agile transformation by coaching leaders and influencing organizational change that improves execution and business outcomes.
* Support continuous evolution of Agile delivery practices, governance models, and operational excellence across the organization.


 What we expect of you
   

  

 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Biotechnology, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 12–17 years of experience in software delivery, Agile program management, product delivery, or related technology leadership roles.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

* Strong expertise in Agile methodologies, particularly the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).
* Experience serving as a Release Train Engineer, Agile Program Manager, Scrum Master, or similar enterprise Agile leadership role.
* Proven experience facilitating PI Planning and other SAFe events across multiple Agile teams.
* Strong understanding of Agile software delivery and the end\-to\-end Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
* Hands\-on experience with Jira, Jira Align, Confluence, and Agile planning/reporting tools.
* Experience identifying, managing, and resolving cross\-team dependencies, risks, and impediments.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence leaders and teams across a global matrix organization.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, facilitation, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to coach teams and leaders while driving continuous improvement and organizational agility.
* Demonstrated experience managing data\-focused projects, including initiatives involving data platforms, data integration, analytics, or data transformation.
* Provide people leadership by coaching, mentoring, and developing team members, fostering a high\-performing, collaborative, and accountable culture while supporting individual growth and organizational objectives.


 Good\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

* Experience within biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated industries.
* Understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD, and Test Automation.
* Experience supporting enterprise portfolio planning and Lean Portfolio Management.
* Workshop facilitation, organizational change management, and Agile transformation experience.


 Professional Certifications
   

  

 Preferred certifications include:
   

  

* Certified SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE)
* SAFe Program Consultant (SPC)
* PMI Project Management Professional (PMP)
* Certified Scrum Professional (CSP) or equivalent Agile certification


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Strong servant leadership and coaching mindset.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to influence without authority across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Strong collaboration and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strategic thinking with a strong focus on execution and business outcomes.
* Commitment to continuous learning and continuous improvement.


 What you can expect of us
   

  

 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well\-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we'll support your journey every step of the way.
   

  

 In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans aligned with local market practices.

7e31d05b.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – Retail & AI Solutions
7e31d05b.description:
**About the Role**

Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are senior engineers who embed directly with our retail clients to scope, build, and ship production software — not demos, not proofs\-of\-concept. You will sit with the client’s business and technology teams, translate ambiguous business problems into working systems, and own what you build from first deployment through stabilization.

This is a hands\-on engineering role with a consultant’s context: you will spend part of your week in discovery conversations with merchandising, store operations, e\-commerce, and supply chain stakeholders, and the rest writing production\-grade code that solves what you heard. AI is central to how we deliver — you will build LLM\-powered features and agentic workflows, and you will use AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code as a core part of your daily engineering practice.

*This is not a pre\-sales or demo role. There is no sales quota. Success is measured by working software in the client’s production environment and the business outcomes it drives.*

**What You Will Do**

* **Discover and scope:** Embed with retail client teams to understand the real business problem beneath the stated ask — across areas such as e\-commerce, POS, order management, inventory, pricing/promotions, and supply chain — and define solutions where no spec exists.
* **Build production software:** Design and ship full\-stack applications and services (Angular front ends, Node.js/TypeScript back ends, REST/GraphQL APIs) inside or integrated with the client’s environment.
* **Engineer AI solutions:** Build LLM\-powered features — retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, tool/function calling, prompt pipelines — and take them from prototype to production with proper evaluation, guardrails, and monitoring.
* **Work AI\-natively:** Use Claude Code and similar AI\-assisted development tools to compress delivery timelines, and help client engineering teams adopt these practices effectively and safely.
* **Integrate with enterprise systems:** Connect to the client’s existing landscape — commerce platforms, ERP/OMS/WMS, POS, data warehouses, identity/SSO — and navigate security, compliance, and change\-management processes.
* **Own what you ship:** Handle deployment, monitoring, incident response, and iteration after go\-live; stabilize and improve rather than hand off and leave.
* **Close the loop:** Feed field learnings back into our delivery playbooks, reusable assets, and product/solution roadmap.

**Must\-Have Qualifications**

* 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and operating production systems end\-to\-end (not only feature work within a large team).
* Strong full\-stack skills: Angular (or a comparable modern SPA framework with willingness to work in Angular) and Node.js/TypeScript, plus solid fundamentals in API design, SQL/NoSQL data modeling, and testing.
* Hands\-on AI engineering experience: you have built and shipped at least one real LLM\-powered application or workflow (RAG, agents, tool calling, prompt engineering, evals) — beyond tutorials or personal experiments.
* Working fluency with AI\-assisted development — Claude Code, or equivalent agentic coding tools — and sound judgment about where they accelerate work and where they need human review.
* Retail domain exposure: you have delivered software for retail or consumer commerce businesses and can speak the language of at least one area — e\-commerce, stores/POS, order management, inventory, pricing, or supply chain.
* Client\-facing strength: experience working directly with business stakeholders, comfort presenting and defending technical decisions, and the ability to operate with incomplete information.
* Cloud deployment experience on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including CI/CD and basic observability.
* Willingness to work onsite at client locations, with travel as required by the engagement.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with the Anthropic API / Claude models, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or agent frameworks such as LangGraph or the Claude Agent SDK.
* Python for data and AI workloads; exposure to data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks) and pipeline tooling.
* Direct experience with retail platforms and systems — e.g., commerce platforms (Salesforce Commerce, Shopify, commercetools), SAP or other ERPs, OMS/WMS, or POS systems.
* Prior consulting, professional services, or startup experience where you owned outcomes rather than tickets.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading small delivery pods.

**Who Thrives in This Role**

FDEs are generalists with depth: engineers who are energized by ambiguity, get satisfaction from seeing their software used by real businesses within weeks, and are comfortable being the technical face of the company at a client site. If you prefer a fixed backlog, a single codebase, and minimal stakeholder contact, this role is probably not the right fit — and that’s okay.

**Why VirtuosicTechnologies**

* Work at the intersection of retail and applied AI, on problems where your code visibly moves business metrics.
* An AI\-native engineering culture: Claude Code and agentic tooling are part of how we build, not an afterthought.
* High ownership and fast feedback loops — you scope it, you build it, you run it.
* A pathway to senior client\-facing technical leadership (Principal FDE / Engagement Architect).

Pay: ₹3,500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Solution Architects to help the world’s best engineering organizations figure out what AI\-native software development actually looks like in production.
   

  

 This is a deeply technical, post\-sale role embedded inside Cursor’s most strategic enterprise accounts. You’ll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high\-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI.
   

  

 Solution Architects sit at the center of long\-term customer transformation. You’ll help customers move from initial excitement to deeply integrating engineering workflows that teams rely on every day. That means understanding how modern software organizations operate, identifying where Cursor can create the most leverage, and helping customers scale adoption across teams, platforms, and workflows over time.
   

  

 This role is highly hands\-on. 34f8aebf.title: Software Engineering Manager, Looker, Google Cloud
34f8aebf.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C\+\+, Java, JavaScript).
* 5 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
* 5 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.
* 2 years of experience with GenAI techniques (e.g., LLMs, multi\-modal, large vision models) or with GenAI\-related concepts (e.g., language modeling, computer vision).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 5 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



As an Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of approximately 6\-10 software engineers responsible for delivering an exceptional client experience for Looker. Your role is to build a team and guide them to execute on cloud data analytics priorities. You will hire, develop, and retain a team of software engineers. You will be responsible for their career growth, providing coaching, and managing performance to build an exceptional engineering organization. You will ensure the team's roadmap directly supports the critical goal of differentiated BI experiences using AI. You will collaborate closely with Product Management, other Cloud Data engineering teams, and customer\-facing roles to respond to customer needs, and influence product direction.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Cultivate a team environment that is psychologically safe and encourages collaboration and innovation. Empower your team to take ownership and deliver outstanding results. Partner with Product Management and technical leads to define and execute the technical strategy for Looker.
* Guide the team through complex architectural decisions and ensure high standards for code quality are maintained through effective design and code review processes. Improve the end\-to\-end customer experience, from ease of use to debuggability and raw performance. Help customers profile their workload, and tune it for GCP.
* Ensure the team delivers high\-quality software on time. Set priorities, manage the project execution, and communicate progress and risks to stakeholders across the organization.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

* Contribute to reusable assets (demo environments, integration templates, solution accelerators)

 API \& Integration

* Familiarity with data formats and transformation (JSON, XML, ETL processes)

* Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Knowledge of distributed systems, containerization, and serverless architectures
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

* Ability to debug complex system interactions and integration issues

* Experience integrating enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS, marketing platforms)
* Familiarity with event streaming, messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Exposure to AI/ML or automation tools (increasingly valuable in modern environments)


**Business \& Soft Skills**
* Strong ability to translate technical concepts into business value and outcomes
* Consultative approach to problem\-solving and solution design
* Excellent communication and presentation skills across technical and executive audiences
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in fast\-paced, customer\-facing environments

a5ba3e81.title: ERP ALM Solution Architect -  Cloud ALM Transition & Custom Systems
a5ba3e81.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 The Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools is the primary technical authority responsible for architecting the transition from legacy SAP Solution Manager to a modern, future\-proof ALM ecosystem. In this role, you will lead the strategic design and operational excellence of the global "Requirements to Deploy" process, ensuring that our delivery pipeline remains robust during a period of significant technological shift.
   

  

 Your core mission is to navigate the complexities of SAP’s Cloud ALM offering while maintaining the flexibility to custom\-build proprietary solutions when standard tools lack the necessary influence on design or functional depth. As part of your daily remit, you will:
   

  

****Architect the Pivot:****
 Actively evaluate the functional gaps within SAP Cloud ALM and decide where the organization must "Build" rather than "Buy." You will be responsible for the high\-level design of custom ALM modules (potentially on SAP BTP or other cloud\-native platforms) to ensure our specific business requirements are met.
   

  

****Design the "Requirements to Deploy" Lifecycle and Lead Technical Decisioning:****
 You will orchestrate the end\-to\-end framework including Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management. You are not just a tool user; you are the designer of the framework that enables these processes.
   

  

****Govern Hybrid Landscapes:****
 You will define the integration patterns required to link SAP\-specific ALM components with the broader enterprise DevOps toolchain, ensuring a "clean core" strategy while managing the decommissioning of legacy SolMan/ChaRM environments.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Mastery of ALM Transition \& Toolsets: Expert\-level knowledge of legacy ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) paired with the ability to architect migrations to SAP Cloud ALM
* 8\+ years of Custom Build \& Extensibility Expertise: Proven experience in designing custom\-built enterprise software or side\-by\-side extensions. You must demonstrate an "architectural mindset" capable of building bespoke tools when SaaS products offer limited design influence
* SDLC \& DevOps Proficiency: Deep understanding of ERP change management and transport layers, with a modern approach to API\-first design, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release orchestration
* Advanced competency in using AI\-augmented engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule, or equivalent) to improve code quality, automate documentation, and design intelligent extensions that bridge functional gaps in standard SaaS offerings
* Lifecycle Management: Proven track record of managing at least 2–3 full\-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles, specifically focusing on the architectural trade\-offs between "Standard" and "Custom" solutions
* Strategic Compliance: Solid background in IT Service Management / ITIL, alongside experience in Computerized System Validation (CSV) and ICFR, ensuring custom\-built ALM tools meet global regulatory standards
* Global Architectural Leadership: Experience working in a large global company, demonstrating the ability to build consensus among diverse stakeholders
* English Communication: Superior command of the English language (both written and verbal) is essential for collaborating with global stakeholders and presenting complex ALM strategies to leadership
* A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

Strong understanding of technical domains such as cloud architecture (AWS), resiliency and high availability patterns, and application development, with proven experience managing projects through the full lifecycle—including influencing decision makers and adapting to evolving business needs.

8776ebfb.title: Product Solutions Consultant
8776ebfb.description:
### **About Company**


Tudip Technologies Pvt. Ltd is a CMMI Level 5 extreme technology company. Careers at Tudip Technologies are not just jobs, but a promise of a bright and dynamic future. Tudip provides ample opportunities to grow within the company technically as well as a technocrat by promoting entrepreneurship. Tudip Technologies’ careers will enable you to help clients enhance and improve while you build your career. Tudip is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are a place which defines Integrity, Innovation, and Serenity. Tudip provides you a better platform that translates an individual into an experienced and immensely skilled professional through an ethical and vibrant business environment. We are here for effective client servicing, taking care of our employees’ needs, and creating a success story to remember.

  



### **About the Role**


We are looking for a customer\-focused and technically proficient Product Solutions Consultant to drive product demonstrations, solution consulting, and pre\-sales engagements for our AI products, Testily and VoXgent. In this role, you will be the bridge between prospects, the sales team, and the product organization. You will understand customer business challenges, demonstrate product capabilities, manage post\-demo follow\-ups, support Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and help convert opportunities into successful customer engagements. This role requires excellent communication skills, business acumen, product expertise, and the ability to present complex technical concepts simply and compellingly.

  



Please read the job criteria below and drop us an email at **joinus@tudip.com** OR create an account on our **Recruitment Portal** to get started.

  



### **Key Responsibilities**


#### **Product Demonstrations**


* Conduct engaging, customized product demonstrations for Testily and VoXgent.
* Tailor demonstrations based on customer industry, use cases, and business objectives.
* Showcase AI capabilities, integrations, automation workflows, and enterprise features.
* Deliver both virtual and onsite product presentations.

#### **Discovery \& Solution Consulting**


* Conduct discovery sessions to understand customer requirements, business processes, and pain points.
* Recommend product capabilities and solution approaches aligned with customer needs.
* Translate technical functionality into clear business value.

#### **Sales Support**


* Partner with Account Executives throughout the sales lifecycle.
* Assist in opportunity qualification and solution positioning.
* Support RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and customer presentations.
* Participate in customer meetings, workshops, and executive presentations.

#### **Post\-Demo Follow\-up**


* Ensure timely follow\-up after every demonstration.
* Address customer questions and coordinate with Product and Engineering teams where needed.
* Track action items and maintain momentum throughout the sales cycle.
* Schedule and coordinate follow\-up meetings, workshops, and PoCs.

#### **Proof of Concept (PoC)**


* Coordinate PoC planning and execution.
* Configure product demonstrations for customer\-specific scenarios.
* Monitor PoC success criteria and provide regular updates.
* Ensure successful completion of PoCs leading to commercial discussions.

#### **Product Expertise**


* Develop deep expertise in Testily and VoXgent features, AI capabilities, integrations, and product roadmap.
* Stay current with competitor offerings and industry trends.
* Provide actionable customer feedback to Product Management.

#### **Customer Relationship Management**


* Build trusted relationships with prospects and enterprise stakeholders.
* Act as the product advisor during evaluation cycles.
* Ensure a professional and consultative customer experience.

#### **Collaboration**


* Work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing teams.
* Contribute to demo environments, knowledge repositories, and product collateral.
* Participate in product launches, webinars, customer events, and industry conferences.

#### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
* 3–8 years of experience in Pre\-Sales, Solution Consulting, Product Consulting, or Sales Engineering.
* Experience demonstrating SaaS, AI, CRM, QA Automation, or Enterprise Software products.
* Strong presentation and storytelling skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Ability to understand customer business challenges and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings when required.

#### **Preferred Skills**


* Understanding of AI and Generative AI concepts.
* Knowledge of software testing, QA automation, and SDLC.
* Familiarity with contact center platforms, conversational AI, and enterprise integrations.
* Exposure to APIs, REST services, cloud platforms, and enterprise architecture.
* Experience with Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics, or other enterprise applications.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

#### **Key Competencies**


* Customer\-centric mindset
* Exceptional presentation skills
* Solution\-oriented thinking
* Business acumen
* Technical aptitude
* Stakeholder management
* Time management
* Negotiation and influencing skills
* Team collaboration
* Continuous learning

#### **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**


* Number of demos conducted per month
* Demo\-to\-qualified opportunity conversion rate
* Demo\-to\-PoC conversion rate
* PoC success rate
* Opportunity win rate
* Pipeline influenced
* Revenue supported
* Customer satisfaction (CSAT) after demonstrations
* Average follow\-up turnaround time
* Product knowledge certification completion
* Sales cycle reduction
* Demo environment readiness and quality

  
### **Key Job Details**


* **Job Title:**Product Solutions Consultant
* **Location:** Pune
* **Country:** India
* **Type:** Full Time

8eabbd58.title: Senior Staff Solution Architect - AI & Cloud
8eabbd58.description:
**Job Description Summary**
 We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Staff AI \& Cloud Solution Architect to lead the design and development of scalable AI platforms and intelligent solutions on AWS. This role requires deep expertise across AI/ML engineering, cloud architecture, MLOps, and Generative AI, along with strong experience in building enterprise\-grade, secure, and compliant SaaS platforms.
   

  

 You will be responsible for architecting end\-to\-end AI systems, enabling machine learning and deep learning engineering workflows, and driving innovation in GenAI and agentic AI solutions. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, data architecture, and applied AI, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and governance.
   

  

 GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world\-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Platform \& Solution Architecture**
* Design and build scalable, multi\-tenant AI platforms on AWS supporting diverse ML and GenAI use cases.
* Define reference architectures, reusable components, and best practices for AI/ML systems.
* Architect end\-to\-end AI pipelines spanning data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and monitoring.
* Ensure platform readiness for SaaS environments, including tenant isolation, scalability, and cost optimization.


**Machine Learning \& Deep Learning Engineering**
* Lead development of machine learning and deep learning models for production\-grade applications.
* Establish standards for ML engineering, including data preprocessing, feature stores, training pipelines, and inference services.
* Optimize model performance, scalability, and latency for real\-time and batch inference systems.


**Generative AI \& Agentic AI Systems**
* Design and implement Generative AI solutions using AWS Bedrock and foundation models.
* Build RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines with vector databases and embeddings.
* Develop agentic AI systems, including autonomous agents, orchestration frameworks, and tool integration.
* Apply advanced techniques such as prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails.


**AWS Cloud Architecture**
* Architect and implement solutions using:
* AWS SageMaker (training, pipelines, deployment)
* AWS Bedrock (GenAI services)
* Compute: Lambda, ECS, EKS
* Orchestration: Step Functions
* Storage/Data: S3, Redshift, DynamoDB, Glue
* Build highly available, fault\-tolerant, and cost\-optimized cloud\-native systems.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.


**MLOps \& Model Lifecycle Management**
* Establish and scale MLOps frameworks for continuous integration and deployment of ML models.
* Implement MLflow for experiment tracking, model registry, and lifecycle management.
* Build automated CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows.
* Enable model monitoring, drift detection, retraining pipelines, and explainability.


**Data Architecture \& Engineering**
* Design scalable data architectures to support AI/ML workloads (batch and streaming).
* Implement data pipelines, feature stores, and data governance frameworks.
* Ensure data quality, lineage, and accessibility across teams.


**Security, Compliance \& Governance**
* Architect AI systems with security\-first principles, including encryption, IAM, and network controls.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise and regulatory standards (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2 as applicable).
* Implement responsible AI practices, including bias detection, auditability, and explainability.
* Establish governance for data, models, and AI services.


**SaaS Platform Engineering**
* Design and implement AI\-powered SaaS platforms, supporting:
+ Multi\-tenancy and tenant isolation
+ API\-driven architectures
+ Usage metering and cost attribution

* Enable platform extensibility and integration with enterprise systems.


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship across AI, ML, and cloud engineering teams.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision\-making.
* Drive innovation and adoption of emerging AI paradigms.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field (PhD preferred) with a minimum of 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML, and cloud architecture.
* Good expertise in Machine Learning Engineering and Deep Learning Engineering.
* Hands\-on experience with:
* AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock, core cloud services)
* MLflow and MLOps frameworks
* Good programming skills in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.).
* Proven experience designing and deploying scalable AI systems in production.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation).
* Good understanding of data architecture and distributed systems.
* Experience implementing secure and compliant cloud solutions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with agentic AI frameworks and multi\-agent systems.
* Familiarity with LLM orchestration tools (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, OpenSearch, FAISS).
* Knowledge of streaming and big data technologies (Kafka, Spark).
* AWS certifications:
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.
* AWS Machine Learning Specialty
* Experience in enterprise SaaS platforms or regulated industries.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Expertise in scalable AI system design
* Good foundation in ML, DL, and GenAI
* Deep knowledge of MLOps and cloud\-native architectures
* Excellent problem\-solving and system design skills
* Good communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to balance innovation with enterprise constraints (security, compliance, cost)


**Impact of the Role**
 This role will be instrumental in shaping the organization’s AI platform strategy and execution, enabling rapid development and deployment of next\-generation AI solutions, including Generative AI and agentic systems, while ensuring scalability, security, and compliance at enterprise scale.
   

  

**Inclusion and Diversity**
 GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

 Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions.  Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 03 years of relevant experience.
   

  

**Job Description**
 A skilled and experienced ServiceNow Developer/Architect to design, implement, and optimize solutions across multiple ServiceNow modules, including IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD), Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), Configuration Management Database (CMDB), Software Asset Management (SAM), Hardware Asset Management (HAM), Generative AI (Gen AI), and system integrations. This role requires a deep understanding of ServiceNow capabilities, best practices, and customization to align with business requirements and drive digital transformation.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* ITSM (IT Service Management): Configure and enhance core ITSM modules, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management. Develop custom workflows, automation, and integrations to improve IT service delivery. Collaborate with service owners to optimize user experience and process efficiency.
* ITOM (IT Operations Management): Implement and optimize ITOM capabilities, including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and Orchestration. Enhance monitoring, alerting, and automated responses to improve service uptime and operational resilience. Integrate ITOM with existing infrastructure to support automated workflows and event\-driven responses.
* HRSD (Human Resources Service Delivery): Configure and manage HR case management, employee self\-service portals, and knowledge management. Enable workflows to automate onboarding, offboarding, and other HR processes to streamline employee services. Collaborate with HR teams to ensure adherence to compliance, data privacy, and security standards.
* GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance): Design and implement GRC workflows to support policy and compliance management, risk assessment, and audit tracking. Automate risk reporting, assessments, and governance processes to enhance regulatory compliance and risk mitigation. Integrate GRC with other systems for real\-time monitoring and reporting.
* CMDB (Configuration Management Database): Develop, optimize, and maintain a robust CMDB to ensure accurate asset and service data. Implement CI relationships, manage CMDB health, and utilize the CSDM (Common Service Data Model). Support alignment of CMDB with ITSM and ITOM processes to ensure effective data consistency and utilization.
* SAM (Software Asset Management) \& HAM (Hardware Asset Management): Manage SAM/HAM processes, including license compliance, software/hardware tracking, and audit readiness. Automate asset lifecycle management, optimize licensing, and reduce asset\-related risks. Integrate SAM/HAM with other modules to create an end\-to\-end asset management solution.
* Generative AI (Gen AI): Utilize Gen AI capabilities to enhance ServiceNow modules, including virtual agent responses and predictive analysis. Integrate AI\-based automation to enhance self\-service, incident categorization, and resolution. Identify and apply AI\-driven insights to optimize workflows and reduce operational workloads.
* Integrations: Design and implement integrations with third\-party systems and applications, including REST, SOAP, APIs, and custom integrations. Ensure secure, scalable, and reliable integrations that facilitate seamless data exchange across platforms. Troubleshoot integration issues and monitor performance to ensure minimal downtime.


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience: 12 \- 15 years of experience in ServiceNow Solution design, implementation, development and administration, with a deep understanding of multiple modules.
* Certifications: Preferred certifications include ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (for ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, GRC), and experience with Integration Hub.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in JavaScript, ServiceNow Scripting, Flow Designer, REST/SOAP, and API integrations. Worked on solution designs
* Soft Skills: Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills; ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders. Worked with client senior management.


 Additional Requirements:
   

  

* Proven experience in ServiceNow customizations, workflow automation, and performance optimization.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
* Strong understanding of ITIL practices and frameworks, particularly for ITSM and ITOM modules.
* Prior experience working with Generative AI tools and technologies within ServiceNow is a plus.

bc36d347.title: AI Solutions Architect
bc36d347.description:
**Core Responsibilities** **AI Solution Design \& Delivery*** Translate client and internal business requirements into feasibility\-validated, buildable AI solutions — delivered, not just proposed.
* Design and deliver end\-to\-end AI solutions, including agentic workflows, AI integrations, automation pipelines, and LLM\-powered applications for internal and external customers.
* Package delivered solutions into documented, reusable assets that can be applied across engagements.
* Engage directly with US\-based clients in discovery sessions, workshops, and solution reviews as the technical AI subject matter expert.

**Agentic AI, Automation \& Workflow*** Design and build multi\-agent AI systems using LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
* Architect MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations connecting AI agents to enterprise tools, data sources, and business workflows.
* Build agentic automation that executes real, multi\-step business processes with appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop oversight.
* Apply prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and vector database integrations to deliver accurate, context\-aware AI solutions at production scale.

**AI Integration \& Application Modernization*** Design AI\-assisted integration solutions that connect disparate systems, data sources, and platforms — platform\-agnostic, applicable across diverse client technology environments.
* Apply AI approaches to accelerate application modernization, legacy migration, and systems integration across client technology stacks.
* Build reusable AI accelerators for code analysis, migration planning, and integration mapping that can be deployed across engagements.

**Organizational AI Adoption \& Enablement*** Support internal teams and external clients in adopting and operationalizing AI, from readiness assessment through practical implementation and change enablement.
* Design AI guardrails and governance practices, including data handling, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and responsible AI use that are appropriate for client\-facing agentic systems.
* Build AI solutions that improve operational efficiency for both client organizations and Integrative's own internal teams and functions.
* Develop practical adoption frameworks, runbooks, and enablement materials that help non\-AI practitioners use and sustain delivered solutions.
* Recruit and mentor junior AI engineers; collaborate with Integrative's enterprise architecture group to ensure AI solutions align with broader technology standards.
* Continuously monitor emerging AI tools, frameworks, and platform releases; evaluate applicability and bring relevant recommendations forward.

**Required Skills \& Competencies****Agentic AI \& Orchestration*** LangChain and LangGraph — hands\-on production experience required. MCP (Model Context Protocol) design and implementation required.
* Multi\-agent frameworks (CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent) strongly preferred. Tool calling, memory management, context and state handling, RAG pipeline architecture.

**AI Integration \& Engineering Foundation*** Production\-grade Python; direct LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI); vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Azure AI Search).
* API\-first and microservices architecture; enterprise integration patterns; prompt engineering at scale.

**Microsoft \& Azure AI Platform*** Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Copilot Studio, Power Automate with AI Builder, Azure DevOps / CI\-CD.

**Delivery \& Communication*** Demonstrated ability to deliver AI solutions that generate measurable business outcomes — for both internal teams and external clients.
* Clear solution documentation and business communication; fluent written and spoken English; confident in client\-facing settings.
* Experience supporting organizational AI adoption — helping teams understand, use, and sustain AI solutions.
* Distributed (onshore/offshore) delivery experience preferred.

We are headquartered in Bangalore, India. We also have offices in Dubai, UK, USA and France.

The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Delivery teams across the complete sales lifecycle.
