Job Code: iTC0019
   

  

 Job Title: Technical Pre\-Sales Manager
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru, India
   

  

 Reports To: Senior Technical Pre\-Sales Manager
   

  

**About ITCart**
 iTCart Private Limited is a global technology organisation redefining how industries operate in the age of Artificial Intelligence. Headquartered in Bengaluru and established across key innovation hubs in the USA, UK, KSA, UAE, and LATAM, iTCart leads AI\-native digital transformation for enterprises worldwide. Our patent\-pending AiXHub™ EOS serves as the foundation for intelligent automation, operational scalability, and AI\-driven business excellence. From streamlining complex workflows to delivering hyper\-personalised insights through Generative AI, we enable organisations to transition seamlessly from legacy environments to future\-ready digital ecosystems.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Technical Pre\-Sales Manager will act as the bridge between business and technology, working closely with sales, prospects, customers, and delivery teams to create compelling solution presentations, proposals, demonstrations, and technical strategies that drive business growth. The ideal candidate will have 8–12 years of overall experience with a minimum of 3\+ years in Technical Pre\-Sales, Solution Consulting, or Solution Engineering and a passion for helping customers solve business problems through innovative technology solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Customer Discovery \& Solution Consulting
   

  

* Partner with sales teams throughout the opportunity lifecycle to provide technical and solution expertise.
* Engage with prospective customers to understand business requirements, challenges, and transformation goals.
* Lead discovery workshops, requirement\-gathering sessions, and solution discussions.
* Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders, including business and technology leaders.


 Solution Design \& Technical Strategy
   

  

* Design and present solutions around AI, Automation, SaaS, Cloud, Analytics, and Digital Transformation offerings.
* Prepare solution decks, technical proposals, effort estimates, response documents, and customer presentations.
* Support contract discussions by providing solution clarification and technical positioning.
* Create scalable and customer\-centric technical solution strategies.


 Proposal Management \& Bid Support
   

  

* Support RFP, RFI, RFQ responses and participate in bid management activities.
* Prepare detailed technical proposals and estimation documents.
* Develop effort estimates, solution sizing, resource planning, and project assumptions.
* Maintain proposal quality throughout the sales cycle.


 Product Demonstrations \& Sales Enablement
   

  

* Conduct product demonstrations, proof of concepts (POCs), and technical walkthroughs.
* Support enterprise sales teams during deal pursuit and closure.
* Present technical solutions to executive and business stakeholders.
* Provide technical positioning throughout customer engagements.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Collaborate with engineering, architecture, and delivery teams to develop winning solutions.
* Work closely with sales, delivery, product, and leadership teams.
* Support successful project transitions from sales to delivery.
* Ensure customer expectations are aligned with delivery capabilities.


 Knowledge Management \& Innovation
   

  

* Stay updated on market trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies.
* Maintain reusable assets, proposal templates, and solution accelerators.
* Drive continuous improvement in pre\-sales processes and technical consulting practices.


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Strong technical support throughout the complete opportunity lifecycle.
* Successful customer discovery workshops and solution consulting engagements.
* High\-quality solution design and enterprise solution architecture.
* Winning technical proposals, RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and bid responses.
* Successful proof of concepts (POCs) and technical demonstrations.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive engagement.
* Effective collaboration with engineering, architecture, sales, and delivery teams.
* Business growth through technical solution consulting.
* Well\-maintained reusable assets, proposal templates, and solution accelerators.
* Continuous learning and adoption of emerging technologies.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software services, SaaS platforms, cloud technologies, AI solutions, automation, analytics, and digital transformation.
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and storytelling skills.
* Strong executive presence with the ability to engage senior decision\-makers.
* Strong business analysis and consulting capabilities.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non\-technical audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills.
* Highly collaborative with sales, delivery, product, and leadership teams.
* Strong negotiation, influencing, and communication abilities.
* Strategic thinking with a customer\-centric mindset.
* High ownership and accountability for solution quality and deal success.


**Experience**
* 8–12 years of overall IT experience across software services, SaaS, enterprise solutions, cloud, or digital transformation environments.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience in Technical Pre\-Sales, Solution Consulting, or Solution Engineering.
* Minimum 4\+ years of experience designing and presenting technology solutions for enterprise customers.
* Minimum 5\+ years of experience conducting customer discovery workshops, requirement gathering, and business solution discussions.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience responding to RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and preparing technical proposals.
* Minimum 4\+ years of experience conducting customer presentations, solution demonstrations, and executive briefings.
* Minimum 5\+ years of exposure to AI \& Generative AI Solutions.
* Minimum 5\+ years of exposure to Enterprise SaaS Platforms.
* Minimum 5\+ years of exposure to Cloud Technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Minimum 5\+ years of exposure to Automation \& Workflow Platforms.
* Minimum 5\+ years of exposure to Data \& Analytics Solutions.
* Minimum 5\+ years of exposure to Digital Transformation Programs.
* Minimum 5\+ years of experience working with CXOs, business leaders, IT leaders, and customer stakeholders.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience creating solution estimates, resource plans, and project assumptions.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience supporting enterprise sales teams in deal pursuit and closure.


 Why iTCart?
   

  

 Global Impact with Local Precision : Serving 25\+ industries, Technology, BFSI, Healthcare, Real Estate, and beyond – we tailor AI to solve region\-specific challenges while driving universal progress.

Each product is designed to help organisations automate workflows, enhance decision\-making, and transform operations using intelligent, real\-time insights.
   

  

 Purpose\-Driven Innovation:Our mission extends beyond technology delivery. Every solution we build also contributes to social upliftment—supporting education, healthcare, employment, and community empowerment across regions where we operate.
   

  

 Vision: We are building the world’s next generation of intelligent enterprises, where AI is not an add\-on but the operational core. Our goal is to help organisations scale confidently, adapt rapidly, and operate with precision through AI\-powered transformation.

You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
   

  

 Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential — and people too. With a culture that’s all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology — and careers — to the next level.
   

  

 We’re at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Our ‘get it done’ culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.
   

  

 Snowflake partners, from System Integrators (SI), Cloud Service Providers (CSP) and Technology Partners (ISV) are an integral part of Snowflake business to help customers unlock Power of Snowflake AI Data Cloud.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and proactive individual to drive the technical growth in this Partner ecosystem.
   

  

 This role demands a technical expert capable of driving success by aligning with key programs and significantly enhancing partner knowledge of crucial product features. The candidate must effectively present to both technical and executive audiences, utilising methods from whiteboarding to presentations and demonstrations, to cultivating strong mind share among Snowflake Partners across India.
   

  

 We require a candidate with a demonstrable history of successful engagement with major partners and a proven ability to develop technical champions within their organisations. Ideal candidates will possess a deep understanding of the broader Platform ecosystem, including products and the competitive landscape, enabling them to influence and serve as the partners' trusted technical advisor.
   

  

 This role requires travel up to 50% within India throughout the quarter to support partner engagement such as enablement, deal support and marketing events.
   

  

**AS A PARTNER SOLUTION ENGINEER, YOU WILL:**
* Collaborate closely with Snowflake's Partner, Sales, and Solutions Engineering teams to promote and implement optimal solutions with our partners.
* Design and deliver technical training, workshops, and certifications to upskill partner teams on Snowflake architecture and best practices based on joint business goals.
* Co\-develop industry\-specific solutions and accelerators with partners (e.g., data migration frameworks, industry data models, Power of N motions). Aligning Snowflake's products to maximise impact on their service offerings.
* Present at Snowflake and Partner events, lead hackathons, and drive Snowflake awareness and adoption within partner organisations.
* Partner closely on strategic customer engagements, collaborating with partners to define use cases, deliver compelling presentations, execute successful Proofs of Concept (POCs), and ensure positive outcomes.
* Own the technology roadmap with the partners, to build and scale their Snowflake practices with reference architectures and delivery methodologies.
* Advocate for partner and customer needs with Snowflake product teams.


**OUR IDEAL PARTNER SOLUTION ENGINEER WILL HAVE:**
* Have 10\+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Experience working with Global Systems Integrators, Regional System Integrators, Cloud Service Providers and Technology Partners within the region.
* Developed data domain thought leadership within a partner community.
* Deep comprehension of Partner revenue models, industry priorities and challenges they navigate.
* Proven experience in designing and building highly scalable data pipelines using Spark, Kafka to ingest data from various systems.
* Strong SQL and data warehousing fundamentals (cloud DW experience preferred)
* Experience with Snowflake Technology Partners that specialise in Data Engineering, Data Science, Collaboration and Cyber Security.
* Hands\-on technical experience with DevOps and CI/CD processes and tools, such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, and Google Cloud Build.
* Strong experience with major cloud platforms and tooling, especially Azure, AWS and Google Cloud.
* Experience using Big Data or Cloud integration technologies such as Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, etc.
* Experience with AI/ML use cases is a plus.


 Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

* Apply a strong "product mindset" to technical problem\-solving—focusing on scalable, reusable solutions rather than one\-off custom scripts.

 R\&D Leader(Industrial Software)\-AUEN BL
   

  

  

  

  

  

**What We Believe In**
 ABB’s Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world’s largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.
   

  

 We offer a broad range of automation, electrification, and digital solutions for process, hybrid, and maritime industries, including industry\-specific integrated control and software, as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services.
   

  

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 In this role, we are looking for an experienced Product Architect to join our Industrial Automation Digital organization. You will define the architecture strategy and technical roadmap for next\-generation industrial software platforms built on Edge and Cloud technologies. As a key technical leader, you will drive architecture governance, engineering best practices, and technology adoption while collaborating with global engineering teams to build secure, scalable, and high\-performance SaaS and PaaS solutions.

* Collaborate with Product Management, Platform Engineering, and global stakeholders to develop product roadmaps, architectural runway, platform evolution strategies, and technical governance while mentoring engineering teams and promoting architecture excellence.
* Drive continuous platform optimization by reducing technical debt, improving developer productivity through AI\-assisted engineering, and maintaining comprehensive architecture documentation, threat models, and engineering best practices.


**Qualifications For The Role**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline with 12\+ years of experience in software architecture, platform engineering, and enterprise product development.
* Strong expertise in cloud\-native architectures, Docker, Kubernetes, Microservices, Microsoft Azure, SaaS/PaaS platforms, distributed systems, REST APIs, C\# .NET Core, relational and time\-series databases, with experience in React and TypeScript being desirable.

* Proven experience designing secure, scalable, and highly available enterprise software architectures while driving technical governance, mentoring engineering teams, and influencing strategic technology decisions across globally distributed organizations.
* Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills with exposure to Industrial Automation, Process Industries, Energy, or Digital Manufacturing domains considered an advantage.


**More About Us**
 ABB is a leading global technology company that energizes the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.
   

  

 The Process Automation business area automates, electrifies, and digitalizes some of the world's most complex industrial infrastructures across energy, process, hybrid, and maritime industries. Through advanced industrial software, cloud platforms, automation technologies, and AI\-driven digital solutions, ABB enables customers to improve operational efficiency, safety, reliability, and sustainability while accelerating the transition toward a low\-carbon future.
   

  

 Join ABB and become part of a global team that is shaping the future of industrial automation through world\-class engineering, cloud\-native platforms, and AI\-powered innovation.
   

  

 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

**About Cognizant**
 Cognizant is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward\-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
   

  

 At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Cloud Security Architect** 
 , you will lead the design, validation, and governance of security architecture across enterprise cloud and hybrid environments. You will play a critical role in ensuring cloud\-native and hybrid architectures align with Cognizant’s security reference architecture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multi\-cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
   

  

 You will work independently with senior stakeholders, enterprise architects, security teams, cloud engineering teams, DevSecOps practitioners, and compliance leaders to provide end\-to\-end ownership of cloud security architecture from threat modeling and design reviews through implementation validation and operational governance. You will have the opportunity to influence strategic cloud adoption initiatives, modern security architectures, and enterprise\-wide cloud governance programs while mentoring teams and driving security excellence.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Govern the security architecture of enterprise cloud and hybrid environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, and OCI platforms.
* Conduct cloud security architecture reviews covering Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Identity Management (PIM), network segmentation, micro\-segmentation, and Zero Trust security models.
* Partner with Cloud Management Office, enterprise architecture, security, and engineering teams to integrate security requirements into cloud design and architecture decisions.
* Define and implement cloud security standards, architectural patterns, governance controls, and security guardrails.
* Embed security requirements into Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud automation frameworks.
* Collaborate with compliance and risk stakeholders to ensure cloud solutions meet regulatory and security requirements.
* Evaluate emerging cloud services, container platforms, serverless technologies, and AI\-enabled solutions while providing architectural guidance and security recommendations.
* Serve as the primary security architecture liaison between enterprise architecture, security governance, control validation, IT security, and business stakeholders.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level objectives (SLOs) for cloud architecture initiatives.
* Lead architecture governance reviews, risk assessments, threat modeling exercises, and solution validation activities.
* Mentor security, architecture, cloud, and engineering teams on secure cloud operations and cloud security best practices.
* Stay current on cloud provider roadmaps, threat landscape developments, regulatory requirements, and industry security standards.


**What You Must Have To Be Considered**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in information security and cybersecurity architecture.
* 8\+ years of experience securing enterprise cloud environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, and/or OCI.
* Proven experience designing and governing cloud security architectures for large\-scale enterprise deployments.
* Demonstrated experience leading cloud architecture security reviews and evaluating security controls against cloud frameworks and assurance programs.
* Experience implementing and governing cloud security requirements within DevSecOps environments.
* Strong expertise in cloud security architecture, threat modeling, risk management, and security governance.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture, compliance, risk, audit, and operational stakeholders.
* Experience managing, mentoring, and guiding architecture, engineering, or validation teams.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for improving the security posture of cloud environments.
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.


**These Will Help You Succeed**
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, including Landing Zones, Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Working knowledge of AWS and Google Cloud Platform security services and governance frameworks.
* Experience with container platforms including AKS, EKS, and GKE.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes security, RBAC, network policies, and service mesh technologies.
* Strong cloud networking expertise including VNet/VPC design, hub\-and\-spoke architectures, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, firewall controls, and micro\-segmentation.
* Expertise in Zero Trust Architecture, IAM, PIM, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), and SIEM/SOAR integrations.
* Experience with security and compliance frameworks including PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2\.0, NIST SP 800\-53, and Cyber Essentials Plus.
* Experience using Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates, CloudFormation, GitOps, and CI/CD security controls.
* Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, Bash, and cloud automation practices.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving abilities.
* Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Leadership experience coaching and mentoring architects, engineers, and security practitioners.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
* Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) or Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK).
* Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\) or equivalent AWS Certified Security – Specialty or GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer certification.
* Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC\-100\).
* Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\).
* Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\) or equivalent AWS or GCP Professional Architect certification.
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).


**Work Model**
 We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring attendance at a client or Cognizant office as determined by business needs. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

7169be91.title: Technical Program Manager III
7169be91.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Technical Program Manager III**
---------------------------------

**Introduction to the team**
----------------------------

Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.


Within this organization, the EG Metrics Platform (EGMP) team in the Data Platform organization is on a mission to build Expedia Group’s enterprise\-wide semantic layer — a centralized metrics platform that standardizes how business metrics are defined, computed, governed, and consumed across the company. As the single source of truth for critical business metrics such as bookings, revenue, visits, funnel progression, and conversion, we power executive reporting, experimentation, BI dashboards, and self\-serve analytics at scale. Semantic layers are increasingly vital in the age of LLMs and AI agents because they reduce hallucinations, enforce consistency, and enable trusted metric discovery. Our team is at the forefront of this shift, building an AI\-powered semantic layer with agentic capabilities for natural\-language metric exploration, intelligent anomaly detection, automated operations, and governed AI\-ready data access.


**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------

* Lead planning and delivery of moderately complex, cross\-functional technical programs across multiple teams, aligning scope, priorities, timelines, and success metrics to business outcomes.
* Own delivery mechanisms for EGMP initiatives spanning governance, onboarding experience, adoption, reliability, cost transparency, and ecosystem integrations.
* Create visibility through dashboards, status reporting, milestones, dependency tracking, and structured decision\-making forums that improve accountability and delivery predictability.
* Partner across engineering, product, analytics, experimentation, and platform teams such as Pulse, TnL, Data Quality, OpenMetadata, and Yield \& Analytics to drive aligned execution on shared priorities.
* Influence trade\-off decisions without formal authority by using data, context, and structured communication to bring clarity to ambiguity and keep programs moving forward.
* Apply systems thinking to understand end\-to\-end platform flows, technical dependencies, upstream and downstream impacts, and architectural or operational risks early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Ensure operational readiness is built into program execution by partnering with engineering teams on monitoring, resiliency, incident readiness, learnings from production issues, and delivery risk mitigation.
* Drive programs that strengthen EGMP as a governed metrics foundation, including work related to certification, metadata quality, data quality integration, lineage, access controls, and authorized data usage.
* Drive programs that improve the speed and safety of onboarding, including sandbox or pre\-production workflows, reliability frameworks, duplicate detection, and better discovery or explorer experiences.
* Support adoption and consolidation efforts that establish EGMP as the single source of truth for reporting and experimentation metrics across Expedia Group.
* Use metrics and insight\-driven narratives to identify risk, guide prioritization, support leadership reviews, and improve execution health across platform programs.
* Contribute repeatable playbooks, templates, governance mechanisms, and process improvements that help scale TPM effectiveness and delivery excellence across the EGMP portfolio.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* You have 5\+ years of experience leading technical programs with cross\-functional dependencies in platform, infrastructure, data, analytics, or similarly complex engineering environments.
* Prior technical background and **core understand of SDLC is a foundational requirement for success** in this role
* You have experience planning and delivering moderately complex programs across multiple teams, including managing timelines, dependencies, risks, milestones, and execution reporting.
* You are skilled at building clarity and accountability through dashboards, status communication, governance mechanisms, and structured operating rhythms.
* You are comfortable influencing without authority and aligning engineering, product, and business stakeholders around trade\-offs, priorities, and next steps.
* You have strong technical fluency and can understand distributed systems, APIs, services, data flows, architecture discussions, and operational risks well enough to ask the right questions and surface gaps early.
* You use data and metrics to make program decisions, identify trends, surface risks, and tell a clear story to technical and leadership audiences.
* You have experience operating effectively in ambiguous environments and creating structure that helps teams move forward with confidence.
* You communicate clearly and concisely across different audiences and can translate complex technical or delivery topics into actionable updates and decisions.
* You bring a strong ownership mindset, sound judgment, and the ability to work collaboratively across teams, functions, and time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* You have experience working on data platforms, semantic layers, metrics platforms, experimentation platforms, BI or self\-serve analytics platforms, or developer\-facing platform products.
* You have experience supporting programs related to governance, metadata, lineage, access control, certification, or data quality.
* You have experience driving platform adoption or consolidation efforts across multiple customer groups and partner organizations.
* You have experience working with operational excellence programs involving reliability, monitoring, cost transparency, production readiness, or incident follow\-up.
* You have experience partnering with teams that support executive reporting, experimentation, and shared analytics capabilities at scale.
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is expected; a master’s degree is a plus.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.  



  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .  



  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

1e2e2b80.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
1e2e2b80.description:
**Description**
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**You're Our Person If...**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

596d0258.title: Chief Architect — Regulated Systems (Healthcare & Payments)
596d0258.description:
The Job, Stated Plainly
   

  

 Somewhere in your org there's an architecture doc nobody's opened since the kickoff meeting. This role doesn't produce those.
   

  

 Techdome is hiring someone to own the technical spine of an 80\+ engineer studio that builds systems handling real patient data and real money — not staging data, not a demo environment. The architecture you design this quarter is the architecture you're paged about next quarter. You'll sit in the design review, write the PR that sets the pattern, run the incident retro when something breaks at 2am, and sit across the table from the client who's trusting your judgment over their own instinct. Same person, all four rooms.
   

  

 This isn't a diagramming job with an "architect" title bolted on. If what draws you to architecture is the leverage of being
 *right* 
 and
 *present* 
 — not the authority of a title — this is written for you.
   

  

 The Shape of the Work
   

  

**You own the platform, not a slice of it.** 
 Service boundaries, data models, API contracts, and the parts of the job nobody puts on a highlight reel — encryption strategy, observability, cost curves, the scaling plan for eighteen months from now. All of it traces back to you.
   

  

**The compliance load is real, not theoretical.** 
 PHI moves through this system, which means audit logging, access control, tokenization, and encryption in transit and at rest aren't checkboxes — they're the architecture. Payment data stays walled off with no exceptions, including the exception someone will eventually ask you to make under deadline pressure.
   

  

**The stack is MERN, end to end, with the infrastructure that keeps it alive in production.** 
 MongoDB, Express, React, Node — plus containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, and secrets management you've actually operated, not just specified in a doc.
   

  

**You make the trade\-off calls and you own what happens after.** 
 Monolith or microservices, build or buy, synchronous or event\-driven — every one of these is a bet, and you're expected to defend it with evidence months later when someone asks why the system behaves the way it does.
   

  

**Your patterns outlast your projects.** 
 Code review standards, reference architectures, the default way this studio solves a recurring class of problem — you're setting the baseline that other architects and tech leads inherit, whether or not they ever meet you.
   

  

**AI tooling is load\-bearing here, not a novelty.** 
 Engineers across the studio ship daily with Claude Code, Copilot, and Cursor. We're not looking for someone who's merely used these tools — we want someone with a real point of view on how they change what "architecture" even means when a junior engineer can generate a service in an afternoon.
   

  

**You grow people without a reporting line to lean on.** 
 Senior engineers become tech leads here through the judgment you demonstrate and the trust you build, not through your position on an org chart.
   

  

**Clients take the hard recommendation from you** 
 — the one that costs more, takes longer, or contradicts what they walked in wanting — because your track record has already done the persuading.
   

  

 What Gets You In the Room
   

  

* 7\+ years of production ownership at architect, principal, or staff engineer level, with 2–3 years as the final technical authority on a platform — the person whose sign\-off actually meant something, not one voice among several.
* You still write code. Real, current Node.js and React experience — MERN specifically is preferred, but a strong Node\-centric full\-stack background gets you a serious look too.
* Cloud fluency that comes from running things, not just drawing them — AWS, GCP, or Azure, with the networking, security, and cost\-optimization instincts you only get from being on call for what you built.
* A regulated or high\-stakes domain you've actually been burned by — HIPAA/PHI, PCI\-DSS, fintech, banking, insurance, or something comparably unforgiving.
* Trade\-offs you made and then had to live with — not hypotheticals, actual decisions with actual consequences you can walk someone through.
* The composure to hold a skeptical room — engineers who'll push back, clients who came in with a different plan — and bring them around with evidence instead of authority.


 What Moves You to the Top of the Pile
   

  

* HIPAA experience that's actually been audited — BAA\-covered infrastructure, PHI access controls, audit trails that held up under scrutiny.
* Payment systems work with Stripe, Braintree, or similar — tokenization, reconciliation, life inside a PCI\-DSS environment.
* Event\-driven and microservices architecture at a scale where it actually mattered.
* Time spent in consulting, multi\-product, or venture\-studio settings, where you're solving the same class of problem for different clients back to back.
* A history of setting technical standards across teams or products — not just the one you happened to be closest to.
* Opinions on AI\-assisted development you're willing to defend in an argument, because you've actually built the practice, not just read about it.


 What Success Looks Like at Six Months
   

  

 You've shipped at least one architectural decision that other engineers now cite as precedent. You've run an incident retro that changed how the team builds, not just how it apologizes. A client has taken your recommendation over their original plan — and it worked out. Somewhere in the codebase, there's a pattern with your fingerprints on it that a new hire picks up without ever being told to.
   

  

 Who Should Probably Skip This
   

  

 If "architect" means Visio diagrams and a handoff to someone else's implementation, this will frustrate you fast. If you'd rather not be the one explaining, at 2am, why the system did what it did — this isn't your role. And if regulated\-industry constraints read to you as red tape rather than the actual point, you'll fight the job the whole way through.
   

  

 Why Techdome
   

  

 We're bootstrapped and profitable — no investor deck to perform for, no growth\-at\-all\-costs mandate distorting the architecture. 80\+ engineers across Hyderabad, Indore, Mumbai, Dubai, and the US, and we take equity in what we build alongside our clients. That's not a perk line — it's why the people here still care about a system a year after launch. We don't get to walk away when the invoice clears, so we don't build like we will.

7aac7d40.title: Program Manager
7aac7d40.description:
This is an internal role at Weekday \- not for a client of ours.
   

  

 Location: Remote
   

  

 Role type: Full time
   

  

 Weekday is an AI\-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them. We are growing profitably and work with 1000\+ companies to bolster their hiring.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a high\-ownership Program Manager role at the heart of how Weekday drives revenue. You will own a portfolio of companies end\-to\-end: sourcing the right candidates, managing the relationship, and turning trust into a steady stream of hires.
   

  

 You won't be handed a script. You'll build your own judgment about what makes a great candidate, decide where to invest your time, and become a partner that companies come to before a role is even fully formed. The Ops teams are there to support you — your job is to use them well and own the outcome.
   

  

 We measure this role by impact, not activity. To make that concrete, here is what success looks like at each stage of your first year.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 End of Month 1 (M1\)
   

  

 You've understood all the moving parts that keep Weekday running. You've spent 100\+ hours sourcing profiles on the platform and built your own mental model for what makes a great, good, or poor candidate — and you can confidently articulate why a given candidate is a great fit for one role but a poor fit for another.
   

  

 You've also spent time as an Individual Contributor across multiple Ops teams, posting top\-tier metrics. You now have first\-hand experience of what it takes to be good at Ops, which means you know how to leverage these teams in the best way possible going forward.
   

  

 End of Month 3 (M3\)
   

  

 Building on the M1 foundation, you've focused on building a portfolio of companies that will consistently hire via Weekday. Through this, you've picked up the broader craft of Account Management beyond sourcing, and developed a thorough understanding of the customers we serve, their requirements, and where they sit in the wider tech/startup ecosystem.
   

  

 You've prioritised well — making sharp calls on how much time and effort each company deserves. That discipline produced your first hire in Month 2, followed by 2\+ hires in Month 3\. You've proactively churned or deprioritised companies at the right moments, and turned around at least one company that had slowed down — now one of your higher\-priority accounts.
   

  

 End of Month 6 (M6\)
   

  

 You've fully established yourself as a key revenue contributor. After your first few hires in the opening quarter, you've spent the last three months consistently making 5\+ hires a month. This is powered by a set of 8\+ companies you now call "high\-priority," each making a hire with Weekday roughly every other month.
   

  

 You've made hires across the full spectrum of roles we cater to, and you feel confident taking on any new role — Engineering, Sales, or otherwise.
   

  

 End of Month 12 (M12\) — One Year
   

  

 What a year. Over the second half, you've scaled the baseline revenue from your portfolio to north of ₹50L/month — and you're confident of hitting that number even in a bad month.
   

  

 The companies you work with truly trust you. They come to you for advice and to brainstorm roles before they're fully formed. You've earned that trust through intelligent market insights, co\-solving real problems, and being a reliable partner — to the point where you can disagree with them and they'll give that disagreement real weight.
   

  

 Internally, you're recognised as a star Key Account Manager: the go\-to person for any high\-stakes company that gets onboarded, or any role others find hard to close. You're trusted to handle difficult conversations with companies, candidates, and colleagues alike.
   

  

 You're now ready for Year 2 — and the context and trust you've built have earned you the right to choose your own goals.
   

  

 What We're Looking For
   

  

  

* Strong ownership and judgment — you make good calls on where to invest time and effort, and you own outcomes rather than activity
* Sharp prioritisation: you know when to double down, when to deprioritise, and when to turn a slow account around
* Excellent relationship\-building and communication — comfortable handling high\-stakes, difficult conversations with companies, candidates, and colleagues
* A bias toward learning quickly: you build your own mental models rather than waiting for a playbook
* Comfort with data and metrics, and the ability to leverage operations teams effectively
* Genuine interest in the tech/startup ecosystem and what makes great hires


 Why Weekday
   

  

 You'll have real ownership from day one, a clear and ambitious growth path, strong Ops support behind you, and the chance to become a trusted partner to the companies shaping the tech ecosystem. Perform, and Year 2 is yours to define.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Leadership \& Ownership** 



* Ability to independently manage important accounts and projects.

**What We're Looking For** 




  




* **8–10 years of experience** 
 in client servicing, account management, brand solutions, experiential marketing, or related fields.
* Experience working on

* **Role:** 
 AI Solution Architect
* **Location:** 
 Remote
* **Job Type:** 
 Full\-Time
* **Payout:** 
 Competitive, based on experience



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking an AI Engagement Lead / Solution Architect to drive a generative AI engagement end\-to\-end for a Fortune 500 financial\-services client. The role requires owning solution design, key technical decisions, and client relationship from proof\-of\-concept through full\-scale implementation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 • Act as the single point of accountability for both architecture and delivery, leading a team of specialists including AI/ML engineers and integration engineers.
 



 • Own the solution design, set guardrails, and govern delivery to ensure a governed release aligned with client priorities.
 



 • Make and defend key design decisions, ensuring alignment with modern generative AI agentic frameworks and integration patterns.
 



 • Partner with the client’s architects, business analysts, and valuation subject\-matter experts to align technical solutions with business outcomes.
 



 • Lead end\-to\-end program execution, ensuring seamless integration and automation across enterprise systems.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 




 • 10\+ years of professional experience, with 4\+ years driving machine learning or AI projects and solution design.
 



 • Accountable ownership of solution architecture, including setting target architecture and defending design decisions.
 



 • Deep understanding of modern generative AI agentic designs and frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.
 



 • Experience with AI integration patterns, including Model Context Protocol (MCP)\-style architectures.
 



 • Proficiency in cloud platforms including Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or AWS.
 



 • Strong collaboration skills to align technical solutions with business stakeholders and SMEs.
 



 • Experience delivering enterprise\-scale AI solutions in financial\-services or regulated environments.
 



 • Ability to lead cross\-functional teams and manage client relationships at executive levels.
 



  





**More About the Opportunity:** 




 This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the deployment of mission\-critical AI systems for a leading financial\-services organization. You will shape the technical vision and execution for a high\-impact generative AI initiative.

 We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.
 



  





**Apply Now!**

07ee7b19.description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
   

  

 Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
   

  

**Your Role**
 In this multi\-faceted role, you will be a key contributor to PTC’s Product Development teams, responsible for driving both release execution, as well as strategic programs and initiatives toward achieving the organization’s best\-in\-class goals. You will be relied on to lead highly complex projects. You will work closely with executive leaders and subject matter experts across departments and business units, and the Program Management Office team to achieve successful project results.
   

  

 To excel in this role, you must have excellent communications skills, an overall understanding of business processes, acumen to use advanced program management skills and the ability to think strategically and tactically. You will be expected to drive best practices, methodologies, tools, and improvements. You will be expected to work in a dynamic, collaborative, cross\-functional team environment with a global team. You should be detail\-oriented and enjoy working with teams to implement projects and initiatives. You should be passionate about process improvement.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 PMO shapes the processes and augments R\&D in their deliveries across segments and drives high impact programs. You will directly participate in the planning, development and launch of market\-leading strategic products across the digital thread portfolio. You will also support the definition and successful execution of strategic R\&D programs, on time and to the satisfaction of the stakeholders.
   

  

**Your Team**
 You will be part of Central R\&D Program Management Office, which works with all product development functions in locations across the world to deliver products. Our culture is one of collaboration, both within our team and across all the product development functions. Since the team works across different products, the experience sharing helps continual learning and improvement, aligning with common practices and reaching forward to advance and improve with every product cycle.
   

  

**Your Day\-to\-Day**
* Work with PM, Engineering \& QA teams on delivering projects and releases to meet R\&D strategic goals
* Plan, schedule, and control the build, test, and deployment of releases
* Enable and drive efficient release process / governance with no supervision
* Proactively identify, communicate, and manage risks
* Identify and manage dependencies, coordinate delivery across scrum teams
* Measure release cadence and effectiveness using common metrics; own release dashboards
* Drive process adoption, analyze current processes, identify gaps, and improve processes.
* Introduce new processes as per business priorities with minimal to no guidance from the immediate manager
* Coordinate release and backlog planning and prioritization between PM and R\&D teams
* Plan and lead periodic release status review meetings with senior management
* Lead all change management activities and ensure timely decisions on change requests
* Project manage functional working teams to implement actionable plans with strategic, technical, and tactical milestones
* Build best practices and lead analysis for continued improvements through RCAs and retrospectives.
* Drive strategic programs and engage the senior management and responsible stakeholders well while continuously grabbing opportunities to push the program forward.
* Organize and lead cross\-functional teams to ensure program execution from ideation and planning to successful implementation
* Drive execution of assigned strategic initiatives through all required phases towards successful delivery
* Define and use tools and business systems required to support existing process and best practices
* Support R\&D decision making through analytical reports and appropriate metrics; design and own R\&D dashboards; establish status reporting for the cross\-functional teams
* Collaborate with other Program and Release managers to define and improve organizational standards for programs, releases, processes and best practices


**Must\-Have Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree; Masters and/or PMP preferred
* 7\-12 years of experience in product development organizations, with minimum of 5 years in a program or project management role.
* Good understanding and working knowledge of Agile Scrum software product development methodology, good knowledge of Scrum Master responsibilities; SAFe knowledge a plus.
* Comfort in managing multiple projects with multiple business partners in a fast\-paced and dynamic team environment
* Self\-starter who can earn trust and can influence and motivate without authority
* Ability to work independently, as well as mentor and support more junior colleagues as needed
* Proactive in identifying and solving problems, looks beyond the obvious and can find the root of the problem
* Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills
* Is effective in different presentation settings especially with large groups
* Proven ability to ‘Drive vs Coordinate’ to accomplish desired outcomes
* Strong business acumen and high comfort level dealing with ambiguity
* Ability to build and cultivate strong cross\-functional relationships
* Excellent facilitator, able to drive collaboration across the teams
* High level of organization and attention to detail
* Data savvy; Able to interpret data and use the knowledge for introducing optimization at different levels
* Fluent with MS PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Project management tools (Jira/Confluence, Qlik, Smartsheet, MS Project)
* Experience driving positive change via process improvement
* Keen interest in learning new methodologies and willingness to be coached and mentored for senior level engagements


 Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

****Job Description****
 At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  

 LinkedIn Marketing Solutions: We help businesses achieve their marketing ROI objectives with a suite of superior products that includes digital advertising and programmatic channels. LinkedIn Marketing Solutions is searching for a Client Solutions Manager (CSM) to manage relationships with our large and often most complex customers. The CSM will leverage their knowledge of online media, communication and relationship building skills, and analytical abilities to provide campaign intelligence and campaign strategy consultation, including identifying areas where LinkedIn can provide more value to our clients.

* Grow and maintain existing business through renewals, tactical reactivations and upsells.
* Co\-develop a strategic plan for your book of business with your Account Executive.
* Use data and insights to highlight the value of advertising, demonstrate ROI, and make recommendations for optimizations and additional investment.
* Inspire innovation by regularly sharing ideas and best practices with peers and sales leaders.
* Embrace our learning culture to develop yourself as a sales professional and colleague to your peers and internal partners.
* Travel requirements: approximately 20% for client meetings, industry events, and team collaboration

* Experience in media account management
* Demonstrated analytical background and experience with statistical analysis, return on investment modeling, and advertising/media analytics
* Ability to think strategically with a proven track record of providing consultative and data\-driven solutions
* Ability to effectively manage time, prioritize tasks and work within deadlines with little supervision
* Ability to work independently and collaborate cross\-functionally
* Experience working with large customers

43e531cc.description:
Solution Architect – Data \& AI

**Experience:** 8\+ Years  
**Location:** Bangalore  
**Shift Timing:** 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM IST  
**Office Requirement:** Candidate may be required to visit the Bangalore office based on business requirements.

**MANDATORY SKILLS**

**Core Technologies**

* Databricks
* DBT
* Unity Catalog
* SQL
* Python

**Architecture \& Domain Skills**

* Data Modelling \& Conversational AI
* Enterprise Solution Architecture / Modern Cloud Data Platforms
* Enterprise Data Modelling
* Dimensional Modelling
* Semantic Modelling
* Medallion Architecture
* Data Product Design
* Semantic Engineering Frameworks

**JOB SUMMARY**

We are looking for an experienced **Solution Architect – Data \& AI** to design enterprise data and conversational AI architectures using modern cloud data platforms.

The role focuses on enterprise data modelling, semantic architecture, reusable solution architecture patterns, trusted and governed data products, self\-service analytics, and conversational AI.

The candidate will translate enterprise architecture standards into scalable solution designs, reusable architecture patterns, reference designs, and technical guidance. The role involves working closely with engineering, analytics, AI, and delivery teams to ensure solutions are trusted, governed, reusable, and scalable.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Create enterprise data models and **Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERDs)** to support trusted and scalable data products.
* Design semantic architectures using **Databricks Metric Views** to support trusted data, analytics, and self\-service analytics.
* Design **Databricks Genie solution architectures** to enable conversational AI and analytics.
* Design scalable solution architectures for modern data and AI platforms using Databricks.
* Define and promote enterprise standards for data products, data modelling, **Medallion Architecture, DBT, Unity Catalog**, and modern data engineering.
* Define reusable semantic engineering and architecture patterns that support trusted analytics and conversational AI.
* Create reusable architecture patterns, reference designs, technical standards, and implementation guidance.
* Design semantic models and architecture patterns that enable trusted data, self\-service analytics, and conversational AI.
* Define architecture patterns that support governed, scalable, and reusable data products.
* Guide engineering and delivery teams in adopting enterprise architecture standards, patterns, and best practices.
* Enable delivery teams to independently build trusted and governed data products using established architecture standards and reusable patterns.
* Lead architecture reviews, solution design workshops, and technical discussions.
* Conduct **architecture office hours** to provide ongoing technical guidance and support to delivery teams.
* Provide technical coaching and guidance on enterprise architecture standards and best practices.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business and enterprise architecture requirements into scalable technical solutions.

**REQUIRED SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE**

* **8\+ years** of experience in enterprise solution architecture or modern cloud data platforms.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Databricks, DBT, Unity Catalog, SQL, and Python**.
* Deep understanding of **dimensional modelling, semantic modelling, Medallion Architecture, and data product design**.
* Experience designing enterprise\-scale data architectures and modern cloud data solutions.
* Experience creating reusable architecture patterns, reference designs, and implementation guidance.
* Experience with semantic engineering frameworks and semantic layer architecture.
* Strong understanding of data governance and trusted data products.
* Experience designing scalable and governed data solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and technical leadership skills.
* Ability to lead architecture reviews, design workshops, technical discussions, and technical coaching sessions.
* Ability to guide delivery teams in adopting enterprise architecture standards and best practices.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional engineering, analytics, AI, and technology teams.

HIGHLY DESIRABLE SKILLS

* Experience designing semantic architectures using **Databricks Metric Views**.
* Experience designing **Databricks Genie solution architectures**.
* Experience with **conversational AI architecture**.
* Experience enabling analytics and conversational AI using Databricks capabilities.
* Experience designing semantic layers for self\-service analytics.
* Experience with enterprise data product architecture.
* Experience establishing reusable architecture patterns and reference designs.

ROLE OUTCOMES

* Increased adoption of enterprise data and solution architecture standards.
* Increased self\-service analytics and independent delivery capabilities.
* Reduced implementation effort through reusable architecture patterns and reference designs.
* High\-quality, trusted, governed, and scalable data products.
* Scalable and reusable data and AI solutions.
* Consistent adoption of architecture best practices across engineering and delivery teams.

d792e75a.title: Presales- Manufacturing Discovery Engineer
d792e75a.description:
**About Yantra24x7:** 




  





**Yantra24x7** 
 helps SME manufacturers see, measure, and improve what happens on their shop floor. Our
 



 Industrial IoT platform connects machines (CNC, conventional, and special\-purpose) to deliver real\-time
 



 OEE, downtime, and production intelligence — without expensive consultants or complex ERP projects.
 



 Our Traceability solution extends this into complete part and batch genealogy — capturing which
 



 machine, operator, tool, program, and process parameters produced every part or batch. For SMEs
 



 supplying to automotive, aerospace, defence, and export customers, this delivers audit\-ready
 



 compliance (IATF 16949, AS9100/NADCAP\-aligned documentation), faster root\-cause analysis when a
 



 defect surfaces, containment of recalls to the exact affected lot instead of entire production runs, and
 



 the customer\-audit confidence that increasingly decides who wins OEM and Tier\-1 business.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 Our SME customers increasingly ask us to spend time inside their factories before they buy — to study
 



 their processes, talk to their operators, and show exactly where Yantra can create value. You will be the
 



 person who does this.
 



 This is a hands\-on, shop\-floor\-first role that blends industrial engineering with pre\-sales consulting. You
 



 will spend 2–3 days at a time inside customer plants, run structured discovery studies, execute pilots on
 



 a cell or line of machines, and translate the findings into a clear business case the owner/MD can act on.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 




 • Factory discovery studies: Spend 2–4 days at prospect/customer plants studying their
 



 manufacturing process — machine layout, cycle times, changeovers, bottlenecks, downtime
 



 patterns, quality losses.
 



 • Operator and supervisor conversations: Interview operators, supervisors, and maintenance teams
 



 to understand ground realities (not just what management believes is happening).
 



 • Loss analysis: Apply Lean / TPM thinking (16 major losses, OEE waterfall, 7 wastes) to quantify
 



 where the plant is losing money today.
 



 • Traceability discovery: Map the customers current traceability practices — route cards, registers,
 



 batch tags — identify gaps against their end\-customer/audit requirements (IATF, AS9100, export
 



 norms), and show how Yantra's Traceability solution closes them with quantified benefits: audit
 



 readiness, recall containment, and rejection root\-cause speed.
 



 • Pilot execution: Set up and run a Yantra pilot on one cell or line — work with our tech team on
 



 machine connectivity, define KPIs, monitor for 2–4 weeks, and validate improvement.
 



 • Business case \& presentation: Convert findings into a simple, numbers\-backed report and present
 



 the benefits to the customers leadership — “here is what you\&\#39;re losing, here is what Yantra found,here is the payback.”
 



 • Feed the product team: Bring shop\-floor insights back to our product and engineering team so the
 



 platform keeps getting better for SME realities.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For:** 




 •
 **3–5 years of hands\-on experience in a manufacturing plant — production, industrial engineering, or** 




**continuous improvement roles.** 




 • Working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, 5S, or Six Sigma (Green Belt or equivalent
 



 practical exposure preferred; certification not mandatory if you have real shop\-floor results).
 



 • Comfortable calculating and explaining OEE, cycle time, takt time, downtime Pareto, and
 



 changeover losses.
 



 •
 **Able to talk to a machine operator in Tamil and to an MD in a boardroom — and be credible with** 




**both.** 




 • Strong observation and documentation skills — you can walk a shop floor and come back with a
 



 structured picture, not just impressions.
 



 • Willingness to travel extensively (expect 10–15 days/month at customer sites).
 



 • Basic comfort with data — Excel analysis is a must; exposure to any MES/OEE/IoT software is a plus.
 



 • Exposure to quality systems and traceability requirements (IATF 16949, AS9100, PPAP, customer
 



 audits, batch/lot control) is a strong plus — especially if you have faced a customer audit or
 



 handled a rejection/recall investigation.
 



 • Diploma or B.E. in Mechanical / Production / Industrial Engineering or related field.
 



  





**What Makes This Role Different:** 




 • You will see dozens of factories a year instead of one — the fastest way to build genuine
 



 manufacturing breadth.
 



 • Shop floor \+ technology \+ business — a rare profile that most plant CI roles never develop.
 



 • Direct exposure to founders and customers; owners/MDs — your work directly closes deals.
 



 • Growth path into Solutions Consulting / Customer Success leadership as Yantra scales.
 



  





**Compensation:** 




 In line with Industry norms, plus travel expenses fully covered, with performance\-linked incentives tied
 



 to pilot conversions. Compensation reviews are linked to demonstrated impact, not tenure.

JOB OVERVIEW

We are looking for an experienced **Power BI Developer with Cloud Data Engineering Experience** to design, develop, and support enterprise Power BI analytics solutions using Databricks and AWS\-based data platforms.

The role is primarily focused on **Power BI and analytics delivery**, while also contributing to Databricks\-based data engineering activities such as data transformation, analytical data modelling, reporting dataset optimization, and modernization of legacy data logic.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, data architects, analytics engineers, governance teams, and technical teams to deliver intuitive dashboards, semantic models, governed reporting assets, and actionable insights.

The role covers the end\-to\-end analytics lifecycle, including requirements gathering, data modelling, Power BI development, deployment, performance optimization, governance, documentation, production support, and continuous improvement.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Design, develop, test, and deploy enterprise Power BI dashboards, reports, scorecards, semantic models, and reusable analytical solutions.
* Connect and integrate Power BI with Databricks SQL Warehouses, Delta Lake tables, governed views, and composite models.
* Partner with business stakeholders and product owners to translate KPIs, reporting requirements, and analytical questions into technical designs and delivery plans.
* Build scalable semantic models using star schemas, conformed dimensions, reusable measures, and clearly defined business logic.
* Develop advanced DAX measures, calculation groups, time\-intelligence logic, and Power Query transformations.
* Evaluate and optimize star, snowflake, and flattened data structures for performance, usability, and scalability.
* Design intuitive report experiences using drill\-through, bookmarks, tooltips, conditional formatting, mobile layouts, accessibility features, and user\-friendly navigation.
* Optimize Power BI reports and semantic models using **Power BI Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio, VertiPaq Analyzer, aggregations, query diagnostics, and incremental refresh**.
* Implement row\-level security, object\-level security, workspace security, application distribution, and governance controls.
* Publish and manage Power BI workspaces, semantic models, reports, apps, refresh schedules, gateways, and deployment pipelines.
* Develop paginated reports using **Power BI Report Builder** where required.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, regression testing, UAT support, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Support user enablement and continuous improvement of enterprise reporting solutions.
* Document report specifications, semantic model designs, KPI definitions, measure catalogs, data dictionaries, support guides, and reusable reporting standards.

Databricks \& Cloud Data Engineering

* Analyze existing data warehouse implementations and support migration, modernization, and consolidation initiatives.
* Reverse\-engineer legacy PL/SQL and SQL logic and translate business rules into scalable Spark SQL solutions within Databricks.
* Design and develop analytical data solutions using **AWS S3, Databricks, and Delta Lake**.
* Build and maintain ETL and ELT pipelines, ingestion frameworks, and transformation processes supporting reporting and analytics requirements.
* Collaborate with data architects to implement enterprise ingestion, transformation, and governance frameworks.
* Work with data engineering teams to define gold\-layer datasets and ensure data quality, lineage, and business\-rule consistency.
* Support **Unity Catalog, Medallion Architecture, Delta Lake table design, governed views, and cloud data warehouse design patterns**.
* Tune Spark SQL, Databricks notebooks, SQL Warehouses, pipelines, and table structures for performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Support CI/CD, Git, version control, release automation, DevOps practices, job scheduling, backup coordination, and production support.

Collaboration, Delivery \& Governance

* Participate in Agile ceremonies, roadmap planning, architecture reviews, sprint activities, production readiness reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, data architects, analytics engineers, governance teams, and support teams.
* Mentor developers through design reviews, code reviews, reusable engineering standards, Power BI best practices, and documentation standards.
* Promote consistency across reporting solutions by aligning semantic models, measures, data definitions, security, and release practices.
* Support governance, testing, documentation, and production readiness of enterprise analytics solutions.

REQUIRED SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Information Technology, or a related field.
* **6–10 years** of relevant experience across business intelligence, analytics delivery, and data engineering.
* **5\+ years of hands\-on Power BI development experience**, including dashboards, reports, semantic models, DAX, Power Query, Power BI Service, and enterprise deployment practices.
* **3\+ years of Databricks, Spark SQL, and Delta Lake experience** supporting enterprise analytics and reporting solutions.
* Strong experience integrating Power BI with **Databricks SQL Warehouses, Delta Lake tables, governed views, and cloud\-based data platforms**.
* Expert knowledge of **Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, Power BI Report Builder, DAX, Power Query, semantic modelling, dimensional modelling, and BI performance optimization**.
* Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills, including experience refactoring or migrating legacy warehouse logic into modern cloud analytics platforms.
* Proficiency in **Python, Scala, or Java**, with practical experience supporting data transformation and automation.
* Strong experience with **AWS S3, Databricks, Unity Catalog, Medallion Architecture, ETL/ELT, metadata management, and data warehouse design**.
* Experience with **Import mode, DirectQuery, composite models, query folding, incremental refresh, aggregations, and Power BI performance tuning**.
* Experience with **Git, CI/CD, REST APIs, deployment pipelines, Agile methodologies, governance, testing, and production support**.
* Strong stakeholder communication, requirements analysis, leadership, mentoring, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

PREFERRED / NICE\-TO\-HAVE SKILLS

* **Microsoft PL\-300 certification** is strongly preferred.
* **Databricks certification** is preferred or considered a strong plus.
* Experience designing enterprise\-scale analytics solutions using Power BI and Databricks.
* Experience supporting migration from legacy data warehouse platforms to modern cloud data platforms.
* Experience working across business intelligence, analytics engineering, and cloud data engineering functions.

Pay: ₹1,500,000\.00 \- ₹2,500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bangalore City, Bengaluru, Karnataka
