We are seeking an experienced Software Architect to lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and maintainable network automation systems.


This role focuses on building enterprise\-grade automation frameworks, driving standardization, and integrating best practices across CI/CD environments. The architect will define target architecture, automation patterns, and governance frameworks, while collaborating closely with platform, security, and engineering teams to align with business and technology strategy.


**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Strategy**

* Define the target automation architecture and roadmap aligned with enterprise goals
* Drive simplification, standardization, and reuse across platforms
* Evaluate and recommend strategic automation solutions based on emerging technologies and long\-term business needs

**2\. Business Alignment**

* Translate business and operational requirements into scalable automation designs
* Enable faster delivery of network services by reducing manual effort and increasing reliability
* Ensure automation initiatives align with business outcomes and operational priorities

**3\. Processes \& Engineering Excellence**

* Champion CI/CD strategies, GitOps practices, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC)
* Work with tools and frameworks such as:
* + Azure DevOps (ADO)
	+ Python
	+ Ansible
	+ Open Policy Agent (OPA)
	+ Containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes preferred)
* Define and enforce automation development standards (coding practices, SDLC)
* Drive:
* + Templating and modularization
	+ Version control and reusable automation frameworks
* Ensure consistent, scalable, and governed automation delivery across environments

**4\. People \& Talent**

* Mentor engineers on automation design, tooling, and best practices
* Promote a DevOps and automation\-first culture
* Support skill development through:
* + Training
	+ Documentation
	+ Knowledge\-sharing initiatives

**5\. Risk Management**

* Address technical debt and ensure secure automation architecture
* Embed security and compliance requirements within automation lifecycle
* Implement controlled deployment, testing, and rollback strategies to mitigate risk

**6\. Governance \& Standards**

* Define and enforce automation design principles and architectural standards
* Establish documentation frameworks ensuring traceability and auditability
* Govern automation pipelines, scripts, and configurations
Collaborate with security and platform teams to ensure regulatory compliance  
* 

**Core Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in:
* + Automation frameworks and architecture design
	+ CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
	+ Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC)
* Proficiency in:

* Experience with:

**Architecture \& Design**

* Experience in defining scalable, modular, and reusable automation architecture
* Strong understanding of standardisation and platform engineering principles

**Experience**

* Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise\-scale automation solutions
* Strong exposure to network automation and infrastructure environments
* Experience in banking or regulated industries preferred

020f9b43.title: Dev Ops or Cloud Engineer
020f9b43.description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 At Workday, the Community Team supports the collaboration and content website for our customers. The DevOps team is responsible for the infrastructure, deployment and operations of the systems used to manage and deploy code needed to maintain the Community website. We seek skilled and passionate engineers who proudly deliver quality code, effectively collaborate with various partners and love automation.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of Workday Community cloud production and development systems.
* Hands\-on in deploying, monitoring, automating and managing enterprise solutions and services in AWS.
* Supports the tools, infrastructure and monitoring that enables the software development lifecycle. Focus on developer efficiency, release velocity, and product quality.
* Maintain an accurate picture of existing server, storage, networking software/hardware and virtual environments to support scaling against various project requirements and production demands.
* Work closely with Dev and QA teams to build and support continuous integration and deployment tooling.


**About You**
****Basic Qualifications****
* 5\+ yrs of software, systems or networking development, with 2\+ of those years in a dedicated software or network automation role
* Ability to work in a flex position requiring overlap of work time to be done on US (Pacific Time) hours
* Comprehensive experience with AWS
* Possession of a solid understanding of CI/CD and be able to build infrastructure as code (IaC) with tools like Terraform and CloudFormation
* Solid experience with Amazon S3, RDS, IAM, Elasticache, CDN, and Route 53
* Understanding and proficiency in serverless environments such as EKS, ECS, and Fargate.
* Strong proficiency in shell scripting and Python
* Deep troubleshooting skills that involve analysis of logs, tracing traffic, verifying configuration data, and leveraging automation tools to resolve issues until end\-to\-end systems are functioning.
* Strong proficiency in Linux system administration and troubleshooting


**Other Qualifications**
* Experience with coding, code reviews, and troubleshooting infrastructure
* Experience with infrastructure provisioning tools such as GitHub in production environments with many nodes.
* Knowledgeable about security, networking, and RDBMS/Database technologies (Postgres, MySQL, Redis).
* Experience with restful services, cloud architecture, distributed systems, cloud system (AWS) and micro\-services.
* Strong vision to put pro\-active solutions in place to prevent future problems, and automate processes so that engineers can self\-service their operational requirements.
* Experience with deploying and maintaining Discourse and Drupal, as well as systems within Adobe Cloud


**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
   

  

 At Workday, we are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience where all candidates can fully demonstrate their skills. If you require assistance or an accommodation at any point, please email accommodations@workday.com.
   

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
 At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.
   

  

 Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.
   

  

 In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

**Overview**
 With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE\&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross\-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in\-product, digital, or human\-centered. Join CE\&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) to help customers migrate, modernize and secure their infrastructure, applications, and data on Microsoft Azure, laying the foundation for scalable, production\-ready AI solutions. As part of the Cloud \+ AI Infrastructure team, you’ll deliver engagements focused on migration, modernization, operational excellence and resilient architecture using frameworks like Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Well\-Architected Framework (WAF). You’ll leverage existing Repeatable IP and execution engines for critical milestones, ensure infrastructure, application, and database readiness for AI workloads, and ensure successful deployment that accelerates adoption. You’ll work closely with customer IT leaders to design and implement scalable solutions, resolve blockers, and accelerate adoption of Azure services through repeatable IP and delivery excellence. With deep expertise across Azure infrastructure, applications, databases, SAP, and hybrid environments, you’ll play a key role in helping customers unlock the full value of their Microsoft Azure investments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Lead architectural design sessions and deliver secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure solutions aligned to customer business goals using frameworks like CAF and WAF.
* Own the end\-to\-end technical delivery results, ensuring completeness and accuracy of consumption and customer success plans in collaboration with the CSAM.
* Drive migration and modernization initiatives, including committed proof of concept and production milestones, across infrastructure, data, SAP, and AI workloads.
* Ensure customer environments are optimized for health, resiliency, security, and performance—enabling production\-scale AI use cases.
* Deliver repeatable IP and contribute to centralized IP development to accelerate deployment and achieve targeted outcomes.
* Identify and resolve technical blockers to accelerate go\-live and ensure delivery excellence across key Factory engagements.
* Generate incremental pipeline from each engagement by driving next best actions and aligning with Unified Enterprise Support (ES) priorities.
* Maintain technical intensity through continuous skilling and certifications in priority workloads such as Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, AKS, App Service, AVS, SAP (Native \+ RISE), Windows, Linux and Defender for Cloud.
* Engage in technical communities, share best practices, and contribute to knowledge reuse to accelerate customer transformation and success.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 8\+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting
+ OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 8\+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting
+ OR equivalent experience

* 8\+ years experience working in a customer\-facing role (e.g., internal and/or external).
* 8\+ years experience working on technical projects
* Technical Certification in Cloud (e.g., Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google, security certifications)


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

82c8952c.title: Senior Solution Architect, Cloud Infrastructure-DevOps
82c8952c.description:
NVIDIA is the world leader in computer graphics, artificial intelligence, and accelerated computing. For over 25 years, we have been at the forefront of research and engineering around the greatest advances in technology. Our history of innovation drives us to solve the worlds hardest problems.
   

  

 NVIDIA is looking for Senior Cloud Infrastructure/DevOps Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyze, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop and maintain continuous integration and delivery pipelines .
* Develop tooling to automate deployment and management of large\-scale infrastructure environments, to automate operational monitoring and alerting, and to enable self\-service consumption of resources.
* Deploy monitoring solutions for the servers, network and storage.
* Perform troubleshooting bottom up from bare metal, operating system, software stack and application level.
* Being a technical resource, develop, re\-define and document standard methodologies to share with internal teams Support Research \& Development activities and engage in POCs/POVs for future improvements .


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, other Engineering fields with at least 8 years work or research experience in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, and data center architecture.
* 5\+ Years of Design, implement and maintain large scale HPC/AI clusters with monitoring, logging and alerting Manage Linux job/workload schedulers and orchestration tools.
* Knowledge of HPC and AI solution technologies from CPU’s and GPU’s to high speed interconnects and supporting software.
* Direct design, implementation and management experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Experience with job scheduling workloads and orchestration technologies such as Slurm, Kubernetes and Singularity.
* Excellent knowledge of Windows and Linux (Redhat/CentOS and Ubuntu) networking (sockets, firewalld, iptables, wireshark, etc.) and internals, ACLs and OS level security protection and common protocols e.g. TCP, DHCP, DNS, etc.
* Experience with multiple storage solutions such as Lustre, GPFS, zfs and xfs. Familiarity with newer and emerging storage technologies.
* Python programming and bash scripting experience. Comfortable with automation and configuration management tools including Jenkins, Ansible, Puppet/Chef, etc.
* Deep knowledge of Networking Protocols like InfiniBand, Ethernet Deep understanding and experience with virtual systems (for example VMware, Hyper\-V, KVM, or Citrix).
* Strong written, verbal, and listening skills in English are critical.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Knowledge of CPU and/or GPU architecture .
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, container related microservice technologies.
* Experience with GPU\-focused hardware/software (DGX, CUDA.)
* Background with RDMA (InfiniBand or RoCE) fabrics.


 NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking individuals in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you.

* Shape the future of a global, hybrid cloud platform supporting a 24/7 investment business.

876926c9.title: AWS Cloud Architect
876926c9.description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence!
   

  

**Overview**
 The AWS Cloud Architect is a senior strategic and technical leadership role responsible for the design, governance, and evolution of enterprise cloud architecture across multi\-region AWS environments. This position will drive the assessment and migration of legacy on\-premises workloads to cloud\-native architectures, define and enforce infrastructure and delivery standards, and govern hybrid environments that span both on\-premises data centres and AWS. Operating within the payments industry, the successful candidate will ensure all architectural decisions are aligned with organisational objectives, PCI DSS compliance obligations, and industry best practices. The role requires strong collaboration with engineering teams, operations, security, and executive stakeholders to define scalable, secure, and cost\-effective cloud strategies — while providing technical leadership, mentoring, and architectural governance across the broader engineering organisation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own the cloud architecture strategy across multi\-region AWS environments, ensuring alignment with business objectives, security requirements, and compliance obligations.
* Lead the planning and execution of cloud migration programmes, taking legacy on\-premises workloads through lift\-and\-shift and progressively re\-architecting them to cloud\-native patterns.
* Architect and govern hybrid environments spanning on\-premises data centres and AWS, including private connectivity, identity federation, hybrid DNS, and unified observability.
* Design highly available multi\-region architectures incorporating active\-active and active\-passive configurations, automated failover, global load balancing, and data replication strategies.
* Define infrastructure\-as\-code standards using Terraform and Terragrunt, including module governance, policy\-as\-code guardrails, and multi\-account state management strategies.
* Architect and oversee GitLab\-based CI/CD platforms, setting delivery standards for infrastructure and application pipelines across multiple engineering teams.
* Ensure all cloud architecture meets the compliance and regulatory requirements of the payments industry, including PCI DSS, SOC 2, and regional data sovereignty obligations.
* Produce and maintain architecture documentation, reference architectures, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and multi\-year technology roadmaps.
* Lead architecture review processes, providing technical governance across major engineering initiatives and acting as the final escalation point for complex infrastructure decisions.
* Mentor and uplift senior and mid\-level engineers, fostering a culture of architectural rigour, security\-first thinking, and continuous improvement.


**Essential Skills**
 Cloud Architecture \& AWS
   

  

* 8\+ years of cloud infrastructure or platform engineering experience, with at least 4 years in a senior architect or principal engineer capacity.
* Deep, broad AWS expertise spanning EC2, EKS, ECS, RDS Aurora, DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, IAM, KMS, WAF, Shield, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, and AWS Organizations.
* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional certification required; additional AWS specialty certifications (Networking, Security) highly regarded.
* Proven ability to produce clear, comprehensive architecture documentation and communicate architectural decisions to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.


 Multi\-Region Architecture
   

  

* Demonstrated experience designing and operating multi\-region AWS architectures including active\-active deployments, Route 53 global traffic management, and automated region failover.
* Deep knowledge of multi\-region data replication patterns including Aurora Global Clusters, DynamoDB Global Tables, and S3 Cross\-Region Replication.
* Experience defining and testing Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO), including regular DR testing and chaos engineering programmes.
* Understanding of data sovereignty, regulatory, and latency considerations that inform multi\-region deployment decisions.


 Migration: Lift \& Shift to Cloud Native
   

  

* End\-to\-end cloud migration programme experience from initial portfolio assessment and wave planning through to production cutover and post\-migration optimisation.
* Proficiency with migration frameworks such as the AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) and the 6 Rs (Rehost, Replatform, Repurchase, Refactor, Retire, Retain).
* Hands\-on experience with AWS migration tooling: Application Migration Service (MGN), Database Migration Service (DMS), Schema Conversion Tool (SCT), and DataSync.
* Experience migrating databases and messaging systems to managed AWS equivalents (e.g., Oracle to Aurora, on\-premises Kafka to Amazon MSK, RabbitMQ to Amazon MQ).
* Skilled at containerising legacy applications and progressively decomposing monolithic architectures into microservices deployed on EKS.


 Hybrid On\-Premises \& Cloud Environments
   

  

* Extensive experience designing hybrid cloud architectures integrating on\-premises infrastructure with AWS via Direct Connect and Site\-to\-Site VPN.
* Strong understanding of hybrid identity management including Active Directory integration, AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO), and federated authentication.
* Experience with hybrid DNS architecture using Route 53 Resolver, hybrid networking via Transit Gateway, and unified monitoring across on\-premises and cloud segments.
* Familiarity with on\-premises hypervisor platforms (VMware, Nutanix) and their integration or migration pathways into AWS.
* Ability to define consistent governance, tagging, cost allocation, and security posture management across mixed on\-premises and cloud estates.


 Infrastructure as Code — Terraform \& Terragrunt
   

  

* Advanced Terraform expertise including custom module frameworks, provider management, policy\-as\-code with Sentinel or OPA, and large\-scale multi\-account state management.
* Terragrunt proficiency for managing complex multi\-environment, multi\-account configurations with DRY principles and remote state strategies.
* Experience governing IaC across AWS Organizations using Service Control Policies (SCPs) and AWS Control Tower or Landing Zone frameworks.


 GitLab, Argo \& CI/CD
   

  

* Strong GitLab platform experience including pipeline architecture, GitLab Runners at scale, environment governance, and integration with AWS deployment targets.
* Argo CD experience for GitOps\-driven delivery and Argo Rollouts for progressive deployment strategies including blue/green and canary releases.
* Ability to define and govern platform\-wide CI/CD standards, enabling multiple product teams to deliver independently, safely, and consistently.


 Istio \& Service Mesh
   

  

* Architect\-level Istio expertise covering control plane configuration, sidecar injection, traffic policies, fault injection, and observability stack integration.
* Experience defining mTLS, RBAC, and Istio AuthorizationPolicies to enforce zero\-trust service communication across Kubernetes namespaces and clusters.


 Payments Industry \& Compliance
   

  

* 3\+ years of architecture experience within the payments industry or an equivalent regulated financial services environment.
* Deep familiarity with PCI DSS requirements as applied to multi\-region cloud architecture, including network segmentation, encryption, audit logging, and access control.
* Experience engaging with auditors, compliance officers, and risk teams to evidence architectural controls and support certification programmes.
* Understanding of payment processing ecosystems — acquiring, issuing, switching, or payment gateway infrastructure — is strongly preferred.


 Desirable Skills
   

  

* Experience with AWS Control Tower and Landing Zone for multi\-account governance and automated account vending at scale.
* Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimisation tooling such as AWS Cost Explorer.
* Familiarity with Argo Workflows and Argo Events for Kubernetes\-native pipeline orchestration and event\-driven automation.
* Observability stack experience, particularly in OpenTelemetry — particularly in multi\-region and hybrid contexts.
* Experience with HashiCorp Vault for enterprise secrets management including Kubernetes auth methods and dynamic credential issuance.
* Background in application security, threat modelling, or cloud security architecture using CSPM or CNAPP tooling.
* Exposure to additional cloud platforms (Azure, GCP) in a multi\-cloud or migration context.
* Experience with Helm or Kustomize for Kubernetes manifest management alongside Argo CD.


 Personal Attributes
   

  

* Visionary yet pragmatic — able to define a compelling long\-term architectural direction while making sensible, incremental decisions that account for business realities and delivery constraints.
* Exceptional communicator with the gravitas and clarity to influence senior stakeholders and the ability to translate complex architectural concepts for non\-technical audiences.
* Strong leadership presence — inspires confidence in engineering teams, fosters psychological safety, and leads by example in terms of quality and rigour.
* Collaborative by nature, with a track record of building effective relationships across engineering, security, operations, product, and executive functions.
* Deep sense of ownership and accountability — takes responsibility for architectural outcomes and is proactive in identifying and addressing technical risk.
* Highly security\-conscious, with a natural inclination to embed compliance and security thinking into every architectural decision.
* Intellectually curious and a continuous learner, staying ahead of developments in cloud technology, payments regulation, and infrastructure tooling.


 Calm under pressure with strong judgment in high\-stakes incident situations and the ability to make well\-reasoned decisions with incomplete information.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 If you are passionate about technology, love personal growth and opportunity, come see what TNS is all about!
   

  

 TNS is an equal opportunity employer. TNS evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

* Architect retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) patterns and semantic search solutions, selecting appropriate vector search, hybrid ranking, and grounding strategies for enterprise knowledge bases.

* Develop search relevance strategies including semantic ranking, vector embeddings, scoring profiles, synonym management, and domain\-specific tuning to improve precision and recall for business\-critical queries.

* Collaborate with application engineering teams to integrate search and GenAI capabilities into web portals, internal tools, and customer\-facing applications using appropriate SDKs and APIs.

* Conduct capacity planning and performance testing for search and GenAI workloads, predicting growth patterns and optimizing resource utilization across cloud environments.
* Create detailed technical documentation for architectures, configurations, and runbooks, enabling operations teams to support and evolve search platforms efficiently.
* Provide guidance on migration strategies from legacy search platforms to Azure AI Search and Copilot\-based solutions, minimizing disruption and ensuring continuity of critical services.
* Mentor junior engineers and architects on GenAI search technologies, design patterns, and best practices, fostering a culture of technical excellence and knowledge sharing.


\*\*Required Skills\*\*
  
* Hands\-on expertise with Azure AI Search (index design, skillsets, semantic and vector search, scoring profiles).
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot search, Graph connectors, and semantic index integration.
* Proven experience designing GenAI search solutions, including RAG architectures and embedding\-based retrieval.
* Strong background in search architecture and solution design for enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated client\-facing architecture and consulting engagement experience.

385f1d49.description:
Every day, Global Payments makes it possible for millions of people to move money between buyers and sellers using our payments solutions for credit, debit, prepaid and merchant services. Our worldwide team helps over 3 million companies, more than 1,300 financial institutions and over 600 million cardholders grow with confidence and achieve amazing results. Join our dynamic team and make your mark on the payments technology landscape of tomorrow.


**Summary of This Role**
------------------------


Combines software development and IT operations practices which shorten the systems delivery life cycle and provide a continuous delivery platform and complements the efficiencies of Agile software development methods. Builds and maintains the tooling and infrastructure used to automate the release, deployment, and upgrade processes. Ensures continuous, high velocity delivery and automated deployment through the use of software provisioning, configuration management, source code management and/or team collaboration applications.

**What Part Will You Play?**
----------------------------

* Lead design and implementation of infrastructure architecture for scalability, security, and performance.
* Own and manage cloud infrastructure strategy and cost optimization.
* Define and enforce DevOps standards and best practices.
* Architect and optimize CI/CD pipelines for high throughput and low latency.
* Drive incident response, root cause analysis, and postmortem reviews.
* Collaborate with security, development, and product teams on strategic initiatives.
* Evaluate and introduce new tools and technologies to the DevOps stack.
* Performs detailed review and participates in client requirement gathering for end solution.
* Acts as technology mentor and able to effectively cross\-train team on technologies and supported solutions.
* Designs and implements end\-to\-end clustered solutions using either in\-house or vendor technologies to meet business needs and client requirements.
* Acts as a level of support to troubleshoot and resolve technical problems in a timely and accurate manner to improve application performance, availability and functionality.
* Manages multiple concurrent projects or incidents seamlessly, adjusting priorities where needed to focus on rapid delivery of service.
* Stays abreast to changes in the industry, identifies potential impacts or enhancements and provides feedback to more senior team members and/or management. Implements standardized automation of procedures to mitigate risks associated with manual processing errors.

**What Are We Looking For in This Role?**
-----------------------------------------

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a technical discipline
* Typically Minimum of 4 years years of experience in IT with expertise in complex technology solutions

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Expert knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS preferred, Azure/GCP a plus).
* Proficiency with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi, Ansible).
* Deep understanding of CI/CD tools and practices.
* Strong experience with container ecosystems (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm).
* Excellent troubleshooting and performance tuning skills.

-------------------------------------------------

* Skills / Knowledge \- A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization; resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career\-oriented, journey\-level position.
* Job Complexity \- Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise.
* Supervision \- Normally receives little instruction on day\-to\-day work, general instructions on new assignments.

63226397.title: Sr Principal Architect
63226397.description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Purpose (Job Summary):** 
 The Senior Principal Application Architect within Enterprise Architecture will lead the development of architecture blueprints and support Solution Architects in their work. They will work with technology and business partners to develop strategies, multi\-year roadmaps, reference architecture, patterns and standards that support business domains. They will work with Solution Architects to define target‑state architectures that enable scale, resilience and data integrity while ensuring alignment to long\-term enterprise strategy.
   

  

 Additionally, the Enterprise Architect acts as a thought leader and mentor, advancing architectural maturity across the business domain and ensuring alignment between business strategy, technology investment, and enterprise outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities / Duties:**
* Develop and coordinate EA engagement across application architecture domains including Investments, Distribution and Corporate
* Build and maintain application architecture strategies, reference architectures and architecture roadmaps
* Establish application architecture patterns and standards for web applications, batch applications, event driven architecture, serverless application, containerized applications, domain API’s and microservices
* Review and approve architecture solutions via EA governance to ensure strategic alignment, avoidance of tech debt and alignment to architecture principles
* Support the solution architecture community
* Collaborate with domain solution architects and the cloud team on cloud application migration strategy
* Hands\-on support for PoCs to evaluate new technologies and usage patterns


**Work Experience / Knowledge:**
* Respected experience in an architecture role, supporting application architecture in sophisticated enterprise environments
* Experience with application design and development on one or more cloud platforms
* Experience with drafting and institutionalizing architecture patterns and architecture standards
* Good business understanding of financial services, distribution, and asset management
* Proficient with architecture modeling using industry standard notation languages (Archimate)
* Experience with software application development in multiple programming languages and technology platforms
* Experience with the design and development of API’s
* Experience with DevSecOps technologies, processes, and practices

* Ability to see the big picture, thinking and acting strategically
* Strong influence skills both directly and indirectly of individuals across the firm to embrace enterprise architecture standards and recommendations
* Ability to work independently; self\-starter/self\-motivated
* Excellent relationship leadership skills with the ability to act with influence and build consensus
* Excellent communication skills both verbal and written.
* High\-energy, confident professional with an ability to remain calm and take control in a crisis.
* Valued team mate, leader and organizer.
* Fully capable to diagnose and solve problems while maintaining integrity and courtesy.
* Open minded, flexible, and willing to listen for other people’s opinions.
* Adapts and leads to changing demands and conditions
* Willing to keep up to date and scale skills and knowledge base, as well as mentor others.


**Formal Education:**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science/information systems or related field or equivalent demonstrated experience.

* Preferred Certified TOGAF

 Full time

 Employee

 Yes

 In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each other’s identities, lives, health, and well\-being. We come together to create better solutions for our clients, our business and each other by building on different voices and perspectives. **What’s in it for you?**
 As an organization we support personal needs, diverse backgrounds and provide internal networks, as well as opportunities to get involved in the community and in the world.

* Represent Qlik as a Product/Technical expert with our partners and be responsible for partner enablement and evangelism of our products and solutions

* Excellent written communication skills, analytical skills and reporting to internal \& external stakeholders
* Proven experience of delivering technical solutioning and successful implementations leading to customer success
* Excellent presentation abilities and composure in front of all levels of technical and business customers or prospects.
* Ability to work as part of a virtual team in delivering enablement, workshops and presales support
* Strong technical and business awareness and ability to deliver on company \& team charter
* Industry sector knowledge preferred for at\-least one domain
* Be a team\-player \& have strong interpersonal and relationship skills
* Willingness to contribute new ideas and be proactive. Excellent analytical \& problem\-solving skills


**The location for this role is:**
 Bangalore / Mumbai, India (travel required across India and internationally as necessary

The GCP Data Architecture Lead is responsible for architecting and delivering large\-scale, enterprise\-grade data solutions using Google Cloud Platform technologies. This role drives the design, implementation, and governance of advanced data architectures, ensuring alignment with business objectives and industry best practices. The position provides strategic technical direction, fosters innovation, and champions the adoption of cutting\-edge cloud and AI solutions to enable data\-driven decision\-making across the organization.

e015208a.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
e015208a.description:
**Company Description** 




 Dentira is a vertically integrated procurement platform focused on the healthcare sector, offering end\-to\-end solutions that streamline purchasing and supply management for providers. Backed by a top\-tier venture capital investor, the company is positioned for long\-term growth and innovation. Dentira is growing 100\+% YoY and is already profitable, providing a stable environment with strong market traction. Team members join a fast\-paced, data\-driven organization that values ownership, collaboration, and impact in modernizing healthcare procurement.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We're looking for a modern\-age Technical Program Manager to own the execution layer of our
 



 procurement and vendor operations. This is not a roadmap\-and\-strategy product role — it's a role for
 



 someone who makes delivery happen: driving the team's day\-to\-day rhythm, keeping vendor
 



 commitments on track, and unblocking work before it stalls. You'll be the person who always knows the true status of every commitment, surfaces risk early, and turns “we should probably tell them” into a message that's already sent.
 



 But we mean modern\-age seriously. When you flag that something in a process or system is off, we
 



 don't want a paragraph buried in a thread — we want you to use AI tools to paint the picture that doesn't exist yet. Take the raw data, turn it into a chart, a dashboard, a one\-glance visual, and make the message loud and clear. This role is for someone who goes beyond the brief, not someone who waits for one.
 



 The technical requirement here is basic. You won't be writing production code or debugging systems in depth — but you should be willing to learn enough to triage a support escalation, glance at a failing
 



 request, or check a basic config before it reaches an engineer's plate. We'll hone the rest.
 



  





**What You will Own** 




 Run the team's delivery rhythm. Host scrum ceremonies (standups, planning, retros), keep the
 



 board honest, and make sure the team is always working on what matters most.
 



 •
 
 Prioritize and defend scope
 
 . Decide what's picked up now versus later, and push back — with
 



 evidence — on work that can wait. Sound prioritization here depends on staying in active contact with
 



 Support, Customer Success, Business, and other PMs to understand real\-world impact.
 



 •
 
 Own vendor programs
 
 . Drive meetings and communications with procurement vendors and external
 



 partners: set the agenda, keep them focused, capture what was agreed, and ensure it actually gets
 



 implemented and handed over on time.
 



 •
 
 Guard the deliverables
 
 . Track promised deliverables against reality. When something is on track,
 



 keep it quiet and moving. When it's slipping, raise it early and communicate proactively — internally
 



 and to vendors.
 



 •
 
 Make the invisible visible
 
 . When you spot something off in a process, system, or vendor's
 



 performance, don't just describe it — show it. Use AI tools to turn raw, scattered data into a clear
 



 visual, dashboard, or model that makes the problem (and the case for fixing it) impossible to miss.
 



 •
 
 Surface and solve pain
 
 . Identify recurring friction and operational pain across the team and its
 



 stakeholders, bring it to the Team Lead, and work jointly toward the right solution rather than just filing
 



 a ticket.
 



 •
 
 Filter the support funnel
 
 . Triage inbound support and operational asks. Do the basic first\-level
 



 checks, then resolve or correctly route issues so engineers only see what genuinely needs them.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





**Non\-negotiables** 




 •
 
 Exceptional communication
 
 . You run meetings that end with clear decisions and owners. You write
 



 follow\-ups people actually read. You're comfortable driving conversations with external partners and
 



 senior stakeholders, and you close the loop every time.
 



 •
 
 Cross\-cultural fluency
 
 . Our partners and teammates span the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand,
 



 France, the UK, Belgium, Germany, and India — and our European footprint is still growing. You
 



 communicate clearly and work smoothly across time zones and cultures without friction.
 



 •
 
 Deep ownership
 
 — nothing gets handed to you. You treat every commitment as yours until it's
 



 shipped. Nobody will spec your work, build your tools, or hand you a process to follow — you're
 



 expected to define your own and take the problem the rest of the way. You chase status, you escalate
 



 before it's a fire, and you don't let things fall through the cracks. “I didn't know it was blocked” is not a
 



 phrase you use.
 



 •
 
 AI\-native by default
 
 . You reach for AI tooling as a first instinct — to draft comms, summarize threads,
 



 triage tickets, and, above all, to build things that don't exist yet: visuals, dashboards, and models that
 



 make a problem land. You build your own workflows and go beyond the brief; you don't wait for tools to be handed to you.
 



 •
 
 Tooling and process discipline
 
 . You're strong with Excel — tracking, filtering, pivoting, and turning a
 



 messy status into a clear picture. You know Jira well and keep a board honest. You've worked in
 



 scrum\-based Agile teams and understand the ceremonies in practice, not just theory.
 



 •
 
 Willing to learn the basics
 
 . Only a very basic level of technical comfort is required up front — enough
 



 to read a simple log or request and know when something is genuinely an engineering problem versus
 



 something you can resolve or route yourself. We'll hone the rest.
 



  





**Strong signals** 




 •
 
 Prior experience
 
 as a TPM, Program Manager, Delivery Manager, Product Owner, or an
 



 engineer/support lead who moved into coordination.
 



 • Experience managing procurement, vendor, or external partner relationships.
 



 • Comfort with Slack and monitoring/status dashboards.
 



 • Background in healthcare, B2B SaaS, or another regulated / reliability\-critical domain.
 



  





**What This Role Is Not** 




 To set clear expectations: this is a delivery\- and execution\-focused role, not a product strategy role. You will strongly influence what gets prioritized and surface the problems worth solving — but product
 



 direction is set jointly with the Team Lead. If your ambition is to own product vision and roadmap end to end, this specific role isn't that (though there's room to grow toward more product ownership over time for the right person).

01730330.title: Principal Partner Solutions Architect
01730330.description:
**What makes us Qlik?**  

AGartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader for 15 years in a row, Qlik transforms complex data landscapes into actionable insights, driving strategic business outcomes. Serving over 40,000 global customers, our portfolio leverages pervasive data quality and advanced AI/ML capabilities that lead to better decisions, faster.  

We excel in integration and governance solutions that work with diverse data sources, and our real\-time analytics uncover hidden patterns, empowering teams to address complex challenges and seize new opportunities. **The Principal Partner Solutions Architect Role**  

  

Principal Partner Solutions Architect will be primarily responsible for establishing mutual solution vision and technical integration across product offerings with both new and future strategic partners. By fostering deeper integration with our technology partners, we will be able to expand our reach into key enterprise level opportunities and, more importantly, create more effective solutions to help address the customer's requirements.  

Qlik is rapidly growing our system Integrators Go to Market Initiatives. GSI’s are a integral part of our business to help customers unlock the Power of Data. We are looking for a self\-driven go\-getter to help grow these GSI’s into profitable revenue streams and accelerate the growth of the business.  

Success in this position requires the candidate to be a ninja at managing relationships, execute programs, set goals and metrics, track and ensure progress. The candidate will also need help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share among Qlik’s SI Partners. **What makes this role interesting?**  

  

* **Engage with high\-profile customers and partners:** Lead technical discussions and showcase innovative solutions to help organizations unlock the true power of their data.
* **Drive business success with cutting\-edge technology:** Leverage Qlik’s next\-generation data analytics and data integration platform to solve complex business challenges.
* **Be at the forefront of industry trends:** Stay ahead of the game by keeping up with the latest advancements in data analytics, as well as the competitive landscape.
* **Collaborate with cross\-functional teams:** Work closely with internal teams and experts across Sales, Marketing, R\&D, and Customer Success to build compelling solutions that resonate with customers.
* **Flexibility and agility:** Thrive in an environment that values adaptability, innovation, and dynamic thinking.

 **Here’s how you’ll be making an impact:**

68a5fd1d.title: Associate Manager - Digital Strategy & Solutions
68a5fd1d.description:
We are a technology\-led healthcare solutions provider. We are driven by our purpose to enable healthcare organizations to be future\-ready. We offer accelerated, global growth opportunities for talent that’s bold, industrious, and nimble. With Indegene, you gain a unique career experience that celebrates entrepreneurship and is guided by passion, innovation, collaboration, and empathy. To explore exciting opportunities at the convergence of healthcare and technology, check out www.careers.indegene.com
 



  





 Looking to jump\-start your career?
 



  





 We understand how important the first few years of your career are, which create the foundation of your entire professional journey. At Indegene, we promise you a differentiated career experience. You will not only work at the exciting intersection of healthcare and technology but also will be mentored by some of the most brilliant minds in the industry. We are offering a global fast\-track career where you can grow along with Indegene’s high\-speed growth.
 



  





 We are purpose\-driven. We enable healthcare organizations to be future ready and our customer obsession is our driving force. We ensure that our customers achieve what they truly want. We are bold in our actions, nimble in our decision\-making, and industrious in the way we work.
 



  





 If this excites you, then apply below.
 



  





 About Indegene
 



  





 We are a technology\-led healthcare solutions provider driven by our purpose to enable healthcare organizations to become future\-ready. At Indegene, you will work at the intersection of healthcare, technology and innovation, while gaining exposure to global clients, experienced industry leaders and high\-impact transformation programs.
 



 We value entrepreneurship, collaboration, empathy and continuous learning. If this excites you, apply below.
 



  





 Role Description
 



  





 We are seeking a Lead/AM/Manager – Digital Strategy and Solutions to lead
 **strategic solutioning, solution packaging, executive storytelling and digital transformation initiatives** 
 for life sciences clients.
 



 The role will work across business, technology, operations and commercial teams to convert client needs into
 **clear, scalable and commercially viable solutions** 
 . The individual will support proposals, RFPs, client workshops, capability development, pilots and strategic transformation programs.
 



 The role requires the ability to move from an early\-stage idea to a
 **well\-structured solution, compelling client narrative and implementation roadmap** 
 .
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Strategy and Solutioning
 



  




* Lead the design and execution of strategic digital transformation initiatives.
* Translate business challenges into scalable digital solutions and operating models.
* **Structure ambiguous client requirements into clear use cases, workflows, capabilities and roadmaps.**
* **Recommend suitable solution approaches based on client maturity, existing technology and transformation readiness.**
* Identify operational gaps and define opportunities for process improvement, automation and AI adoption.



  





 Solution Packaging and Commercialization
 



  




* Develop solution frameworks for proposals, RFPs and client engagements.
* **Package capabilities, platforms, accelerators and delivery experience into repeatable offerings.**
* **Define the solution scope, value proposition, differentiators, outcomes and delivery approach.**
* **Work with pricing, delivery and finance teams to ensure solutions are commercially practical.**
* **Create reusable assets such as playbooks, assessment frameworks, use\-case libraries and reference architectures.**



  





 Storytelling and Client Engagement
 



  




* **Develop executive\-ready narratives for client pitches, proposals, analyst briefings and capability presentations.**
* **Convert complex business and technology concepts into clear and easy\-to\-understand stories.**
* **Partner with design teams to create simple, visual and impactful presentations.**
* Support client workshops, presentation preparation and leadership discussions.
* **Prepare talking points, scripts and responses for strategic client meetings and oral presentations.**



  





 Proposals and GTM Support
 



  




* Lead or support RFPs, RFIs, proactive proposals and strategic pursuits.
* **Bring together inputs from domain, technology, delivery, creative and commercial teams.**
* **Ensure that proposals communicate one connected solution story rather than a list of disconnected capabilities.**
* **Support the development of pilots, demonstrations, case studies and sales\-enablement content.**
* Capture client and market feedback to improve future solution offerings.



  





 AI and Emerging Solutions
 



  




* Stay current on developments in AI, GenAI, automation, analytics and digital platforms.
* **Identify opportunities to redesign end\-to\-end workflows using AI and agentic solutions.**
* **Shape solutions across content, customer engagement, commercial operations, market research and knowledge management.**
* **Consider data readiness, governance, evaluation, integration and human oversight while designing AI solutions.**
* Balance innovation with feasibility, compliance and business value.



  





 Delivery and Team Leadership
 



  




* Manage transformation initiatives and ensure timely delivery and measurable outcomes.
* Define and track KPIs aligned to client and organizational goals.
* Ensure quality, governance and compliance across solution delivery.
* Build and manage cross\-functional teams across strategy, operations and technology.
* Mentor team members and support capability development.
* **Coach teams on problem structuring, solution design, proposal development and executive storytelling.**



  





 Desired Profile
 



  




* 4–12 years of experience in digital strategy, consulting, solutioning, pre\-sales or transformation roles.
* **Experience in life sciences, healthcare or another regulated industry is preferred.**
* Strong experience in client engagement, proposals, RFPs and transformation programs.
* **Proven ability to convert business requirements into structured solutions and client\-ready narratives.**
* **Experience in packaging services, platforms or capabilities into differentiated offerings.**
* Working knowledge of digital platforms, automation, analytics, AI and enterprise technologies.
* **Understanding of life sciences commercial areas such as CRM, marketing automation, content operations, customer data and digital analytics.**
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, presentation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to balance business, technology, operational and commercial considerations.
* Experience managing cross\-functional and global teams.
* Ability to work effectively in fast\-paced and ambiguous environments.
* MBA or Engineering background preferred. Consulting or GTM experience will be an advantage.



  





 Equal Opportunity
 



  





 Indegene is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and diversity.
 



 All employment decisions are based on business requirements, candidate merit and qualifications. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without discrimination based on race, religion, sex, colour, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

702fd853.title: Presales Engineer - Android
702fd853.description:
**About The Company**
 At Wiseasy, we're not just leading the charge in payment innovation; we're redefining it. Our mission is to empower and integrate global innovation in Intelligent Payments. We do this by specializing in cutting\-edge 'SMART' terminals and comprehensive payment technology services.
   

  

 Our full suite of enterprise solutions, encompassing "Cloud \+ Software \+ Terminals," is designed to transform the landscape of financial transactions. We are the catalysts for change in the payments space, enabling banks, acquirers, fintech companies, telecom operators, and Industry Solution Providers (ISVs) to offer a spectrum of financial services and create new revenue streams. These services are tailored to enhance cost\-efficiency, operational effectiveness, and raise the bar of customer satisfaction.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Presales Engineer (Android) at Wiseasy, based in India, you will play a crucial role in driving the adoption of our innovative payment solutions across the region. This is a client\-facing role where you will support customers and business partners — including resellers, distributors, and system integrators — by developing demo applications and Proof of Concept (PoC) solutions using Android SDK resources, tools, and technical expertise to effectively promote, sell, and support our products and services. The primary goal is to strengthen our customer and partner ecosystem and drive mutual success. This role requires approximately 15–20% travel within India and potentially across the APAC region.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* At least 2–3 years of experience in Android development or a Technical Support role, preferably in fintech or the card\-present transaction domain.
* Prior experience with Android POS terminals, payment gateways, and EMV specifications is a strong advantage.
* Proficiency in Java, Kotlin, or Flutter, with hands\-on experience in Android Studio or similar IDEs.
* Familiarity with India's payments ecosystem (UPI, NPCI, RuPay, Aadhaar\-based authentication) is a plus.
* Strong technical acumen with the ability to understand and troubleshoot software issues independently.
* Excellent communication skills in English; proficiency in Hindi or other regional Indian languages is an advantage. Mandarin communication skills will also be considered a plus.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, multicultural, and multilingual environment while managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on building long\-term customer relationships.


**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with the Sales team to identify new business opportunities and drive customer acquisition across the Indian market.
* Engage with customers and business partners to understand technical requirements and propose appropriate solutions.
* Develop demonstrative applications to validate customer\-specified proof of concepts.
* Ensure seamless integration of our SDKs and APIs into clients' applications by analyzing logs and technical documents.
* Conduct training sessions and workshops to educate customers on our products and solutions.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and provide timely, effective resolutions.
* Stay informed on India's digital payments landscape, including UPI, RuPay, and regulatory frameworks such as RBI guidelines, to better contextualize Wiseasy solutions for local clients.


**Benefits**
 Wiseasy offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' professional growth and personal well\-being. You will have access to competitive salary packages, performance\-based incentives, and opportunities for career advancement within a global organization. We provide health insurance coverage, including medical, dental, and vision plans, to ensure your health needs are met. Our company also offers flexible working hours and a collaborative work environment that encourages innovation and continuous learning. Additionally, employees benefit from ongoing training programs, technical certifications, and exposure to cutting\-edge payment technologies, enabling you to stay ahead in the rapidly evolving fintech landscape.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 Wiseasy is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse team drives innovation and success, and we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Our hiring practices are designed to ensure fairness and promote a culture of respect and collaboration across all levels of the organization.

983ed4e9.title: Teamhead Cloud Native Platform Engineering
983ed4e9.description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.


  
**Your mission**
----------------


The Teamhead Cloud Native Engineering leads a team of 4 engineers and reports directly to the Head of Cloud Native Platforms in Herzogenaurach. This role carries full responsibility for the team’s cloud engineering output, direction, and quality.


A Cloud Engineer designs, implements, and manages cloud landing zones to ensure they are scalable, reliable, and secure. They work with cloud service providers like Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure to deploy and optimize cloud resources


**Key Responsibilities \& Scope of Ownership:**


* Lead the design and implementation of complex cloud solutions on Azure and GCP following the architectural framework.
* Oversee and optimize the deployment and management of applications on our global cloud platforms.
* Manage and enhance the security, reliability, and cost\-effectiveness of cloud infrastructure.
* Continuously monitor and strategically optimize resources for peak performance.
* Develop and enforce advanced security measures to safeguard data and applications.
* Design and implement automation strategies using tools like Terraform or Ansible.
* Diagnose and resolve complex issues in the cloud environment efficiently.
* Evaluate and oversee the impact of changes on existing cloud solutions and guiding team members through complex modifications.
* Create documentation of technical concepts that enhance team understanding and support strategic decision\-making.
* Lead collaboration efforts with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless cloud integration.
* Mentor junior team members.
**Your talent**
---------------


**Key Requirements:**


* Several years of experience in cloud engineering, with proven hands\-on expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and/or Microsoft Azure.
* Strong understanding of cloud\-native architecture principles including containerisation (Kubernetes, Docker) and microservices.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible for automated provisioning and configuration management.
* Solid knowledge of cloud security best practices, identity and access management, and data protection standards.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices for continuous delivery and automated testing.
* Strong monitoring and observability skills using tools such as Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, Grafana, or equivalent.
* Ability to lead and mentor a team of engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to document complex technical concepts clearly for diverse audiences.
* Deep knowledge of Microsoft CAF / Google FAST / Landing zone principles

**Key Technologies:**


* **Cloud Platforms:** Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Terraform, Ansible
* **Containerisation \& Orchestration**: Kubernetes, Docker
* **CI/CD:** GitHub Actions, Jenkins
* **Monitoring \& Observability:** Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations
* **Security**: Azure Security Center, IAM, encryption, compliance frameworks
* **Networking \& Storage:** VNet, VPC, load balancing, blob/object storage, managed databases
* **Scripting \& Automation:** Python, Bash, PowerShell

**Leadership Expectations:**


At PUMA, engineering leaders are expected to shape strategy, build capability, and create an environment where teams can deliver exceptional outcomes at speed and scale. Successful leaders combine technical excellence and people leadership while embodying the mindset and behaviours that define PUMA’s culture.


**Strategic Thinking \& Vision**


* Translate ambitious business goals into clear, executable technology strategies and roadmaps.
* Demonstrate the courage to challenge conventional thinking and advocate for innovative solutions that create long\-term value.
* Operate effectively in ambiguity, providing clarity, direction, and confidence for teams and stakeholders.
* Balance immediate business priorities with long\-term scalability, sustainability, and consumer impact.
* Ability to define and drive OKRs

**Ownership \& Accountability**


* Take end\-to\-end ownership of outcomes, driving execution with determination and a relentless focus on results.
* Set high standards for quality, reliability, and operational excellence while fostering a culture of accountability.
* Navigate setbacks and changing priorities with resilience, maintaining momentum through complexity and uncertainty.
* Make difficult decisions when required and stand behind them with conviction and integrity.

**People \& Team Leadership**


* Build, grow, and retain diverse, high\-performing teams that can deliver effectively at scale.
* Foster a culture of open, two\-way feeback (upwards and downwards)
* Create a culture of trust, inclusion, collaboration, and mutual respect where people can do their best work.
* Support learning, growth, and ongoing development while giving teams the autonomy and accountability to succeed.
* Recognise achievements, celebrate success, and nurture a culture where strong performance and enjoyment coexist.

**Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management**


* Develop strong partnerships across Product, Design, Data, Marketing, Operations, and Business teams to deliver shared outcomes.
* Influence stakeholders at all levels through credibility, openness, and clear communication.
* Show confidence in decisions while staying receptive to challenge, feedback, and different viewpoints.
* Lead with a team\-first approach, removing silos and encouraging collaboration across functions and regions.

**Innovation \& Continuous Learning**


* Promote modern engineering practices, AI\-native ways of working, and a mindset of experimentation.
* Encourage curiosity, continuous learning, and thoughtful risk\-taking to uncover new opportunities for consumers and the business.
* Make room for innovation while maintaining discipline in execution and delivery.
* Continuously elevate engineering excellence, operational maturity, and the consumer experience.

**Commercial \& Consumer Mindset**


* Understand how technology decisions influence consumer experience and business results.
* Make decisions that strike the right balance between innovation, speed, quality, and commercial value.
* Keep a strong consumer\-first perspective, ensuring technology investments deliver meaningful value.
* Apply sound judgment and confidence when turning business priorities into engineering outcomes.

**Building PUMA's Future**


* Serve as a visible culture champion and role model as PUMA continues to grow its Global Tech Engineering organisation.
* Embrace the chance to build teams, capabilities, and ways of working from the ground up.
* Lead with energy, optimism, and purpose, inspiring others around a shared vision and ambitious goals.
* Build an environment where bold thinking, determination, collaboration, and enjoyment are all part of achieving success.
**Our principles**
------------------


PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.


At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.


PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

17f7e754.title: Cloud Engineer
17f7e754.description:
**About The Company**
 HCLTech is a leading global technology company renowned for its innovative solutions and comprehensive IT services. With a rich history spanning several decades, HCLTech has established itself as a trusted partner for organizations across various industries, including banking, retail, healthcare, telecom, manufacturing, and technology. The company specializes in digital transformation, cloud computing, data analytics, AI, and enterprise modernization, helping clients achieve operational excellence and competitive advantage. Committed to fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning, HCLTech invests heavily in cutting\-edge technology and talent development to deliver impactful solutions that drive business growth and efficiency worldwide.
   

  

**About The Role**
 HCLTech is seeking a highly skilled Google Cloud Solutions Engineer / Architect to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and engineering cloud solutions that facilitate the adoption of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) at an enterprise level. Your expertise will enable Fortune 2000 clients to migrate, modernize, and optimize their IT infrastructure, leveraging advanced data engineering and AI\-driven automation use cases. You will collaborate closely with global sales teams, technical architects, and strategic partners to develop compelling go\-to\-market strategies, create innovative solution approaches, and secure customer wins across diverse industries such as banking, retail, healthcare, and telecom. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work on high\-impact projects, shape cloud transformation initiatives, and contribute to the growth of cloud adoption within large organizations.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate will possess a strong educational background with a B.E. or B.Tech degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields. You should have a minimum of 5 to 7 years of overall IT experience, with at least 2\-3 years dedicated to working on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Technical proficiency in GCP compute, storage, and networking is essential, along with high\-level expertise in data engineering, including enterprise data warehouses and business intelligence tools such as BigQuery and Looker. A foundational understanding of AI/ML platforms, including Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI, as well as familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), is desirable. The candidate should have demonstrated experience working with global system integrator partners, especially in building joint solutions and scaling go\-to\-market strategies. Excellent soft skills, including executive presence, effective whiteboarding, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value, are crucial. Certifications such as Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, or Machine Learning Engineer are preferred.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Pre\-Sales \& Go\-To\-Market (GTM):**
* Collaborate with global sales teams and Google Cloud Architects to respond to RFIs and RFPs, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and strategic objectives.
* Develop ROI models and hyperscale funding strategies that demonstrate TCO benefits and drive cloud adoption.
* Design industry\-specific use cases for IT managed services, focusing on cloud migration, modernization, and digital transformation initiatives.


**Cloud Architecture \& Solutions Engineering**
* Lead technical workshops to define and design reference architectures for data center migration and modernization projects on Google Cloud.
* Create enterprise\-grade data engineering solutions utilizing GCP native services like BigQuery, Looker, and Vertex AI.
* Innovate and design AI solutions such as Gemini Enterprise Agentic AI and Generative AI (GenAI) to accelerate IT managed services, cloud operations, and engineering functions.


**Partner Collaboration**
* Work closely with Google GSI partners to develop joint solutions, scale go\-to\-market efforts, and expand solution footprints.
* Leverage industry domain expertise, particularly in BFSI, RCPG, telecom, healthcare, life sciences, manufacturing, or technology sectors, to map value stream use cases and tailor solutions accordingly.


**Benefits**
 HCLTech offers a competitive compensation package along with comprehensive benefits including health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off. Employees have access to ongoing learning and development programs, certifications, and opportunities for career advancement within a global organization. The company fosters a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages innovation, knowledge sharing, and professional growth. Additionally, employees benefit from exposure to cutting\-edge technologies and large\-scale projects that make a tangible impact on clients’ digital transformation journeys.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 HCLTech is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diverse perspectives foster innovation and drive better business outcomes. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply and will be considered based on merit and experience.
