535024f6.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
535024f6.description:
**Description**
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**You're Our Person If...**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

48508c50.title: RTR Solution Architect
48508c50.description:
**RTR Solution Architect** 




**Experience\-12\+ Years** 




**Location\-Hyderabad** 




  





**Role Overview:** 




  





 We are looking for a Record\-to\-Report (RTR) Architect to lead the design of financial close, reporting, and consolidation solutions on SAP FI/CO / S/4HANA Finance. This role requires deep expertise in financial accounting, group/statutory reporting, and multi\-GAAP compliance, along with hands\-on experience delivering solutions across US and EU entities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Own the end\-to\-end RTR solution architecture — General Ledger, Asset Accounting, Financial Close, Intercompany, and Group/Statutory Reporting — within SAP FI/CO / S/4HANA Finance.
* Lead blueprint and fit\-gap workshops with US and EU finance stakeholders, ensuring designs support US GAAP alongside EU statutory/IFRS/local GAAP requirements, multi\-currency, and country\-specific tax and legal reporting.
* Define the integration architecture between FI/CO and upstream modules (SD, MM, PP) as well as reporting and consolidation tools (SAP Group Reporting, BPC, or equivalent).
* Drive global template design and localization strategy for statutory reporting, tax compliance (e.g., e\-invoicing/SAF\-T style requirements in EU, 1099/sales tax in the US), and chart of accounts harmonization across regions.
* Review functional specifications and WRICEF objects for the finance workstream, ensuring architectural consistency, auditability, and compliance.
* Lead architecture review boards for the finance track, resolving cross\-module design conflicts and maintaining design authority documentation.
* Own solution design across the full project lifecycle — blueprint, realization, testing, cutover, and hyper care — for large multi\-country SAP finance transformation programs, including Central Finance and S/4HANA conversions.
* Mentor RTR functional consultants and act as the escalation point for complex financial close and reporting design issues.
* Partner closely with OTC, SCM, and technical architects, as well as controllership and tax teams, to ensure a fully integrated financial solution.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 




  




* 12\+ years of SAP FI/CO experience with a focus on Record\-to\-Report, including at least 3\-4 full lifecycle implementations as a solution architect or lead.
* Proven experience delivering RTR solutions for both US and EU legal entities, with working knowledge of US GAAP, IFRS, and EU statutory/local GAAP reporting requirements.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in General Ledger, Asset Accounting, New GL, financial close processes, intercompany reconciliation, and multi\-currency/multi\-ledger design.
* Experience with S/4HANA Finance, Central Finance, and SAP Group Reporting or BPC for consolidation.
* Demonstrated experience integrating FI/CO with SD, MM, tax engines, and statutory/e\-invoicing reporting tools relevant to EU jurisdictions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to finance leadership (Controllers, CFO office) across multiple regions.
* Solid understanding of global template design, chart of accounts strategy, and rollout methodology for multinational finance transformations.



  





**Preferred / Good to Have:** 




  




* SAP S/4HANA Finance certification.
* Experience with SAP Central Finance for phased S/4HANA migration.
* Exposure to tax/compliance automation tools (Vertex, OneSource, e\-invoicing platforms).
* Prior experience in a Big 4 or systems integrator consulting environment delivering to large enterprise clients.



  





**Education:** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field; CA / CPA / MBA (Finance) is a plus.

7e5c5a42.title: Program Architect
7e5c5a42.description:
**Programme Architect – Enterprise \& Multi\-Cloud Transformation** 




  





 OSF Digital is a global digital transformation and AI consultancy, helping organisations create better customer experiences through Salesforce, data, AI and cloud technologies. As a leading Salesforce partner for more than 20 years, we work with some of the world's best\-known brands to deliver innovative, scalable solutions across commerce, customer engagement, marketing and enterprise platforms.
 



 With teams across North America, Europe, Asia\-Pacific and Latin America, we combine global expertise with local delivery to help organisations solve complex business challenges and achieve measurable business outcomes.
 



  





**Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Programme Architect** 
 to provide architecture leadership across large\-scale enterprise transformation programmes within the ROAPAC business unit.
 



  





 This is a strategic role responsible for defining end\-to\-end solution architecture, governing technical decisions across multiple workstreams, and ensuring all solutions align to a unified target architecture. Working closely with customers, Solution Architects, Technical Architects and delivery teams, you will provide architectural leadership across complex, multi\-cloud Salesforce programmes.
 



  





 While Salesforce Commerce Cloud is an important part of many of our programmes, we're looking for someone who can think beyond a single platform and provide architectural leadership across the broader enterprise landscape.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the overall programme architecture across multiple workstreams.
* Define and govern the end\-to\-end target architecture throughout the programme lifecycle.
* Provide architectural leadership across Salesforce, integration, mobile and enterprise platforms.
* Drive architecture governance, design reviews and cross\-workstream decision making.
* Identify architectural risks, dependencies and integration challenges.
* Act as a trusted advisor to customers and executive stakeholders.
* Mentor Solution Architects and Technical Architects while helping establish architecture standards and reusable delivery frameworks.
* Support pre\-sales activities, solution design and technical strategy.



  





**Skills \& Experience** 



* Significant experience as a Programme Architect, Enterprise Architect, Lead Solution Architect or similar strategic architecture role.
* Experience leading architecture across large\-scale enterprise transformation or multi\-cloud programmes.
* Strong Salesforce ecosystem knowledge, with experience across multiple clouds (Commerce Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, Data Cloud or similar).
* Strong understanding of enterprise integration, API\-led architecture and solution governance.
* Ability to connect multiple technologies, challenge solution designs and balance technical, business and delivery priorities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical teams and executive stakeholders.
* Experience mentoring architects and leading distributed delivery teams.



  





**Why Join OSF Digital?** 



* Lead architecture for enterprise transformation programmes with globally recognised brands.
* Shape the future of our multi\-cloud architecture practice.
* Work alongside global teams delivering innovative Salesforce, AI and digital transformation solutions.
* Help define architecture standards while mentoring the next generation of architects.



  





 If this sounds of interest, please feel free to reach out for a confidential conversation.

**Company Description** 
 AI Vidya is a training and career enablement organization focused on developing future leaders in artificial intelligence. The company provides personalized AI training programs designed to help individuals build practical, industry\-relevant skills. With dedicated job assistance and expert guidance, AI Vidya supports learners throughout their career journey in the digital age. The organization emphasizes confidence\-building, skill mastery, and ongoing mentorship to help participants thrive in the fast\-paced world of AI. Joining AI Vidya means being part of a community that aims to lead and innovate in the evolving AI landscape.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time remote Cloud Engineer role. The Cloud Engineer will design, build, and maintain cloud\-based infrastructure to support AI Vidya’s training platforms and internal systems. Responsibilities include implementing scalable and secure cloud solutions, managing Linux\-based servers, configuring and monitoring databases, and optimizing performance and reliability across environments. The role involves collaborating with software development teams to deploy applications, automate workflows, and improve CI/CD pipelines. The Cloud Engineer will also troubleshoot production issues, implement best practices for security and cost optimization, and contribute to documentation and operational standards.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong foundation in Cloud Computing and Infrastructure, including experience with major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and infrastructure\-as\-code tools.
* Proficiency in Linux administration and systems management, including monitoring, security hardening, and automation using shell scripting or similar tools.
* Hands\-on experience with Databases (SQL and/or NoSQL), including configuration, performance tuning, backup strategies, and high availability.
* Software Development skills with at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version control (e.g., Git).
* Understanding of networking concepts (VPCs, subnets, load balancers, firewalls) and cloud security best practices.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and prior exposure to AI or data platforms is a plus.

e023f93e.description:
Job Title: Senior Cloud Engineer \- Azure
   

  

 Location: Bangalore (WFO)
   

  

 Experience: 5\-6 years
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Engineer \- Azure to lead the design, deployment, and support of enterprise Azure environments. This role involves managing complex Azure infrastructure, handling advanced incident resolutions, driving automation initiatives, and providing technical leadership within the operations team.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has deep hands\-on Azure expertise, strong troubleshooting capabilities, and the ability to support multi\-customer Managed Services environments.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead Azure infrastructure operations and act as a senior technical escalation point for L2/L3 teams.
* Design, deploy, and manage Azure services including:
* Virtual Machines, AV Sets/Zones, Load Balancers, Virtual Networks
* Azure Storage, Azure Backup, ASR, Key Vault
* Azure App Services, Functions, AKS (optional), Azure SQL (platform\-level)
* Optimize performance, cost, security, and availability across Azure workloads.
* Manage identity and access using Azure AD / Entra ID, RBAC, Conditional Access.
* Implement and maintain monitoring solutions using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Alerts.
* Troubleshoot complex issues involving compute, networking, storage, OS, and security.
* Build and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell, Azure Automation, Logic Apps, or CI/CD pipelines.
* Review and implement Azure Policies, governance controls, tagging standards, and compliance requirements.
* Support DR strategies, backup validation, patching cycles, and BCP testing.
* Document architecture, configurations, runbooks, and best practices.
* Collaborate with security, network, DevOps, and application teams to ensure seamless cloud operations.
* Participate in shifts and on\-call support for critical incidents.
* Mentor team members and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


**Technical Skills Required**
* Hands\-on expertise with Azure IaaS/PaaS services:
* VMs, VNets, NSG, Peering, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway
* Azure Backup, Site Recovery, Key Vault, Azure Storage
* App Services, Azure SQL, Load Balancers, App Gateway
* Strong understanding of Azure governance, cost management, RBAC, and security best practices.
* Advanced experience in PowerShell scripting, Azure Automation, and automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of ARM/Bicep/Terraform for infrastructure deployments (preferred).
* Strong Windows or Linux server administration background.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps pipelines, Git, and YAML\-based automation (nice\-to\-have).
* Experience with enterprise monitoring tools: Azure Monitor, Sentinel (optional), Grafana, etc.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and Managed Services operations.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Strong leadership and decision\-making ability.
* Excellent communication skills and customer\-facing experience.
* Ability to manage high\-severity incidents under pressure.
* Proactive, ownership\-driven, and detail\-oriented.
* Mentoring and capability\-building mindset.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\) required.
* Azure Solutions Architect (AZ\-305\) or Azure Security Engineer (AZ\-500\) preferred.
* ITIL Foundation certification is an advantage.


 Work Environment
   

  

* 24x7 Managed Services with rotational on\-call responsibilities.
* Exposure to large\-scale enterprise Azure deployments and modernisation programs.
* Opportunity to work closely with architects and lead cloud transformation initiatives.

3c52e82e.title: Technical Program Manager II
3c52e82e.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Technical Program Manager II
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 Are you a technical program manager who wants to focus on analytic platforms and data needs? Are you passionate about coordinating and clearly communicating across teams while also managing risk and priorities for your team? Do you want to work in an inclusive and nurturing culture that encourages your own professional learning and development?
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Technical Program Manager for the Clearing Program. You will own the end\-to\-end delivery of engineering projects
   

  

* Responsible for planning, execution, and delivery, from inception to completion, for an existing technology product or program
* Proactively manages the end\-to\-end delivery of engineering work though the engineering team and all dependent organizations
* Reports on progress, ensuring dependencies are covered


 Operates between teams and architectures overseeing the gaps between teams, processes, and systems, while removing all blocking issues leading to a successful delivery
   

  

  
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Plan and manage a group of related technology projects or activities in a coordinated way from inception through successful delivery
* Deep understanding of the design approaches and technologies utilized in your area


 Focus on the customer experience, the build and delivery processes and the problems to be solved
   

  

* Work across multiple scrum teams (may be cross\-cutting across products, scrum teams, and/or technologies or work may be vertically focused on a single product or feature set)
* Align dependent organizations and remove/mitigate all blocking issues
* Work directly with external to the organization or external to Mastercard technology providers and customers
* Work with limited guidance, seeking guidance as needed because the product and delivery strategy is defined.
* Deep understanding of the business and technical requirements for the solutions being built
* Understand the needs of the engineers and technical operations teams who have to build, maintain, and operate the system for the life of the system
* Recognize complex designs and propose simplified solutions by working with software design engineers, principals and TPMs
* Help customers and the engineering teams make trade\-off decisions by considering all of the data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability.
* You identify blocking issues and manage their resolution.
* Identify, assess, track and mitigate issues and risks at multiple levels
* Write documentation as required
* Partner with industry vendors that provide technology or user experience design components that support our architecture and work with vendors on our implementation plans and roadmaps identifying partnership opportunities to increase our development velocity and our learnings
* Communicate role up of project issues and status in a concise, accurate, and professional manner for senior leadership consumption, escalating blocking issues when appropriate
* Communicate progress, anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, identify, assess, track and mitigate issues/risks at multiple levels
* Work across teams to optimize processes
* Regularly review metrics and proactively seek out new and improved data/mechanisms for visibility ensuring your program stays aligned with organization objectives
* Anticipate bottlenecks and adequately factor in contingency for unplanned delays
* Determine if success metrics are in place and if not, you work to define them
* Recognize discordant views and take part in constructive dialog to resolve them
* Continuously assess development processes, test plans, and operations. You work with teams to improve concurrent project delivery.
* Streamline and/or eliminate excess process in any area of the architecture, production operations environment, or business area where the same efforts (or issues) are repeated year\-over\-year


**All About You**
* Deep understanding of the design approaches, technologies and business drivers in your area
* Demonstrated understanding of Project Management processes, strategies and methods
* Expert level knowledge of software development processes and Agile practices
* Experience working in a high\-level collaborative environment and promoting a teamwork mentality
* Experience applying analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to predict challenges and seek to proactively head\-off obstacles
* Excellent time management and organizational skills
* Experience in all things data – writing SQL queries, researching data discrepancies, data reporting
* Strong communications skills \- both verbal and written \- ability to communicate critical points efficient across a wide range of audiences
* You have passion and experience in working on customer facing emerging products and services.
* You have a strong sense of personal accountability regarding decision\-making and supervising scrum teams
* You are results driven with proven ability to effectively define and communicate project status, risks, and solutions in a proactive manner. Also able to manage support issues to drive to root cause and resolution.
* You are high\-energy, detail\-oriented, proactive and adaptive and can work in a dynamic environment.
* You have an ability to simultaneously manage short\-term priorities and long\-term initiatives and have experience working with agile software development processes, ideally as a scrum master.
* You build solid and trust\-based relationships within the team and various stakeholders and become a valued thought partner.
* You can exercise influence outside your own teams to achieve results for the entire organization.
* Expertise in Jira and AI


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Our Purpose** 




 India is in the middle of an extraordinary AI revolution, powered by a young, tech\-savvy generation and visionary leaders who see the future in code and creativity. Across industries—from healthcare to finance to education—AI adoption is accelerating at record speed. Over 90% of business leaders are now reimagining their processes through AI, while developers and students across the country are building tools that are transforming the way India works and lives.

 .

**The Future of AI, Built on Trust and Expertise.**

 , is a full\-stack system built for modern AI—from training and fine\-tuning to inference. It streamlines compute, orchestration, security, and observability, helping organizations in high\-growth markets like India adopt AI faster, safer, and more cost\-efficiently.
 







**The Opportunity: Champion the Growth of AI Acceleration** 




 Join us at the forefront of AI innovation, where you will deal with customers, architect modern AI and cloud solutions, and help accelerate their journey toward intelligent, automated enterprises. Your expertise will directly shape strategic customer outcomes.

 In this role, you’ll help customers overcome complex business challenges by designing and showcasing AI, GenAI, and cloud\-native solutions tailored to their needs. Through technical workshops, deep\-dive discussions, and hands\-on PoCs, you’ll validate real\-world value while guiding customers through their transformation journey and influencing key buying decisions.

* Act as a trusted technical advisor, simplifying complex concepts for business and technical stakeholders.
* Work closely with Product \& Engineering to share feedback and influence roadmap decisions.
* Stay current on trends across Cloud, AI, GenAI, ML, MLOps, and networking.







**Core Competencies** 



* Hands\-on experience with LLM\-powered enterprise apps (chatbots, copilots, AI search, automation).
* Experience with GPU\-accelerated workloads and inference optimization.
* Ability to design scalable cloud\-native architectures with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Strong understanding of vector databases, embeddings, and search optimization.
* Proven track record supporting enterprises through complex AI/Cloud cycles.
* Experience collaborating with engineering and product teams.
* Ability to design custom infrastructure solutions aligned with customer environments.







**Strategic \& Analytical Competencies** 



* Solution Thinking: Design AI, GenAI, ML, and cloud solutions aligned to business goals.
* Strategic Insight: Translate market trends and customer needs into impactful solution strategies.
* Data\-Driven Decisions: Evaluate options, metrics, and PoC outcomes to recommend scalable architectures.
* Problem\-Solving Excellence: Diagnose issues, identify root causes, and propose practical solutions.
* Experience leading PoCs and producing detailed documentation and architecture diagrams.
* Customer\-Centric Strategy: Map customer pain points to AI/cloud capabilities showing clear ROI.
* Cross\-Functional Thinking: Work seamlessly with sales, engineering, and product teams.







**Education \& Certifications**

**Your Mindset** 



* Customer\-First \& Trusted Advisor

**Why This Role is a Unique Opportunity at Neysa** 




 This role places you at the forefront of AI and Cloud innovation, enabling you to shape how enterprises leverage GenAI, ML, and advanced cloud solutions. You’ll influence key business decisions in a fast\-growing AI platform company.

We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare.  

We are an AI\-native unified commerce platform backed by Reliance Retail. We power OMS, POS, Storefront, Clienteling, Supply Chain (WMS, TMS, RFID), and AI tools for enterprise retailers across 30\+ countries, working with leading retailers and brands across the Middle East, Africa, and Southeast Asia. **About the Role**  

Fynd has built its own ERP — **Fynd ERP** — as part of our unified commerce platform. We’re hiring an ERP Solution Architect whose primary charter is to own the deployment and rollout of Fynd ERP for our customers, end to end. Because most enterprises we work with already run on SAP or Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365\), this person also needs to deeply understand both platforms — their modules, data models, and integration surfaces — well enough to:  

* Architect and build integrations between Fynd ERP and SAP/D365 (or specific modules within them) wherever a customer needs their existing ERP to coexist with Fynd ERP rather than be replaced outright.
* Understand a customer’s existing SAP or D365 implementation in depth — their configuration, customizations, master data, and process flows — so we can correctly scope what Fynd ERP will own, what stays on the legacy ERP, and how the two will talk to each other.
* Bring that SAP/D365 experience back into Fynd ERP itself — using firsthand knowledge of how SAP and D365 solve a given problem to identify gaps, propose enhancements, and help shape Fynd ERP’s own roadmap so it holds up against the platforms our customers are used to.


In short: this person deploys Fynd ERP, uses their SAP/D365 depth as the tool that makes that deployment succeed inside real, messy, already\-SAP\-or\-D365\-running enterprises, and feeds what they’ve learned on those platforms back into making Fynd ERP itself better — spanning commerce and supply chain systems in particular.  

This is not a role for someone who has only briefly touched SAP or D365\. We need someone who has genuinely operated at the level of an SAP Solution Architect or D365 Solution Architect — someone who has led full\-lifecycle implementations, speaks the terminology fluently, and understands what “good” looks like on those platforms — because that’s the bar our customers’ own SAP/D365 architects will hold us to. **Mindset \& Working Style**  

Beyond the platform depth, we’re specifically looking for someone who is:* **Hands\-on, not just advisory:** Someone who will get into the configuration, the code, the API payloads, and the data — not just draw architecture diagrams and hand them off.
* **AI\-first:** Someone who instinctively reaches for AI/LLM\-based approaches to speed up ERP work — data mapping, code generation, documentation, testing, migration scripting — rather than doing everything the traditional, manual ERP consulting way.
* **Genuinely enthusiastic about pushing boundaries:** Someone who gets energized by “how do we do this better/faster/differently” rather than defaulting to how SAP or D365 implementations have always been done.
* **Equally comfortable in the ERP world and the open\-source world:** Traditional ERP work (SAP/D365, proprietary tooling, enterprise integration patterns) tends to live in a different universe from open\-source engineering culture (GitHubnative workflows, open APIs, community tooling, modern dev stacks). We need someone who can move fluidly between both — bringing open\-source speed and pragmatism into ERP work, and enterprise rigor into how we build Fynd ERP.

 **What You’ll Do****Fynd ERP Deployment (Primary Responsibility)*** Own end\-to\-end deployment of Fynd ERP for customers — discovery, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration, testing, go\-live, and hypercare.
* Translate customer business processes (commerce, supply chain, finance, inventory) into Fynd ERP configuration and, where needed, custom extensions.
* Define the “system of record” boundary for each engagement — which processes and data live in Fynd ERP vs. the customer’s existing SAP/D365 estate.
* Act as the primary technical/architectural point of contact for customers during Fynd ERP rollouts.

**SAP \& D365 Integration Depth*** Architect and build integrations between Fynd ERP and SAP (ECC/S4HANA) or D365 (F\&O/Business Central) — using APIs, IDocs/BAPIs/RFCs on the SAP side, Data Entities/AIF/DMF on the D365 side, and middleware/iPaaS tools as needed.
* Design integration patterns for the specific modules most likely to be in scope: SAP FI/CO, MM, SD, WM/EWM; D365 Finance, Supply Chain Management, Business Central.
* Ensure master data consistency (SKUs, customers, vendors, pricing, inventory) flows correctly and reliably between Fynd ERP and the customer’s SAP/D365 environment.
* Design for event\-driven, real\-time, or batch integration depending on the customer’s SAP/D365 landscape (on\-prem ECC vs. S/4HANA Cloud, D365 on\-prem vs. cloud).

**Understanding the Customer’s SAP/D365 Landscape*** Perform in\-depth technical discovery of a customer’s existing SAP or D365 implementation — configuration, RICEFW customizations, integration points, data model, and known technical debt.
* Speak fluently in SAP/D365 terminology and process language (e.g., SAP Activate methodology, Clean Core/BTP extensibility, S/4HANA migration paths; D365’s Data Management Framework, Power Platform extensibility) so that customer\-side SAP/D365 architects treat you as a peer, not a vendor rep.
* Identify risks, gaps, and dependencies in the customer’s current ERP setup that will affect the Fynd ERP deployment.
* Advise customers on brownfield vs. greenfield approaches where Fynd ERP is being introduced alongside or in place of parts of SAP/D365\.

**Cross\-Cutting*** Set integration and architecture standards across engagements so patterns are reusable rather than reinvented per customer.
* Work closely with Fynd ERP product and engineering teams to feed back real\-world SAP/D365 integration requirements into the product roadmap.
* Use prior hands\-on experience with SAP and D365 to identify capability gaps in Fynd ERP and propose concrete enhancements — effectively acting as a product advisor grounded in what mature ERPs already do well.
* Mentor implementation consultants and vet any external SIs/partners engaged on SAP or D365 workstreams.

 **Must\-Have Experience*** 8–15\+ years in ERP implementation, consulting, or architecture roles.
* Proven, hands\-on, end\-to\-end implementation experience on both SAP (ECC/S4HANA) and Microsoft Dynamics 365 (F\&O/Business Central) — not exposure to one platform and theoretical familiarity with the other.
* A track record equivalent to an SAP Solution Architect and/or D365 Solution Architect: has led or architected multiple full\-lifecycle implementations (requirements solution design build/configuration data migration testing go\-live hypercare) on each platform.
* Deep, working fluency in SAP terminology and concepts — e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, WM/EWM, RICEFW objects, IDocs, BAPIs/RFCs, SAP Activate methodology, S/4HANA migration (brownfield vs. greenfield), SAP BTP/Clean Core, SAP Integration Suite (CPI)/PI\-PO.
* Equal fluency in D365 terminology and concepts — e.g., D365 Finance, Supply Chain Management, Business Central, Data Entities, Data Management Framework (DMF), Application Integration Framework (AIF), X\+\+ extensibility, Power Platform (Power Automate/Power BI), Azure Integration Services.
* Real experience integrating a non\-SAP/non\-D365 system into an existing SAP or D365 landscape — this is the exact pattern we need for Fynd ERP.
* Strong understanding of commerce and supply chain processes (order management, inventory, procurement, fulfillment) and how they map to ERP modules.
* Comfortable owning technical discovery directly with a customer’s IT/ERP team, including their SAP/D365 architects.
* Hands\-on and builder\-minded — writes/reviews integration code, works directly in configuration and data, and doesn’t stop at architecture diagrams.
* AI\-first working style — actively uses AI/LLM tools to accelerate ERP work (data mapping, migration scripting, documentation, test generation) rather than relying purely on manual, traditional ERP\-consulting methods.
* Demonstrated comfort operating in both the ERP world and the open\-source world — e.g., has used or contributed to open\-source tools/frameworks alongside enterprise ERP platforms, and can bring that pragmatism into how we build and extend Fynd ERP.

 **Good to Have*** SAP certifications (e.g., SAP Certified Application Associate/Architect – S/4HANA) and/or Microsoft Dynamics 365 certifications.
* Prior experience with a product company building its own ERP/commerce platform, rather than only working ERP implementations as a consultant/SI.
* Experience in retail, D2C, or unified\-commerce environments specifically.
* Familiarity with modern iPaaS/API management tooling (MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure API Management, or similar).
* Exposure to cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, GCP) supporting ERP and integration workloads.

 **What We’re NOT Looking For*** Someone who has only worked on one ERP platform and has “read about” the other.
* Pure functional consultants without integration/technical architecture depth.
* Project/program managers without hands\-on solution design and implementation ownership.
* Someone looking for a purely internal role — this position is customer\-facing and will regularly sit across the table from a customer’s SAP or D365 architects.

 **Ideal Candidate Profile**Someone who can walk into a customer’s environment already running SAP or D365, quickly map out what their system actually does, tell us exactly where Fynd ERP should plug in and what needs to integrate versus what needs to be replaced — and then go build and deploy that solution themselves. They’ve done this more than once, on both platforms, and can hold their own in a room full of SAP/D365 architects because they’ve genuinely been one.  

They’re also restless in a good way — they reach for AI tools to move faster, they’re as comfortable pulling from open\-source communities as they are navigating enterprise ERP conventions, and they’re always asking why something has to be done the slow, traditional way when it doesn’t have to be.

3301c9e8.title: M365 End User Computing Architect
3301c9e8.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**
-----------------


The End User Computing (EUC) Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic design, governance, and evolution of the organization's end user technology ecosystem. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert for the Microsoft 365 platform and related productivity, collaboration, and security services — driving adoption, standardization, and innovation across the enterprise.


The EUC Architect partners closely with business stakeholders, IT operations teams, security, and enterprise architecture to ensure the end user environment is modern, resilient, and aligned with organizational objectives. This individual operates at both the strategic and hands\-on technical level, owning architectural decisions from concept through implementation.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own the end\-to\-end architectural vision and roadmap for the Microsoft 365 tenant, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, and the broader M365 suite
* Define and enforce tenant configuration standards, governance policies, and design patterns across all M365 workloads
* Lead architectural decisions for Microsoft Copilot adoption, including readiness assessments, data governance prerequisites, and rollout strategy
* Design and maintain identity and access architecture in partnership with the IAM team, including Entra ID (Azure AD) Conditional Access, SSPR, MFA, and hybrid identity models
* Architect Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Manager solutions for device management, compliance policies, application delivery, and Autopilot provisioning
* Establish architecture for Microsoft Purview (Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, eDiscovery, Compliance Manager) and advise on data governance posture
* Drive the strategy for Microsoft Viva, Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI), and low\-code/no\-code citizen development governance

**End User Computing Strategy**
-------------------------------

* Define the long\-term EUC strategy spanning physical endpoints (Windows, macOS), virtual desktop infrastructure (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365\), and mobile platforms (iOS, Android) via Microsoft Intune
* Lead endpoint lifecycle architecture including OS imaging, patching strategy, hardware standards, and Windows 11 migration planning
* Architect solutions for remote and hybrid work scenarios, ensuring performance, security, and user experience parity regardless of location
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft technologies and communicate business value and architectural impact to leadership

**Governance \& Standards**
---------------------------

* Develop and maintain EUC architecture standards, reference architectures, and design documentation
* Establish M365 governance frameworks including tenant policies, external sharing controls, Teams provisioning governance, and data residency requirements
* Define and socialize naming conventions, RBAC models, licensing optimization strategies, and change management processes
* Conduct architecture reviews for EUC\-impacting projects and provide design authority sign\-off

**Security \& Compliance**
--------------------------

* Partner with the Information Security team to integrate Zero Trust principles throughout the EUC environment
* Architect solutions leveraging Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, and the broader Microsoft Defender XDR suite
* Ensure EUC architecture aligns with regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, FINRA, GDPR) as applicable to the business

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT leadership on EUC and M365 capabilities, roadmap, and investment priorities
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, networking, and application teams to ensure integrated, cohesive solutions
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to EUC engineers and administrators
* Represent EUC architecture in governance forums, architecture review boards, and vendor engagements
* Partner with Microsoft account teams and FastTrack resources to leverage available programs and stay ahead of platform changes

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 10\+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 5 years in an architecture or senior engineering role focused on end user computing or Microsoft 365\.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise across the core Microsoft 365 workloads:


	+ **Collaboration \& Productivity:** Microsoft Teams, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Viva
	+ **Identity \& Access:** Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Conditional Access, MFA, Privileged Identity Management
	+ **Device Management:** Microsoft Intune, Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Windows Autopilot
	+ **Security:** Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365
	+ **Compliance:** Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, DLP, eDiscovery
	+ **Automation \& Platform:** Power Platform, Microsoft Graph API
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing M365 tenant architecture in large, complex enterprise environments
* Strong understanding of hybrid identity models, Azure AD Connect, and cloud\-only identity scenarios
* Experience with virtual desktop technologies (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with ITSM platforms and their integration with M365 tooling (e.g., ServiceNow)
* Strong documentation skills with ability to produce architecture diagrams, reference designs, and decision records

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* **Technical Depth:** Expert\-level command of M365 platform capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns
* **Strategic Vision:** Ability to translate business requirements into a coherent, future\-state EUC architecture
* **Communication:** Clear and compelling communicator to both technical and executive audiences
* **Problem Solving:** Structured thinker who can diagnose complex, cross\-domain issues and drive resolution
* **Collaboration:** Builds trust across teams; effective in cross\-functional and matrixed environments
* **Governance Mindset:** Proactively establishes guardrails and standards without creating unnecessary friction

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Microsoft certifications, including one or more of:


	+ Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert
	+ Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate
	+ Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate
	+ Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate
	+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot for M365 deployment planning and AI\-readiness assessments
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and their application in enterprise EUC environments
* Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, etc.)
* Background in enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman)

0ca67263.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview**
----------------


The ServiceNow Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic design, governance, and continuous evolution of the organization's ServiceNow platform. This role owns the end\-to\-end architectural vision for ServiceNow — spanning platform configuration, enterprise integrations, workflow automation, and the adoption of ServiceNow's AI and intelligence capabilities — ensuring the platform delivers measurable value across the business.


The ServiceNow Architect serves as the primary technical authority for the platform and works in close partnership with enterprise architecture, IT operations, business process owners, and product teams to transform ServiceNow from an ITSM tool into a strategic enterprise workflow automation hub. This individual operates at the intersection of technical depth and business strategy, shaping how work gets done across the organization.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

**Platform Architecture \& Governance**
---------------------------------------

* Own the ServiceNow platform architecture, including instance strategy (production, sub\-production), domain separation considerations, upgrade planning, and long\-term roadmap
* Establish and enforce platform governance standards: development practices, scoped application design, naming conventions, update set management, and code review processes
* Define the ServiceNow data model strategy, including CMDB architecture, CI relationships, and data integrity governance in alignment with ITIL and business requirements
* Lead architecture reviews for all significant ServiceNow development efforts, providing design authority sign\-off and ensuring alignment with platform best practices
* Maintain architectural documentation including reference architectures, design decision records, and platform topology diagrams

**Enterprise Integration Architecture**
---------------------------------------

* Design and own the integration architecture connecting ServiceNow to the broader enterprise technology ecosystem, including ERP, ITSM, HR systems, monitoring platforms, identity providers, and cloud services
* Architect integrations using ServiceNow's native capabilities — IntegrationHub, Flow Designer spokes, REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, and Event Management — as well as third\-party iPaaS platforms where applicable
* Define integration patterns and standards for inbound/outbound data exchange, ensuring reliability, security, and maintainability at enterprise scale
* Lead integration efforts with key enterprise platforms including Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, SharePoint), Azure, Active Directory/Entra ID, monitoring and observability tools, and HR platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors)
* Establish and govern the ServiceNow CMDB as the authoritative source of truth for enterprise configuration data, including discovery tooling, reconciliation rules, and CSDM alignment
* Partner with security and IAM teams to architect identity federation, SSO (SAML/OIDC), and role\-based access control across the platform

**Workflow Automation**
-----------------------

* Lead the architectural strategy for enterprise workflow automation on the ServiceNow platform, spanning IT, HR, Legal, Finance, Facilities, and other business domains.
* Design scalable, reusable automation frameworks using Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Business Rules, and Scripted REST APIs.
* Architect end\-to\-end process automation for key workflows including incident management, change management, employee onboarding/offboarding, procurement, and request fulfillment.
* Define standards for automation governance: approval workflows, SLA frameworks, notification architecture, and audit trail design.
* Identify and prioritize automation opportunities across the enterprise by partnering with process owners and analyzing ticket and workflow data.
* Champion low\-code/no\-code automation patterns to enable business teams to build within governed guardrails, reducing reliance on centralized IT development

**ServiceNow AI \& Intelligence Capabilities:**
-----------------------------------------------

* Drive the adoption and architectural strategy for ServiceNow's AI and intelligence portfolio, including:


	+ **Now Assist (Generative AI):** Virtual agent augmentation, case summarization, resolution note generation, and AI\-assisted search across ITSM and non\-ITSM workflows.
	+ **Predictive Intelligence:** ML\-based classification, categorization, and routing of incidents, cases, and requests.
	+ **AI Search:** Unified enterprise search architecture leveraging ServiceNow's semantic search capabilities.
	+ **Process Optimization:** Identifying bottleneck and deviation patterns in workflows using ServiceNow's process mining capabilities.
	+ **Virtual Agent:** Conversational interface design and NLU topic architecture integrated with enterprise channels (Microsoft Teams, web portal).
* Assess organizational AI readiness, including data quality, CMDB health, and historical record hygiene as prerequisites for effective AI model performance
* Define governance and ethical use standards for AI\-driven automation and decision support within ServiceNow
* Stay current with ServiceNow's AI roadmap and evaluate new capabilities for applicability within the enterprise context

**Product \& Module Ownership**
-------------------------------

* Provide architectural leadership across ServiceNow product lines as adopted by the organization, which may include:


	+ IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), IT Asset Management (ITAM)
	+ HR Service Delivery (HRSD), Legal Service Delivery, Workplace Service Delivery
	+ Security Operations (SecOps), GRC / Integrated Risk Management (IRM)
	+ Customer Service Management (CSM), App Engine / Creator Workflows
* Evaluate new ServiceNow modules for strategic fit, total cost of ownership, and integration complexity before platform adoption decisions are made
* Manage the platform upgrade lifecycle, including scoped impact analysis, regression testing strategy, and stakeholder communication

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT leadership on ServiceNow capabilities, investment priorities, and platform roadmap
* Partner with process owners and product managers to translate business requirements into scalable platform solutions
* Mentor ServiceNow developers, administrators, and business analysts — establishing technical standards and elevating team capability
* Represent ServiceNow architecture in enterprise architecture governance forums and technology review boards
* Manage the relationship with ServiceNow account teams, technical success managers, and implementation partners to maximize platform value

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 10\+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 5 years in a senior architecture or technical lead role focused on ServiceNow
* Deep, hands\-on expertise across core ServiceNow platform capabilities:


	+ **Platform:** Instance architecture, Application Engine, Scoped Apps, CMDB, CSDM, Update Sets, ATF
	+ **Automation:** Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Business Rules, Scheduled Jobs, Event Management
	+ **Integration:** REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, LDAP/SSO, Azure/AWS connectors, iPaaS patterns
	+ **ITSM/ITOM/ITAM:** Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Discovery, Service Mapping, HAM/SAM
	+ **Portal \& UX:** Service Portal, Now Experience (UI Builder), Employee Center
* Demonstrated experience architecting ServiceNow integrations with complex, heterogeneous enterprise technology environments
* Proficiency in ServiceNow scripting: JavaScript (Glide API), REST API design, and client/server\-side scripting
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL processes and their implementation within ServiceNow
* Experience leading platform upgrades across major ServiceNow releases in production environments
* Excellent documentation skills with ability to produce architecture diagrams, integration maps, and design specifications

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

**Platform Mastery:** Expert command of ServiceNow architecture patterns, APIs, and the platform's evolving capability landscape

**Integration Thinking:** Designs loosely coupled, resilient integration architectures that scale across enterprise system boundaries

**Process Orientation:** Translates ambiguous business processes into structured, automatable workflows with appropriate governance

**AI Fluency:** Understands where AI and machine learning add genuine value and architects for responsible, effective adoption

**Strategic Influence:** Earns credibility with senior stakeholders and shapes platform investment decisions

**Mentorship:** Actively develops others and raises the overall technical capability of the ServiceNow practice

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow's AI portfolio, including Now Assist, Predictive Intelligence, Virtual Agent, and AI Search
* ServiceNow certifications, including one or more of:


	+ Certified System Administrator (CSA)
	+ Certified Application Developer (CAD)
	+ Certified Implementation Specialist — ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, SecOps, or equivalent
	+ Now Certified Expert (NCE) designation
* Experience with ServiceNow App Engine and building custom scoped applications for enterprise use cases
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman) and their application to platform governance
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with Microsoft 365, Azure Monitor, Dynatrace, Splunk, Workday, or SAP
* Background in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government) and associated compliance requirements
* Exposure to DevOps practices as applied to ServiceNow development (source control integration, CI/CD pipelines, ATF)

6931a44e.title: Solution Architect – Application Development & Modernization
6931a44e.description:
**Role Overview** 




  





 We are seeking a customer\-focused Solution Architect to drive Application Development and Modernization initiatives. The role involves engaging with clients to understand business challenges, assessing existing application landscapes, defining target\-state architectures, and designing scalable, secure, and cloud\-ready solutions. The Solution Architect will collaborate with Sales, Delivery, Engineering, and Technology teams to deliver innovative solutions aligned with business objectives and digital transformation strategies.
 








**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Requirement Discovery** 



* Engage with clients and internal stakeholders to understand business objectives, technical challenges, and target\-state outcomes.
* Conduct technical discovery workshops and requirement\-gathering sessions.
* Analyze existing application architecture and identify modernization opportunities.
* Recommend technology solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.



  
 



**Solution Architecture \& Design** 



* Design scalable, secure, and resilient applications using modern technologies such as .NET, Java, Python, Microservices, and REST APIs.
* Architect cloud\-native solutions on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Define end\-to\-end solution architecture covering application, integration, data, security, and infrastructure layers.
* Apply DevSecOps principles including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), containerization (Docker), and Kubernetes.
* Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, availability, reliability, and security requirements.



  
 



**Technical Solutioning** 



* Translate business requirements into comprehensive technical solution designs.
* Prepare architecture diagrams, technical proposals, and solution documentation.
* Support effort estimation, sizing, technology selection, and cost optimization.
* Provide technical guidance throughout the solution lifecycle.



  
 



**Client Engagement** 



* Lead technical discussions, architecture workshops, and solution presentations with business and IT stakeholders.
* Present solution approaches, modernization strategies, and technology recommendations.
* Conduct Proof of Concept (POC) demonstrations to validate proposed solutions.
* Build trusted relationships with clients by providing technical expertise and strategic guidance.



  
 



**Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Sales, Delivery, Engineering, Product, and Cloud teams to ensure successful solution implementation.
* Support proposal development, RFP/RFI responses, and technical documentation.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies, cloud services, and application modernization best practices.



  
 



**Core Skills Required** 









**Technical Expertise** 



* Strong understanding of Application Architecture and System Design.
* Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Strong knowledge of Microservices, REST APIs, and Event\-Driven Architectures.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps, CI/CD, and Infrastructure Automation.
* Strong understanding of secure application design principles.
* Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns and cloud\-native application development.



  
 



**Soft Skills** 



* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication and presentation abilities.
* Ability to engage with business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.



  
 



**Experience** 



* 10\-15 years of overall IT experience.
* 4\-5 years of experience in Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, Enterprise Solution Design, or Application Modernization.
* Experience designing cloud\-native and enterprise applications.
* Prior experience in application development or modernization projects is preferred.
* Experience engaging with clients, understanding business requirements, and delivering technical solutions.



  
 



**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience with Cloud Migration and Application Modernization.
* Understanding of API Management, Integration Platforms, and Enterprise Architecture.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled applications and modern software development practices.
* Cloud Certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP) are an added advantage.

d855411c.title: AI Solution Architect
d855411c.description:
* AI \& Solutions Architect
* Job Title \- AI \& Solutions Architect
* Location – Pune
* Experience – 10\+ years
* About Silicon Stack



 Silicon Stack is an Australian technology services company with a strong delivery base in Pune. We provide GCC staffing, AI and data engineering, application development, and managed services to enterprise clients across the automotive, industrial, and technology sectors. Our India team of approximately 150 engineers, data scientists, architects, and delivery professionals works across concurrent technology programmes at any given time.
 



  




* The Role We are looking for an AI \& Solutions Architect who combines strong technical depth in AI/ML and cloud architecture with communication skills to engage credibly with senior client stakeholders. This is not a pure engineering role — it sits at the intersection of architecture, solution design, and client advisory. The right person has built real AI products or platforms, understands how enterprise technology landscapes fit together, and can translate complex technical ideas into clear proposals and presentations. This is a growth role — the expectation is that the person develops into the practice's primary technical authority over the next 18–24 months. Key Responsibilities AI \& Architecture — 50% of the role • Own the architectural direction for AI, GenAI, machine learning, and data engineering deliveries across the practice
* • Design and review end\-to\-end solution architectures — from data ingestion and model development through to deployment and MLOps
* • Provide technical guidance to delivery teams on implementation approach, technology selection, and best practices



 • Build and maintain reusable architectural frameworks and reference architectures that accelerate delivery across the team
 



 • Evaluate and recommend new tools, platforms, and frameworks — particularly in the rapidly evolving AI and cloud landscape Technical Pre\-Sales \& Solution Design — 30% of the role
 



 • Lead technical discovery sessions with client stakeholders — understand business problems and map them to technology solutions
 



 • Own the technical section of all proposals and RFP responses — solution architecture, technology fit, delivery approach, and effort estimation
 



 • Develop and present capability presentations and solution workshops — you are the technical face of the practice in client conversations
 



 • Design service offerings — packaging technical capabilities into defined, repeatable engagement models that the commercial team can sell
 



 • Work closely with the MD and commercial team to support deals from a technical credibility standpoint Technical Leadership — 20% of the role
 



 • Mentor and develop Architects and Senior Engineers within the team — raise the technical bar across the practice
 



 • Conduct technical interviews for senior hires — define what good looks like and help the team recruit to that standard
 



 • Produce thought leadership content — articles, capability briefs, and technical documentation that builds the organisation's credibility externally
 



 • Stay ahead of the technology curve — AI, GenAI, cloud\-native architectures, agentic systems — and bring relevant developments into the practice Technology Depth Expected Strong working knowledge required across most of these areas.
 



 Depth in AI/ML and cloud is essential; breadth across the rest is expected.
 



 Domain Expected knowledge AI / GenAI Hands\-on experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, agentic AI, prompt engineering, and AI evaluation frameworks. Practical experience with AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Google Vertex AI. Machine Learning Model development, training, evaluation, and deployment. MLOps practices — model versioning, monitoring, drift detection. Familiarity with MLflow, SageMaker, or equivalent. Data Engineering Data pipeline architecture, ETL/ELT, data lake and warehouse design. Working knowledge of Spark, dbt, Redshift, Snowflake, or similar platforms.
 



 Cloud Architecture AWS (primary), Azure, or GCP. Cloud\-native design patterns — serverless, microservices, event\-driven architecture. Security and compliance in cloud environments.
 



 Application Architecture Backend systems — APIs, microservices, distributed systems.
 



 Familiarity with Python, Node.js, or Java in a services context. Enough to review and guide delivery teams. Integration API design, event streaming (Kafka, Kinesis), enterprise integration patterns. Sufficient to design solutions that connect AI/data layers with existing enterprise systems.
 



 What We Are Looking For Essential Preferred
 



 • 8–12 years in technology with at least 4 years in an architecture, solution design, or technical lead role
 



 • Demonstrable hands\-on AI/ML experience — has built, deployed, or led the development of at least one real AI or GenAI system
 



 • Strong cloud architecture knowledge across at least one major provider (AWS preferred)
 



 • Experience working directly with clients or senior stakeholders — can present, explain, and defend technical approaches clearly
 



 • Good written and verbal communication — you write proposals that are clear, structured, and persuasive to a non\-technical reader
 



 • Intellectually curious with a growth mindset — this role grows significantly and the person must want to grow with it
 



 • Pune\-based or willing to relocate immediately
 



 • Background in an IT services, consulting, or managed services environment
 



 • Experience designing AI or data solutions for industrial, automotive, or manufacturing clients
 



 • Exposure to technical pre\-sales — contributing to proposals, RFP responses, or solution workshops
 



 • Published technical content — blogs, talks, open\-source contributions — that demonstrates active engagement with the technology community
 



 • Familiarity with the GCC delivery model — how enterprise organisations build and run technology operations in India

Job Summary: We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Software Architect to join our growing engineering team on our generative AI Platform. Reporting directly to the Platform Owner, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and overseeing the implementation of core technical components for our cutting\-edge insurance platform. This role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, architectural vision, and hands\-on problem\-solving skills to ensure our platform is scalable, secure, and performant.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architectural Design \& Development:
+ Collaborate with the Principal Architect to translate business requirements and high\-level architectural designs into detailed technical specifications and actionable architectural blueprints for core agentic platform components.
+ Handle business implementations of the agentic platform and understand specific uses cases that will need to be implemented on the agentic platform.
+ Design and develop robust, scalable, secure, and maintainable software architectures for new and existing modules within the insurance platform (e.g., policy administration, claims processing, billing, rating engines).

+ Identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and scalability issues within your domain.
+ Research and evaluate new technologies, tools, and architectural patterns to continuously improve the platform's capabilities and efficiency.

* Collaboration \& Communication:
+ Work closely with product managers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure architectural solutions meet business needs.
+ Collaborate effectively with other architects (e.g., Data Architects, Security Architects) to ensure holistic and integrated designs.
+ Document architectural decisions, technical designs, and system flows clearly and concisely.
+ Present technical solutions and architectural concepts to various audiences, from technical teams to non\-technical stakeholders.

* Quality Assurance \& Performance:
+ Contribute to defining and enforcing technical standards and best practices for performance, reliability, and security.
+ Assist in defining strategies for unit testing, integration testing, and performance testing for core components.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in software development, with at least 2\+ years in a Software Architect or Lead Developer role, specifically working on large\-scale, complex enterprise applications.
* Proven experience in designing and building highly scalable, distributed systems, preferably within the financial services or insurance domain.
* Strong proficiency in \[Specify core programming languages, e.g., Java, Python] and relevant frameworks.
* Deep understanding of architectural patterns (e.g., Microservices, Event\-Driven Architecture, RESTful APIs, DDD).
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Solid understanding of database technologies (relational and NoSQL) and data modelling principles.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with specific insurance domain concepts.
* Knowledge of security best practices for enterprise applications.
* Certifications in cloud architecture (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect).

a9c35c66.title: Databricks Solution Architect
a9c35c66.description:
**Position Summary:** 




 As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you are a trusted technical advisor embedded within the customer organisation. You work closely with sales and field engineering to accelerate adoption and growth of the Databricks platform. You ensure customer success by providing technical accountability for our most complex customers—helping them maximise the value of Databricks workloads they have already selected and improving their return on investment.
 



 This role blends deep technical leadership with strategic customer engagement. You own the post\-sales technical strategy for the customer’s highest\-value use cases and serve as their primary advisor across the Databricks platform. You engage senior technical and business leaders with strong architectural judgment—driving design reviews, performance and cost optimisation, product adoption, and rapid blocker removal. In parallel, you drive account growth by ensuring alignment with architectural best practices and measurable value realisation—building executive alignment, leading stakeholders, orchestrating specialised Databricks teams, and steering customers toward scalable, production\-grade architectures.
 



 While not a hands\-on\-keyboard role, this is a highly technical position where architectural skills in fields such as data architecture, data engineering, data warehousing, or data science are essential.
 



 You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organisation.
 



  





**The impact you will have** 



* Be the accountable Databricks Architect for your assigned customers, working with technical teams to guide priority use cases from design through go\-live—removing blockers, providing best practices, and ensuring stable, scalable adoption.
* Lead the post\-technical\-win strategy and execution plan for major Databricks use cases, aligning with Solutions Architects to understand full demand plans and drive clarity across multiple selling teams and stakeholders.
* Own the technical leadership of assigned use cases, creating certainty from ambiguity and coordinating onboarding, enablement, success, go\-live, and healthy consumption of workloads selected for Databricks.
* Serve as the first point of contact for production/go\-live status, often across multiple complex use cases within large enterprise organisations.
* Orchestrate the broader Databricks ecosystem—Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services, Support, and specialist technical teams—to ensure high\-quality delivery and escalate advanced issues when needed.
* Create and execute a point of view for accelerating use cases into production, collaborating with Professional Services on proposals as needed.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to introduce new capabilities, private previews, and upgrade paths that support customer roadmaps.
* Develop and manage a unified technical execution plan covering:
* progression of priority use cases from technical win through production
* user enablement and growth
* product adoption aligned with the Lakehouse vision
* cloud cost control, tuning, and optimisation
* executive and operational governance
* Provide clear internal and external updates, including KPI reporting on usage, customer health, investment status, risks, product adoption, and use case progression.



  





**What we look for** 



* Programming experience in Python, SQL, or Scala, and a solid understanding of distributed data systems.
* 5\+ years of experience delivering Data, Analytics, or AI projects, with the ability to contribute to architectural discussions with customers.
* Experience in customer\-facing technical roles such as technical architecture, pre\-sales, consulting, or customer success.
* Ability to guide architectural decisions in domains such as data engineering, data architecture, data warehousing, or data science.
* Demonstrated ability to drive delivery outcomes without hands\-on keyboard responsibilities.
* Experience resolving complex escalations with senior customer stakeholders.
* Understanding of how to connect technical deliverables to business value.
* Track record of achieving or exceeding goals or objectives.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Description
 



  





 About Opalus and OPAL
 



 Opalus Investments Limited is developing OPAL, an AI\-powered SaaS business operating platform for SMEs. OPAL places accounting at the core and connects finance, customers, people, projects, documents and workflow in one secure operating environment. We are establishing our software development team and office in Kochi, Kerala.
 



  





 The opportunity
 



 Build and operate the secure cloud platform, delivery pipelines and observability capabilities that support OPAL from development through production.

* Design and operate Kubernetes\-based application environments on AWS or Azure.
