331c5f32.title: Data Delivery lead IND
331c5f32.description:
**About us:**  

OsbIndia (OSBI) is an offshore subsidiary of OSB Group. OSBI was incorporated in 2004 as a key part of the OSB Group’s business strategy to provide operational service support. OSBI works with the Group’s trading brands in the UK, providing exceptional customer support and service delivery to new and existing customers.
  
  

OSBI also prides itself on offering operational excellence by devising and utilizing process improvements and functional efficiencies.
  
  

1\. Job Purpose
  
The Data Delivery Manager will have delivery responsibility for pieces of Data Office work while also having a wider Data Office role of assisting the Head of Data Delivery in ensuring that Data Office resources are managed against demand across the data teams.
  
From a delivery perspective the Data Delivery Manager will work with both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, the Data Office will be moving to predominately Agile, but some Waterfall will persist. The Data Delivery Manager will lead pieces of Data Office work either by providing delivery management to the Scrum Masters or directly to some of the Data Engineers / Senior Data Engineers.
  
From a wider Data Office resourcing and delivery perspective the role will operate across the Data Office, working with the Head of Data Delivery and the other members of the leadership team to ensure that resources are correctly allocated and projects and programmes are tracking to their deliverables.
  
The Data Delivery Manager role is a functional role as opposed to a hands\-on technical role, from time to time, the role may provide direct line management to some other members of the Data Delivery Team.
  
Therefore, the Data Delivery Manager role will encompass all aspects of delivery management, team management and leadership covering:
  
* Team, Delivery \& Scrum Management
* Resource Planning \& Allocation
* Stakeholder Management (up to Director level)
* Team process development and adherence to standards
* Risk assessment and issue resolution
* Representation of the Data Office team in senior forums / discussions e.g. Steering Groups, Project Boards, Change Boards
* Provision of reporting covering Data Office work and performance
* Mentoring other data delivery professionals (particularly in Agile)


The role will require an appreciation and high\-level understanding of data architectures, and of the design and delivery of data transformations and visualisations. The successful candidate will need to work flexibly with a varied workload in an environment which is vibrant and dynamic.
  
The role reports to the Head of Data Delivery in UK (with Line Manager reporting to Senior Manager Data Operations at OSBI, Bengaluru) and will need to work closely with other members of the data leadership team.
  
  

2\. Core Responsibilities
  
* To lead delivery of pieces of Data Office work using Agile or Waterfall methodologies.
* Occasional line management support to other members of the Data Delivery team when required in the absence of the Senior Data Delivery Manager.
* To undertake Data Office Resource Planning and Allocation that covers all aspects of the Data Office.
* From a Project perspective actively work with the Change Delivery Programme and Project Managers to understand the forth coming project demand and then help ensure that Data Office resources are allocated to the projects in a timely manner.
* Work closely with the Change Delivery teams, representing the Data Office and ensuring that the plans derived are deliverable from a Data Office viewpoint.
* Actively work with the Change Delivery Programme and Project Managers to ensure delivery timelines are adhered to, delivery risks are managed and any blocking delivery issues are resolved in a timely manner.
* Be a point of contact for the Data Office and then during delivery to be a point of escalation for data issues / problems.
* To provide proactive Stakeholder Management (up to Director level) to all parties impacted by / working with the Data Office, providing advice and guidance as requested, and always representing the Data Office in a positive and proactive way.
* Forge effective working relationships across the wider IT team, Change Delivery and the Business to aid the delivery of data solutions and to help shape and drive the Data Office across the organisation.
* Represent the Data Office in senior forums / discussions e.g. Steering Groups, Project Boards, Change Boards
* Work closely with the Head of Data Delivery and other members of the leadership team to drive the Strategy for the Data Office.
* Derive and provide reporting covering Data Office work and performance.
* Assist with Data Office recruitment activities, helping to review CVs and conduct interviews.
* To play an active role in the IT management community, providing support and help to other IT management colleagues as requested / required.
* To provide delivery mentoring and guidance to other data delivery professionals, particularly in Agile.
* Ensure that you fully understand and comply with the organisation’s Risk Management Policies as they relate to your area of responsibility and demonstrate in your day\-to\-day work that you put customers at the heart of everything you do.
* Ensure that you fully understand and comply with the organisation’s Data Governance Policies as they relate to your area of responsibility and demonstrate in your day\-to\-day work that you treat data as an important corporate asset which must be protected and managed.
* Maintain the company’s compliance standards and ensure timely completion of all mandatory on\-line training modules and attestations.
* Ensure that you keep your professional knowledge up to date to comply with the Knowledge and Competence requirements of the Mortgage Credit Directive.


3\. Experience Requirements
  
* 10\+ years previous experience of managing a multi\-site IT team is essential, preferable within the Financial Services Industry.
* 8\+ years previous experience of IT software delivery management experience is essential, preferably on Data projects.
* 5 years previous experience in managing multiple stakeholders at different levels of seniority is essential.
* 5 years previous experience of IT process development, management, developing technical roadmaps and strategy is essential.
* 5 years previous experience of working in formal change and project management processes as well as working in a formal release process is essential.
* 5 years previous experience of resource planning, management and allocation is essential.
* 5 years previous experience of undertaking recruitment, interview and selection activities is desirable.


Why join OSBI?
  
  

We understand your career and how you progress is as unique as your individual personality. We've created a culture and an environment that encourages personal growth and offers our people opportunities to learn and succeed. Whether you're in the early stages of your career or already have an established profession, we're constantly seeking to hire talented individuals who want to make a difference and grow with us. We're a connected company working together to create a business in which we can all take pride and prosper.
  
If you want to know more about OSBI, please click on the website link: www.osb\-india.com
  
  

To know more about OSBI culture please find us on Instagram @OSBINDIA
  
  

To find out more about the roles \& updates please follow our LinkedIn Page www.linkedin.com/company/osbi.

6eb9d275.description:
**Specialist Manager, Talent Development**


At Deloitte, we are known for being a standard of excellence and our employees are the drivers behind. As part of this role, you will be entrusted with hiring professionals excelling in their respective fields to match the needs of our business and our talent legacy of hiring the best and the brightest. The learning and development team works closely with business leadership to design, develop and deliver training curriculum that translates to on\-the\-job performance and delivers business results.

**Work you'll do**


As a Specialist Manager, Talent Development on the Enterprise Solutions Learning team, you will be responsible for…

* Designing and managing a standardized People Channel learning curriculum across technical, professional, and leadership skills.
* Partnering with business leaders and US/USI learning teams to identify skill needs and roll out learning programs across the practice.
* Monitoring learning consumption, learner feedback, and adoption trends; sharing insights and recommendations with stakeholders on a regular basis.
* Managing facilitator recruitment, vendor coordination, and communications to support learning delivery and engagement.
* Leading annual learning needs analysis, micro and macro planning, and budget tracking activities, including reforecasts, accruals, and invoice tracking.
* Supporting innovation in learning solutions through the use of instructional systems design frameworks, adult learning approaches, and learning technologies.

**The team**


The Enterprise Solutions Learning team, delivers business\-focused, innovative learning and development programs thoughtfully designed to help Deloitte’s 20K internal professionals best serve their internal clients at every stage of their careers. Through the work of this team, development at Deloitte is not just about education – it is a vital part of Deloitte’s leadership culture.

**Location:** Hyderabad

**Shift Timings:** Flexible. US time zone and overlap with the FA business is expected

**Qualifications**


Required:

* Bachelor’s degree
* 9\-14 years of experience in learning and development, talent development, instructional design, or human resources
* Experience designing and implementing learning curricula across technical, professional, and leadership topics
* Experience partnering with business stakeholders to identify learning needs and support talent strategy priorities
* Experience managing learning operations, including facilitator coordination, vendor management, and program communications
* Experience managing budgets, forecasts, accruals, invoices, or program spend tracking
* Experience using Microsoft Office tools, including Microsoft Excel

Preferred:

* Experience supporting learning programs for human resources or talent organizations
* Experience implementing learning solutions using education, experience, and exposure models
* Experience conducting facilitator briefings, stakeholder sessions, or recruitment calls
* Experience applying adult learning practices in program design and delivery

**Our purpose**  


Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
**Our people and culture**  


Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
**Professional development**  


At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
**Benefits to help you thrive**  


At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
**Recruiting tips**  


From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

8588ca83.title: Product Owner/ Delivery Manager
8588ca83.description:
About the Role
 



 We are looking for a senior, hands\-on Product Owner / Delivery Manager who takes end\-to\-end responsibility for product features, from ideation through build, release, and live operation.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role combining:
 



  




* **Product Management**
* **Product Ownership**
* **Delivery \& Release Management**



  





 The role sits close to the CTO Office and acts as the single point of accountability for product execution, timelines, quality, and stakeholder communication.
 



 You will plan, drive, and run releases, own the product roadmap, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and provide clear delivery reporting to leadership.
 



 The ideal candidate will be hands\-on, execution\-focused, and comfortable working in an Agile/Scrum environment, with strong ownership of delivery, quality, timelines, and stakeholder communication.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**End\-to\-End Product \& Feature Ownership** 



* Own product features from concept → delivery → post\-release support
* Translate business goals into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Take full accountability for scope, timelines, quality, and outcomes
* Balance new features, technical work, and fixes based on priority and impact








**Delivery \& Release Management** 



* Act as Delivery Manager for product initiatives and releases
* Plan, schedule, and run software releases end\-to\-end
* Coordinate engineering, QA, design, and business teams to ensure readiness
* Lead UAT planning and execution, including go/no\-go decisions
* Manage live issues, defects, and hotfixes in coordination with engineering
* Ensure predictable delivery through strong planning and execution discipline



  
 



**Product Ownership (Agile / Scrum)** 



* Act as Product Owner for one or more development teams
* Own, prioritise, and continuously groom the product backlog (Jira)
* Lead sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
* Ensure Agile/Scrum processes are followed with a strong delivery mindset
* Handle defect triage, prioritisation, and resolution tracking



  
 



**Roadmap \& Prioritisation** 



* Own and maintain the product roadmap

 Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**


As a T1 Technical Architect – MuleSoft \& Solace, you will be our hands\-on specialist for API\-led connectivity and event\-driven integration. Reporting to the P1 Technical Architect Manager, you will work closely with senior T2 architects to design, build, test, and maintain our global application interfaces and event mesh networks. Using MuleSoft and Solace PubSub\+, you will connect our internal enterprise applications (such as SAP S/4HANA) with cloud services, regional platforms, and commercial partners, ensuring real\-time, highly reliable, and secure data flows.

 **The Five Principles in Action for This Role**

* **Quality:** You will build and test precise API specifications (RAML/OAS), robust Mule flows, and Solace event schemas that protect the integrity of our enterprise data. Your extreme attention to detail ensures that millions of messages, transactions, and event payloads route cleanly through our global ecosystem without bottlenecks or data loss.
* **Responsibility:** You will own the day\-to\-day stability, performance, and health of our MuleSoft and Solace integration lines. When automated workflows or real\-time event streams hit technical bottlenecks, you take immediate personal ownership to investigate, patch, and restore standard operations.
* **Mutuality:** In a CPG business, our success is entirely linked to the success of our business segments, retail partners, and external systems. You will design and deploy clear, reliable, and standardized API\-led integrations and event topics that make data sharing simple, painless, and mutually beneficial.
* **Efficiency:** You will combat operational waste by building reusable API templates, shared Mule fragments, and standardized event schemas. By minimizing redundant integrations and leveraging pub/sub messaging patterns, you help the business scale digital products with maximum speed and minimum cost.
* **Freedom:** We support your professional growth and technical curiosity. Guided by our long\-term generational mindset, you are encouraged to propose innovative, modern integration approaches (such as combining real\-time APIs with event\-driven architectures) and explore advanced MuleSoft and Solace platform capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Hands\-On API \& Event\-Driven Development**

* Develop, test, and deploy end\-to\-end APIs, integration flows, and event\-driven patterns using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform (Studio, API Manager, CloudHub/RTF) and Solace PubSub\+ (Event Portal, brokers).
* Design and build RAML/OAS API specifications and implement API\-led connectivity architectures (Experience, Process, and System API tiers).
* Configure Solace PubSub\+ message queues, topics, subscriptions, and event mesh networks for high\-throughput, real\-time messaging.
* Build and maintain standard integration points with internal ERP systems—specifically SAP S/4HANA—using SAP Connectors, OData, and modern enterprise integration patterns.

**2\. Platform Integration \& Onboarding**

* Execute technical onboarding and connectivity setup for applications, databases, and third\-party SaaS services entering the API and event mesh networks.
* Conduct performance, load, and end\-to\-end testing of integration flows and event streams to validate low\-latency and reliable message delivery.
* Ensure all MuleSoft APIs and Solace event configurations adhere strictly to global API design standards, security guidelines (OAuth, TLS), and internal architecture blueprints.

**3\. Monitoring, Troubleshooting \& Operations**

* Monitor the health of the MuleSoft and Solace environments, tracking API transaction rates, response times, message queues, and event subscription backlogs.
* Provide rapid Level 2/3 technical support for integration failures, runtime exceptions, API gateway issues, connection drops, and message queue blockages.
* Perform root\-cause analysis (RCA) on persistent runtime issues and implement permanent structural fixes (such as implementing robust error\-handling, caching, or reconnection strategies).
* Help maintain detailed documentation for API contracts, event schema definitions, topology diagrams, and deployment pipelines.

**4\. Technical Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**

* Work under the mentorship of T2 Technical Architects to align MuleSoft and Solace designs with the wider Global Integration Hub architecture (such as SAP BTP IS, Azure IS).
* Identify opportunities to migrate legacy point\-to\-point integrations and file transfer protocols to modern, real\-time API or event\-driven patterns.
* Assist in platform maintenance, coordinate runtime patch testing (Mule runtimes, Solace firmware), and manage digital certificates/keys for secure connections.

**Required Experience \& Qualifications**

**Technical Competency \& Platform Expertise**

* **Integration Focus:** 3\+ years of direct, hands\-on experience designing, developing, and managing integration solutions using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform (CloudHub/RTF) and/or Solace PubSub\+ (or equivalent enterprise event brokers like Kafka, RabbitMQ, though Solace is highly preferred).
* **API Design \& Standards:** Deep understanding of RESTful API principles, RAML/OAS, HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, and XML formats.
* **Messaging \& Event\-Driven Patterns:** Solid experience with pub/sub architectures, message queueing, event\-driven design, JMS, MQTT, AMQP, and Solace event mesh concepts.
* **ERP/System Integration:** Basic to intermediate knowledge of integrating with SAP ERP/S4HANA environments using MuleSoft SAP Connector, IDocs, or RFCs.

**Industry \& Domain Knowledge**

* **CPG/FMCG Familiarity:** Experience working within a fast\-moving consumer goods, retail, or logistics\-heavy business environment.
* **Supply Chain Processes:** Good understanding of standard physical supply chain movements, primarily Order\-to\-Cash (O2C), Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), and warehouse operations (3PL integrations).

**Soft Skills \& Collaboration**

* **Problem\-Solving:** Analytical mindset with a systematic, calm approach to diagnosing system errors and data mismatches.
* **Collaboration \& Communication:** Excellent verbal and written skills, with the ability to coordinate technical requirements smoothly with internal and external IT squads.
* **Growth Mindset:** Strong willingness to learn, adapt to new cloud\-based integration trends, and expand skills into adjacent integration technologies (like Azure or SAP BTP).

**Education \& Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or equivalent practical work experience.
* Certifications in MuleSoft (e.g., MuleSoft Certified Developer, MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect) or Solace (e.g., Solace Certified Developer/Architect) are highly regarded.

36b6b2b8.title: Generative AI Forward Deployed Engineer, Google Cloud
36b6b2b8.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in cloud computing or a technical customer\-facing role.
* Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG\-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience taking production\-grade AI\-driven solutions from conception to launch and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
* Experience leading technical discovery sessions.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Experience implementing multi\-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self\-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
* Knowledge of "LLM\-native" metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost\-per\-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production\-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an "innovator\-builder," moving beyond high\-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high\-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state\-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise\-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real\-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go\-To\-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production\-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi\-agent systems, model context protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable return on investment (ROI).
* Architect and code the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
* Build high\-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
* Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
* Co\-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google\-grade development best practices, ensuring long\-term project success and high end\-user adoption.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

a39f4702.title: Lead System Architect
a39f4702.description:
**Meet Our Team:**
------------------



Our team lives and breathes the Pega delivery vision: quickly building high\-quality, outcome\-driven applications that evolve with the changing needs of business. As a key member of the Pega Consulting team (GTM), you will work with a passionate and driven project team, delivering new and innovative business and technical solutions using Pega technology.

**Picture Yourself at Pega:**
-----------------------------


*Pega is changing the way the world builds software.* In this role, you’ll help us design, develop, implement and test the next generation customer centric solutions. This is your chance to get your hands\-on leading technology that figures out what people really care about.


At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.


We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

**What You'll Do at Pega:**
---------------------------


* Lead and drive scope definition, requirements analysis, functional and technical design, application build, product configuration, unit testing, UAT and production deployment
* Partner with our world leading clients to deliver high quality technical solutions across all phases of the software development lifecycle
* Utilize your outstanding technical consulting skills to demonstrate new and innovative ways to implement software solutions
* Collaborating with a high performing Pega delivery team you will ensure the solution meets or exceeds your client’s expectations.
* Provide support and technical governance focused on one or more projects at a single client
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert to the organization and pro\-actively respond to adhoc questions
**Who You Are:**
----------------


* *Pega CLSA Certified resource must.*
* You are a highly technical hands on individual who is passionate about exploring and applying Pega technology to help solve business problems.
* Experience in building and implementing model\-driven, enterprise\-level business solutions.
* Excellent time management and organization skills, with the capability to manage multiple competing priorities
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate, partner and collaborate
* Willingness to go the extra mile
* Dedication to achieving outstanding customer results with a team\-oriented drive and a demonstrated ability to lead by example
* Aptitude to pick up new concepts and technology rapidly; ability to explain it to both business \& IT stakeholders
* Open to work from 1:00 \- 10:00 PM IST


You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.


You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**What You've Accomplished:**
-----------------------------


* You’ve built and implemented model\-driven, enterprise\-level business solutions and applications.
* You’ve led end\-to\-end delivery of medium to large component of bigger solution.
* You’ve been exposed to a variety of technologies including Application Servers, programming languages, relational and non\-relational data bases and integration techniques.
* You’ve demonstrated knowledge of and applicability of Object\-Oriented techniques and principles.
* You’ve delivered solutions in Agile and Scrum methodologie
**Pega Offers You:**
--------------------


* Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities.
* An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment.
* Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay and bonus incentive, employee equity in the company
* An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‑enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices

  

\#LI\-LR1


  
**AI in Action – Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment**  

Pega embraces the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI) to improve efficiency, consistency, and fairness across our business. We encourage thoughtful and ethical adoption of AI technologies that support people—not replace them. We may use AI‑enabled tools in our recruitment process. These tools are designed to assist us by providing insights and operational support.



All hiring decisions are made based on human review and judgment. You may have the right to request human review, provide additional information, or raise questions about how such tools are used.


**Culture**  

At Pegasystems, we foster an environment where people feel valued and empowered to contribute their best. With global clients across industries and regions, we know our success depends on the unique perspectives, experiences, and talents of our people. Ours is a workplace where everyone can grow, collaborate, and deliver meaningful outcomes.



We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and experiences and focus on the core competencies and mindset needed to thrive in a role.



As an Equal Opportunity employer, Pegasystems will not discriminate in its employment practices due to an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, veteran or disability status, or any other category protected by law.



This same mindset shapes how we work, encouraging curiosity, continuous learning, and smarter ways of working with AI. At Pegasystems, we believe the best ideas come from curious people who embrace change, learn continuously, and use AI to work smarter and move faster. Guided by our values, we bring a growth mindset to every challenge and create lasting impact together.


**Export Compliance**  

For positions requiring access to technical data subject to export control regulations such as this, Pegasystems may need to obtain export license approval from the U.S. Government and EU Authorities for certain individuals.


**Accommodations**  

If you require reasonable accommodations under the Americans with Disabilities Act (US only) or comparable regional regulations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please contact us here or contact (US only) 1\-888\-PEGA\-NOW and/or 225 Wyman Street Waltham, MA 02451 ATTN: Benefits.

96b047af.title: Solution Architect
96b047af.description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a seasoned Full Stack Solution Architect with strong enterprise solution design experience and deep hands\-on expertise in .NET and AI/ML\-enabled platforms. This role is responsible for defining end\-to\-end architecture for new and existing digital products, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions, and guiding delivery across frontend, backend, data, cloud, integration, and machine learning workstreams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead end\-to\-end solution architecture for enterprise web, cloud\-native, and AI/ML\-enabled applications across frontend, backend, integrations, data, and infrastructure layers.
* Translate business requirements, user specifications, and stakeholder discussions into architecture blueprints, technical roadmaps, delivery plans, and scalable implementation approaches.
* Define target\-state architectures, roadmaps, standards, timescales, and governance mechanisms to support effective use of technology and digital services.
* Act as design authority and provide architecture assurance, ensuring all architecture deliverables are aligned with organizational standards, policies, security requirements, and strategic goals.
* Drive full lifecycle solution delivery from concept, requirements gathering, specification, design, development, testing, acceptance, deployment, and operational support.
* Design and enable AI/ML\-powered features and platforms, including model selection, data pipelines, feature engineering, inference patterns, deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and optimization.
* Build prototypes and proof of concepts for AI\-enabled capabilities, including model fine\-tuning and production\-readiness assessments.
* Define API contracts, system integration patterns, and technical architecture artifacts for enterprise\-scale applications and services.
* Guide engineering teams on coding standards, reusable frameworks, design patterns, and architectural best practices.
* Establish and maintain standards for CI/CD, automated testing, source code management, containerization, orchestration, observability, and operational readiness.
* Evaluate and select appropriate cloud platforms, managed services, MLOps tools, frameworks, libraries, and third\-party vendor solutions.
* Ensure strong security, privacy, compliance, resilience, and performance optimization across applications, APIs, and ML pipelines.
* Provide leadership in determining and promoting appropriate frameworks, libraries, tools, and engineering approaches used to translate architecture into working code.
* Mentor technical teams, review solution designs and code, lead architecture reviews, and help build new technical capabilities within the team.
* Engage confidently with senior stakeholders, clients, and both technical and non\-technical audiences to explain solution approaches, trade\-offs, and delivery considerations.
* Drive cost optimization, capacity planning, enterprise integration strategy, and support for organizational change and technology adoption.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* 13\+ years of software development experience, including significant experience in solution architecture, technical design, and enterprise application delivery.
* Strong hands\-on experience with .NET technologies, including C\#, .NET Framework, .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, MVC, Web API, and Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering full stack solutions spanning backend services, web applications, data platforms, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
* Solid experience with SQL Server and broader data technologies, including SQL/NoSQL databases, ETL, data pipelines, and enterprise data integration.
* Experience with distributed systems, REST APIs, JSON, SOAP, WCF, microservices, SOA, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Hands\-on knowledge of AI/ML concepts and implementation, including building, fine\-tuning, deploying, or integrating machine learning models into production applications.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure and/or AWS, including compute, storage, databases, identity and access management, networking, and managed platform services.
* Experience with DevOps practices and tools, including source control, continuous integration, continuous deployment, automated testing, and release governance.
* Strong understanding of containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
* Good knowledge of frontend development with HTML, CSS, HTML5, JavaScript, and at least one modern framework such as Angular, React, or Vue.
* Strong understanding of application security, data privacy, compliance, and performance tuning.
* Excellent documentation, technical proposal writing, presentation, and communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical direction and communicate effectively with clients, leadership, and delivery teams.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with MLOps tools and platforms such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or similar.
* Experience with LLM\-based applications, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and vector databases such as Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, or FAISS.
* Familiarity with high\-throughput, low\-latency architectures and real\-time inference systems.
* Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK.
* Experience with IIS, Mono, ASP.NET MVC vNext, and related Microsoft web ecosystem technologies.
* Knowledge of CRM and collaboration platforms such as SharePoint and Microsoft Dynamics.
* Prior experience in product\-led or SaaS environments and in leading cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Ability to adopt emerging technologies quickly and establish new capabilities within architecture or engineering teams.
* Team mentoring and capability building

1c2bbffb.title: MST Solution Architect
1c2bbffb.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description:** 
 SAP Solution Architect
   

  

**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced SAP Solution Architect to join our team. As an SAP Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and managing SAP solutions that align with our business goals and technology landscape. This position requires a deep understanding of SAP systems, strong problem\-solving skills, and the ability to lead cross\-functional teams in achieving project objectives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Solution Design and Architecture
+ Develop and implement comprehensive SAP solutions that align with business objectives and requirements.
+ Design scalable and sustainable SAP architectures that integrate seamlessly with existing systems and processes.
+ Conduct thorough assessments of current systems and identify opportunities for improvement and optimization.
+ Ensure the architecture adheres to best practices, standards, and compliance requirements.
+ Develop reference architectures and blueprints


* Project Leadership
+ Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including business stakeholders, developers, and IT professionals, to ensure successful project delivery.
+ Provide technical guidance and mentorship to project team members.
+ Monitor project progress, identify potential risks, and develop mitigation strategies.


* Technical Expertise
+ Strong experience of SAP solutions, including SAP HANA, SAP Fiori, SAP BW, SAP ECC, SAP PI/PO, SAP BTP, SAP SLT (not exhaustive)
+ Stay up\-to\-date with the latest SAP technologies, trends, and best practices.
+ Conduct technical reviews and evaluations of proposed solutions to ensure feasibility and effectiveness.
+ Collaborate with vendors and partners to evaluate and select appropriate SAP tools and services.


* Integration and Optimization
+ Design and implement integration strategies to ensure seamless data flow between SAP systems and other EY enterprise applications.
+ Identify and resolve technical issues and bottlenecks to enhance system efficiency.


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in SAP solution architecture and implementation.
* Proven experience in designing and implementing SAP solutions for large\-scale enterprises.

77fdd112.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job description \-** 
**Manager – Cloud (Risk Consulting – Digital Risk)**
**Requisition ID \- TBC**
 EY focuses on high\-ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities. At EY GDS, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY GDS become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The objective of our Risk Consulting services is to provide clients with a candid and reliable overview of their risk landscape. Our solutions enable clients to build confidence and trust with customers, regulators, and the broader market.
   

  

 Within Cloud Risk and Security, this role focuses on leading engagements that assess, test, and validate cloud security and risk controls across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments. The role involves working closely with IT, cloud engineering, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure that cloud environments are secure, resilient, and aligned with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Operate as a fieldwork leader, assisting clients in identifying, assessing, and monitoring cloud\-related security and technology risks.
* Lead and execute cloud security and risk assessments, including control design and operating effectiveness testing across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Collaborate with engagement teams to plan engagements, develop work programs, timelines, risk assessments, and testing procedures.
* Serve as a fieldwork leader by directing daily testing activities, tracking engagement progress, and managing staff performance.
* Perform cloud architecture and configuration reviews covering landing zones, identity models, network segmentation, encryption and key management, logging and monitoring, and backup and disaster recovery.
* Assess cloud governance and security controls aligned to shared responsibility models and industry frameworks.
* Prepare high\-quality deliverables, reports, and recommendations aligned with US work product quality standards.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong fundamentals across cloud risk and cloud security, with hands\-on experience across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong audit mindset with the ability to design, execute, and evidence control testing across cloud environments.
* Proven experience leading cloud security audits, risk assessments, architecture reviews, and maturity assessments.
* Practical experience assessing controls related to identity and access management, network security, encryption and KMS, logging and monitoring/SIEM, backup and disaster recovery, and data protection.
* Experience with containerized and cloud\-native environments, including Kubernetes, serverless, and workload security.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-location teams, manage delivery risks, and deliver high\-quality outcomes within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (non\-negotiable).
* Ability to manage time effectively and work in US time zones, as per project needs.
* Exposure to cyber\-related risk or security activities is an added advantage.


**Behavioral Skills**
* Demonstrates adaptability and agility, with a strong commitment to continuous learning across cloud platforms and emerging technologies.
* Exhibits end\-to\-end engagement leadership, delivering cloud security audits and risk assessments across complex environments.
* Brings an innovation\-oriented mindset, leveraging automation and analytics to enhance control testing efficiency and continuous monitoring.
* Actively contributes to practice\-building initiatives, including development of accelerators, tools, and reusable assets.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide teams to deliver high\-quality outcomes.
* Communicates effectively and manages stakeholder expectations across technical and business audiences.


**To qualify for the role, you must have.**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 7–12 years of total experience, including 3–5 years in cloud security or cloud risk roles.
* Cloud security certifications such as CCSP or CCSK, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, or equivalent.
* Demonstrated experience in cloud security audits, risk assessments, architecture reviews, and control testing.
* Experience designing and assessing controls across identity and access management, network security, encryption and KMS, logging and monitoring, backup and disaster recovery, and data protection.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and compliance standards such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and privacy expectations.
* Client\-facing experience working with engineering, security, and risk stakeholders.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Exposure to container security, Kubernetes, Zero Trust concepts, SASE/SSE, CASB, or cloud\-native security tooling is preferred.
* Experience supporting regulated industries or large\-scale cloud transformations or migrations is an added advantage.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

9572e078.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Position Title:** 
**Delivery Executive – Senior Manager**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Global MS Delivery Executive oversees all of the engagements of a specific offering (understood as the end\-to\-end delivery, including technology, process and people) and works with the various engagement leaders to improve performance and deliver results and outcomes which are in line with the respective cost baselines “as sold” and EY´s related MS contractual obligations.
   

  

 In terms of proposition development this role will focus on delivering services across the following topics
   

  

* Offering delivery normative models and Global Standard Operating Models (GSOM)
* Competence development and ramp up for the specific offering
* Regulatory advisory work when applicable to the offering and on specific engagements
* Risk assessments when applicable to the offering and on specific engagements
* Transformation/change management across offerings and engagements
* Technology/analytics enablement across offerings and engagements
* On boarding/Transition and Data Operations of related engagements
* Quality Assurance \& Remediation
* Training


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* This position owns the end\-to\-end delivery of the defined Managed Services offering to enable growth plan/s.
* Brand and eminence – extend our reputation in the marketplace
* Grow related capabilities through people development, new hires, and service line alignment and develop the appropriate third\-party relationships with the various stakeholders in the supply chain of the specific offering
* End to end delivery, including technology for the offering globally
* Connecting all the SDCs (Service Delivery Centers). Site leaders for specific offering will be coordinated by this role and Account Delivery Leaders will have a dotted line into it as well
* Looking across the offerings and delivery centres to ensure accuracy of delivery for all engagements/solutions
* Accountable for the aggregated cost of delivery as it pertains to the respective offering.
* Deal support – role will support when clients want to review delivery and carry out due diligence. This role will need to manage due diligence visits and sign off on the cost baseline of the deals to make sure the scope is in fact “deliverable” and the supply chain is optimized
* Deal support – they will be the face of delivery for the related offering.
* Accountable for: delivery transformation, continuous improvement and transformation of the delivery network; all the SLAs for the specific offering. Input into the SLAs and build of offering Delivery Leaders in GDS and the SDCs


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Take on leadership role in driving the development of the Global/Managed Services delivery business contributing to growing headcount and revenues as applicable
* Confidence and experience to lead a “first of a kind deal” arrangement and establish new delivery capabilities where needed
* Develop ecosystem of supplier and product vendor relationships and how to take to market a price attractive offering blending in markets and near/off shore resources.
* Enhance our existing recruitment, on\-boarding, and development plan to both target hire experience to support the growth of the practice, and establish a training curriculum to develop the necessary skills to deliver to this market demand.
* Dedicated people accountable to this role, following global standards, right processes etc.
* Strength to withstand significant personal pressure and overtime on a regular basis to address role


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* MBA and or Master's Degree
* Prior experience in Managed Services delivery of global operations (12\+ years)
* Experience in Service Management, Tech Ops and Data Ops functions and UAT capabilities and outsourcing
* Skilled in reengineering initiatives and data intelligence capability
* Lead Global Transformation programmes
* Experience in build/transform MS operations rather than operate BAU
* Domain expertise in the related field of play for the offering the candidate will drive in very large managed services/product companies with significant experience in interacting with senior client personnel including C\-level
* Experience of working in an Agile Scrum environment
* Be proficient in assessing options (e.g. risk, performance and cost\-benefit) and informing decision\-makers with persuasive visualizations based upon assessment outputs
* Can coordinate / collaborate with teams \& stakeholders in multiple geographies
* Manage Matrix teams with participants in multiple geographies
* This role requires flexibility in working with various Client and EY stakeholders across the world and in different time zones
* Travel required


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Experience in integrated managed services solutions primarily around
* 
+ Risk: Transform the risk and controls functions and outcomes of the business, including enterprise risk, enterprise resilience, compliance, internal audit, and controls and protect value across stakeholders in the long term
+ Finance: transform their finance functions and drive value creation by making finance more agile (responsive, insightful and efficient) to support better scalability, decision\-making and enterprise\-wide performance
+ Integrated Workforce Mobility: Tax, Immigration, Compensation, Assignment \& Social Security
+ IT outsourcing models, Cloud/Saas/Paas solutions and the role of IT in digital change

* You may have certification in TOGAF, PMP \& ITIL
* Proficiency in Design Thinking and Agile Methodology
* You will have core understanding of the big four and their got\-to\-market propositions


**What We Look For**
* Ability to extend our reputation in the marketplace
* Passion for problem\-solving and helping our clients with some of their most complex issues


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**

e84e68d4.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
   

  

 TTEC Digital seeks a Solutions Architect to join our team. This role is a full\-time and fully remote opportunity!
   

  

**The work:**
 We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early\-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982\.
   

  

 This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
   

  

**Who we hire — the DNA:**
* Self\-starters and do\-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show\-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI\-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed\-systems literate. High\-efficiency, event\-driven, low\-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.
* No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well\-rounded, smart people who move fast


**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**
* The technical face to enterprise customers — scoping deployments, designing tenant configurations, and getting customers live fast (same\-day with Desktop Intercept).
* You're selling and deploying a platform that combines voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI — technology that changes monthly — so you learn constantly and demo fearlessly
* Startup environment: the deal, the deployment, and the product are all moving at once, and you thrive in that.


**What you'll own:**
* Pre\-sales and deployment architecture
* Tenant configuration and plugin enablement design
* Customer integration scoping (CCaaS / CRM / SIP)
* live demos that win — show\-me applies to customers too
* The customer's voice back into Product and Engineering
* Your committed go\-live timelines.


**Who you are:**
* A self\-starter with grit and a closer's instinct — you like winning, and a signed customer going live is your scoreboard
* Show\-me mentality: you'd rather run the live demo than present the slide
* You adapt fast when the product shifts under you (it will, weekly), love new technology, and use AI tools daily — including in your own demo and scoping workflow
* A do\-er who owns the messy middle instead of escalating it
* A team player who translates in both directions: business requirements into technical needs for engineering, platform capability into business value for the customer.


**What You Will Bring:**
* 8\+ years of solutions architecture/sales engineering in contact\-center, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS.
* Technical enough to design an integration on a whiteboard and credible enough to own a CTO conversation — you keep the respect of senior engineers on both sides of the table.
* Knows CCaaS / CTI, SIP / RTP, and CRM landscapes cold.
* Strong working knowledge of the modern AI stack — LLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, transcription/translation — deep enough to answer the customer's AI architecture and data\-security questions without phoning home.
* Has taken enterprise customers live and owned the messy middle — network quirks, security reviews, procurement, the works.
* Hands\-on enough to configure a tenant, read an API payload, and debug a customer integration in real time — a troubleshooter, not a talker: when the pilot breaks at 4pm, you isolate it.
* Understands event\-driven platform architecture well enough to scope custom integrations accurately — what's config, what's a connector, what's a feature request.
* Deployment playbook craft — turns every go\-live into a repeatable playbook so the second customer is faster than the first; this is how one SA scales.
* Enterprise security fluency — comfortable in InfoSec reviews (SOC 2, data residency, PII/redaction, AI data\-usage questions); AI deals die here without it.
* Competitive positioning depth — knows the CCaaS/agent\-assist landscape and can architect around a competitor's incumbency.
* POC discipline — scopes pilots with clear success criteria and exit dates, so pilots convert instead of drifting.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

0463084b.title: Senior Partner Solution Engineer
0463084b.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential — and people too. With a culture that’s all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology — and careers — to the next level.


We’re at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Our ‘get it done’ culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.


Snowflake partners, from System Integrators (SI), Cloud Service Providers (CSP) and Technology Partners (ISV) are an integral part of Snowflake business to help customers unlock Power of Snowflake AI Data Cloud.


We are seeking a highly motivated and proactive individual to drive the technical growth in this Partner ecosystem.


This role demands a technical expert capable of driving success by aligning with key programs and significantly enhancing partner knowledge of crucial product features. The candidate must effectively present to both technical and executive audiences, utilising methods from whiteboarding to presentations and demonstrations, to cultivating strong mind share among Snowflake Partners across India.


We require a candidate with a demonstrable history of successful engagement with major partners and a proven ability to develop technical champions within their organisations. Ideal candidates will possess a deep understanding of the broader Platform ecosystem, including products and the competitive landscape, enabling them to influence and serve as the partners' trusted technical advisor.


This role requires travel up to 50% within India throughout the quarter to support partner engagement such as enablement, deal support and marketing events.

**AS A PARTNER SOLUTION ENGINEER, YOU WILL:**

* Collaborate closely with Snowflake's Partner, Sales, and Solutions Engineering teams to promote and implement optimal solutions with our partners.
* Design and deliver technical training, workshops, and certifications to upskill partner teams on Snowflake architecture and best practices based on joint business goals.
* Co\-develop industry\-specific solutions and accelerators with partners (e.g., data migration frameworks, industry data models, Power of N motions). Aligning Snowflake's products to maximise impact on their service offerings.
* Present at Snowflake and Partner events, lead hackathons, and drive Snowflake awareness and adoption within partner organisations.
* Partner closely on strategic customer engagements, collaborating with partners to define use cases, deliver compelling presentations, execute successful Proofs of Concept (POCs), and ensure positive outcomes.
* Own the technology roadmap with the partners, to build and scale their Snowflake practices with reference architectures and delivery methodologies.
* Advocate for partner and customer needs with Snowflake product teams.

**OUR IDEAL PARTNER SOLUTION ENGINEER WILL HAVE:**

* Have 10\+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Experience working with Global Systems Integrators, Regional System Integrators, Cloud Service Providers and Technology Partners within the region.
* Developed data domain thought leadership within a partner community.
* Deep comprehension of Partner revenue models, industry priorities and challenges they navigate.
* Proven experience in designing and building highly scalable data pipelines using Spark, Kafka to ingest data from various systems.
* Strong SQL and data warehousing fundamentals (cloud DW experience preferred)
* Experience with Snowflake Technology Partners that specialise in Data Engineering, Data Science, Collaboration and Cyber Security.
* Hands\-on technical experience with DevOps and CI/CD processes and tools, such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, and Google Cloud Build.
* Strong experience with major cloud platforms and tooling, especially Azure, AWS and Google Cloud.
* Experience using Big Data or Cloud integration technologies such as Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, etc.
* Experience with AI/ML use cases is a plus.


Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.


How do you want to make your impact?


For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

6d3949bd.title: Senior AI & Automation Solutions Engineer (m/f/d)
6d3949bd.description:
**City:** Gurugram  

**Department:** Human Resources


**Recruiter:** Tavleen Bindra

  

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.



Joining the People \& Organization Digital Transformation team, you will work directly with the Head of Digital Transformation and a close\-knit team of four engineers based in Berlin. Your work will span automation engineering, AI application deployment on top of HR systems — with direct impact on how Flix manages its people technology globally. This is a pure technical role. There is no administrative overhead, no time\-critical firefighting and no expectation of HR domain expertise on day one — we can teach you the domain. This is an exciting, problem\-solving\-focused role at the intersection of AI, automation, and HR solution architecture. While the technical skills can be developed, what we cannot teach is the engineering mindset, depth of integration expertise, and natural instinct for automation that this role demands.



This is a hybrid role based in Gurugram with a minimum office presence of 3 days per week. The role has a Europe and APAC\-facing scope, with regular collaboration across Central European time zones.


**About the Role**


* Lead the technical workstream supporting internal automation projects —evaluating global HR system options, assessing integration complexity, mapping data dependencies and supporting potential migration execution from Workday or equivalent enterprise HR platforms.
* Design and build automation and integration workflows using n8n,UiPath and Python — including multi\-step orchestration, exception handling, retries, monitoring, alerting and structured documentation.
* Build and maintain enterprise system integrations using REST APIs,OAuth 2\.0, webhooks, SFTP and event\-driven patterns across the HR technology landscape.
* Develop secure AI integrations connecting platforms such as Claude with HRIS and enterprise systems using MCP servers, connectors, plugins and agent frameworks — with appropriate access controls and user\-level permissions.
* Deploy and operate internal applications and AI\-powered tools on Flix's hosting infrastructure (AWS), including RBAC/ABAC access models, secrets management, credential rotation and audit logging.
* Analyse business processes end\-to\-end, identify automation opportunities and design scalable target\-state architectures that can support both the evaluation phase and eventual migration or implementation execution.
* Engage with cross\-functional stakeholders across Europe and APAC —translating complex technical requirements into clear solution designs and project deliverables across 3–6 month project scopes.


**About You**


* 6–7\+ years of hands\-on professional experience in automation engineering, systems integration, solution architecture or AI application development. Exceptional mid\-level candidates with strong technical depth will also be considered.
* Demonstrable experience building and delivering automation workflows and enterprise integrations — this is an engineering role, not a data analytics or reporting role. Experience in Python, n8n and UiPath is essential.
* Strong working knowledge of API design and integration patterns —REST APIs, OAuth 2\.0, webhooks, SFTP and event\-driven architectures.
* Hands\-on experience deploying and operating applications on AWS,including Lambda, API Gateway, Bedrock, Glue, Secrets Manager and CI/CD pipeline management.
* Solid software engineering fundamentals — Git/GitHub, Docker,structured release management and familiarity with security practices including least privilege, RBAC/ABAC and credential handling.
* Experience with Workday or enterprise HRIS platforms (configuration, integration or migration) is a strong advantage and a meaningful differentiator — though not an absolute requirement if your automation and integration fundamentals are strong.
* Comfort working across European and APAC time zones, collaborating with a Berlin\-based team and contributing to strategic cross\-functional initiatives.
* n8n Level 1 or Level 2 certification is strongly preferred.


We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!


**What We Offer**


* **Travel perks**: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* **Work from (M)Anywhere**: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* **Hybrid work model**: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* **Wellbeing support**: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* **Learning \& Development**: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* **Mentoring Program**: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


To view more local benefits specific to each office location,



**Why Join Flix?**



At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.  

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.



If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced **AI/ML Architect** to design and implement enterprise\-grade Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in **Generative AI, AI Agents, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AI Governance, Python**, and modern full\-stack technologies. * **Azure OpenAI**

Preferred Skills

Nice to Have
